GLOBAL.OutpostConcept.name: Outpost
GLOBAL.OutpostConcept.description:
Structure claiming a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] for its owner and forming the foundation for a new [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink].

An outpost can:Be built by a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Hero[/hyperlink].Must be in a land or water province.Cannot be built in an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UninhabitableConcept]Uninhabitable[/hyperlink] province.Cannot be built adjacent to a province with another outpost or city.Be upgraded into a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] if on land.Has various upgrades that can be built on it.Not be entered by enemies without trespassing.Grant access to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Materials[/hyperlink].Provide income from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NodeConcept]Resource Nodes[/hyperlink] in the domain when a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] establishes a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept]Trade Route[/hyperlink] to it.

GLOBAL.AffinityProvinceImprovementConcep.name: Affinity Province Improvement
GLOBAL.AffinityProvinceImprovementConcep.description: Affinity Province Improvements are built from the Production Queue and replace an existing Province Improvement. Only one can be built per City, and an Empire can only build one of each. If the Seed, Root and Heart of the same affinity have been built in the Empire, the Magic Victory Spell is unlocked.

GLOBAL.AccuracyConcept.name: Accuracy
GLOBAL.AccuracyConcept.description: Accuracy is the likelihood of attacks landing successfully. If the attack does not land, it misses or grazes the target.<bulletlist><bullet>Grazes deal half damage.</bullet><bullet>Misses deal no damage.</bullet><bullet>Misses can hit random adjacent units next to the target.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.ActionPointConcept.name: Action Point
GLOBAL.ActionPointConcept.description:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] use Action Points to attack and use abilities.Units get 3 Action Points per [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], and can use up to 2 of them to move.
Abilities use action points in different ways: Ability costs a single action point. The unit's turn ends afterwards. Ability triggers once per remaining action point. The unit's turn ends afterwards. Ability costs 3 action points. The unit's turn ends afterwards. Ability costs 0 action points. Ability costs 0 action points. The unit retains 1 action point afterwards. Ability requires 3 action points. The unit retains 1 action point afterwards.

GLOBAL.BaseAbilityConcept.name: Base Attack
GLOBAL.BaseAbilityConcept.description:
A base attack is a normal attack that a unit can usually use every turn in combat.

Some [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitEnchantmentConcept]Unit Enchantments[/hyperlink] only affect a unit's base attacks.

GLOBAL.CasualtyConcept.name: Casualty
GLOBAL.CasualtyConcept.description:
When a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] sustains damage, members of the unit are lost.

Each member lost lowers the damage output of the unit proportionally. The chance for the unit to apply [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept]Negative Status Effects[/hyperlink] is also reduced.

A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Hero[/hyperlink] unit and large monsters only have a single member and are not affected by this rule.

GLOBAL.ChargeConcept.name: Charge
GLOBAL.ChargeConcept.description:
A Charge attack:Gains extra damage per hex traveled, up to 3 hexes.Cancels [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DefenseModeConcept]Defense Mode[/hyperlink].Removes [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RetaliationConcept]Retaliation Attack[/hyperlink].
These effects are negated by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHARGE_RESISTANCE]Charge Resistance[/hyperlink], unless the attack is a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEAVYMELEESTRIKE]Heavy Charge Strike[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.CombatSpeedConcept.name: Combat Speed
GLOBAL.CombatSpeedConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Combat Speed represents how far a unit can move within a <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Each hex in combat costs 1 point to traverse.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.SlowingConcept]Slowing[/hyperlink] terrain costs 2 points to traverse.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.ControlLossImmunityConcept.name: Control Loss Immunity
GLOBAL.ControlLossImmunityConcept.description:
Immune to effects that make you lose control of a unit, such as [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BERSERK]Berserk[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DOMINATED]Dominated[/hyperlink].
Also grants immunity to being [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CapturedConcept]Captured[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.CriticalHitConcept.name: Critical Hit
GLOBAL.CriticalHitConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>If a unit's attack is a Critical Hit, its damage is increased by +50%.</bullet><bullet>Critical Hits are usually caused by high <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Critical Hit chance can never be higher than an attack's chance to hit.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.DebuffConcept.name: Debuff
GLOBAL.DebuffConcept.description: An ability that attempts to inflict a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept]Negative Status Effect[/hyperlink] on an enemy without directly dealing damage.

GLOBAL.DefenseConcept.name: Defense
GLOBAL.DefenseConcept.description: Defense reduces damage from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MeleeConcept]Melee[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RangedConcept]Missile[/hyperlink] attacks.

GLOBAL.DefenseModeConcept.name: Defense Mode
GLOBAL.DefenseModeConcept.description: Defense Mode is a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] ability. When in Defense Mode, a unit:<bulletlist><bullet>Extends its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ZoneOfControlConcept]Zone of Control[/hyperlink] to all adjacent hexes.</bullet><bullet>Gains +2 <defense></defense> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DefenseConcept]Defense[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Gains +2 <resistance></resistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept]Resistance[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Is immune to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FlankingConcept]<flank></flank> Flanking[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.EngagedInMeleeConcept.name: Engaged in Melee
GLOBAL.EngagedInMeleeConcept.description: While within an enemy's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ZoneOfControlConcept]Zone of Control[/hyperlink], a unit is Engaged in Melee and cannot use most ranged attacks or magical abilities.

GLOBAL.EvasionConcept.name: Evasion
GLOBAL.EvasionConcept.description: Increases chance of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RangedConcept]Missile[/hyperlink] and ranged [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicConcept]Magic[/hyperlink] attacks missing.

GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept.name: Experience
GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept.description:
Experience points are earned by units to allow them to reach higher ranks, improving their abilities.

Units earn experience from winning battles. They also earn a small amount each turn on the world map.

GLOBAL.FirstStrikeConcept.name: First Strike
GLOBAL.FirstStrikeConcept.description: When attacked, a unit with First Strike will use a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RetaliationConcept]Retaliation Attack[/hyperlink] to attack first.

GLOBAL.FlankingConcept.name: Flanking
GLOBAL.FlankingConcept.description: Flanking attacks are triggered by attacking a target from behind or from the side.<bulletlist><bullet>Flanking attacks deal +25% damage.</bullet><bullet>Units in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DefenseModeConcept]Defense Mode[/hyperlink] cannot be flanked.</bullet><bullet>If a unit starts its turn in an enemy's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ZoneOfControlConcept]Zone of Control[/hyperlink], then it cannot flank it in that turn.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.FortifiedConcept.name: Fortified
GLOBAL.FortifiedConcept.description: Can only be damaged by abilities or spells that have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DEMOLISHER]Demolisher[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.FumbleConcept.name: Fumble
GLOBAL.FumbleConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>If a unit's attack is a Fumble:<bulletlist><bullet>A hit becomes a Graze, dealing half damage.</bullet><bullet>A graze becomes a miss.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet><bullet>Fumbles are usually caused by low <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.AmbitionConcept.name: Hero Ambitions
GLOBAL.AmbitionConcept.description:
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Hero[/hyperlink] has an Ambition, which sets goals for them to complete and gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RenownConcept]Renown[/hyperlink]. Each includes a Minor Ambition, which can be repeated any number of times, and a Major Ambition, which can only be completed once.

Completing these ambitions grants [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RenownConcept]Renown[/hyperlink], while completing the Major Ambition additionally grants a unique hero property.

A hero's Ambition may be changed through an event should that hero fail to complete their goals in a set period of time.

GLOBAL.HeroClass.name: Hero Class
GLOBAL.HeroClass.description:
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Hero[/hyperlink] has a Class, chosen during creation. Each class lets the hero specialize in particular roles and often supports two general variations on that role.

Hero Classes:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassDefender]Hero Class: Defender[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassWarrior]Hero Class: Warrior[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassMage]Hero Class: Elementalist[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassRitualist]Hero Class: Ritualist[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassRanger]Hero Class: Ranger[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassDeathKnight]Hero Class: Death Knight[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassSpellblade]Hero Class: Spellblade[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.HeroDedication.name: Hero Signature Skills
GLOBAL.HeroDedication.description:
At certain levels, heroes gain the ability to choose Signature skills. For [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MortalChampionConcept]Champions[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WizardKingConcept]Wizard Kings[/hyperlink], and Dragon Lords, these take the form of Affinity Dedications.

Each tier of Affinity dedication becomes available based on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinities[/hyperlink] of your empire and your hero's level:
Initiate - Requires 1 affinity point and a level 4 Hero.Adept - Requires 3 affinity points and a level 8 Hero.Master - Requires 6 affinity points and a level 12 Hero. Paragon - Requires 8 affinity points and a level 16 Hero.

These Dedications grant a benefit of their own and unlock new Hero Skills.

Some Hero types such as Eldritch Sovereigns have special Signature Skills that are not related to affinity.

GLOBAL.DestinyConcept.name: Destiny
GLOBAL.DestinyConcept.description:
Each Hero has a Destiny, which sets goals for the hero to complete to gain Renown. Each Destiny has a Minor Ambition, which can be repeated any number of times, and a Major Ambition, which can only be completed once.

Completing Ambitions grants Renown, and completing Major Ambitions grants a unique hero property as well.

A Hero's destiny may be changed through an event should that hero fail to complete its ambitions for a set period of time.

GLOBAL.HeroOrigin.name: Hero Origin
GLOBAL.HeroOrigin.description:
The Origin is determined by the type of hero made during faction creation; for most randomly encountered [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Heroes[/hyperlink] this will be [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MortalChampionConcept]Champions[/hyperlink].

This is where skills unique to those types are found, such as breath attacks for Dragon Lords or spell enchantments for [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WizardKingConcept]Wizard Kings[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.RenownConcept.name: Hero Renown
GLOBAL.RenownConcept.description:
Heroes gain Renown as they complete the goals associated with their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AmbitionConcept]Ambition[/hyperlink]. Gaining enough renown increases their Renown Level, which increases the bonuses their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GovernorConcept]Governed City[/hyperlink] gains from the hero's Governance trait.
Additionally, renown levels grant units in the hero's army additional morale and reduce the chance of losing units when [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RoutingConcept]Routing[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.HeroClassDeathKnight.name: Death Knight
GLOBAL.HeroClassDeathKnight.description:
A Hero Class that specializes in high damage [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MeleeConcept]Melee[/hyperlink] attacks, backed up by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DebuffConcept]Debuffs[/hyperlink] and summoned [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UNDEAD]Undead[/hyperlink] units.

Compatible weapons:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.GreatWeaponConcept]Great Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.OneHandedWeaponConcept]One Handed Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShieldConcept]Shield[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.FistWeaponConcept]Fist Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.PolearmWeaponConcept]Polearm Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.SkirmishingWeaponConcept]Skirmisher Weapon[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.HeroClassDefender.name: Defender
GLOBAL.HeroClassDefender.description:
A Hero Class that specializes in defending its allies, survivability, and retaliation.

Compatible weapons:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.OneHandedWeaponConcept]One Handed Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShieldConcept]Shield[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.FistWeaponConcept]Fist Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.PolearmWeaponConcept]Polearm Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.SkirmishingWeaponConcept]Skirmisher Weapon[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.HeroClassMage.name: Elementalist
GLOBAL.HeroClassMage.description:
Elementalists are magical damage dealers setting up attacks or delivering the killing blow with powerful Elemental abilities.
Each Elementalist hero chooses a discipline which determines the element of their abilities.

Compatible weapons:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicOrbWeaponConcept]Magic Orb Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicStaffWeaponConcept]Magic Staff Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.EldritchRelicWeaponConcept]Eldritch Relic Weapon[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.HeroClassRanger.name: Ranger
GLOBAL.HeroClassRanger.description:
A Hero Class that specializes in ranged damage, skirmishing, and disrupting enemies.

Compatible weapons:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.RangedWeaponConcept]Ranged Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.SkirmishingWeaponConcept]Skirmisher Weapon[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.HeroClassRitualist.name: Ritualist
GLOBAL.HeroClassRitualist.description:
A Hero Class that specializes in support through healing and buffs.

Compatible weapons:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicOrbWeaponConcept]Magic Orb Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicStaffWeaponConcept]Magic Staff Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.EldritchRelicWeaponConcept]Eldritch Relic Weapon[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.HeroClassSpellblade.name: Spellblade
GLOBAL.HeroClassSpellblade.description:
A Hero Class that uses both [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MeleeConcept]Melee[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicConcept]Magic[/hyperlink] attacks to deal magic damage from a distance and physical damage when the enemy gets close.

Compatible weapons:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.GreatWeaponConcept]Great Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.OneHandedWeaponConcept]One Handed Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShieldConcept]Shield[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.FistWeaponConcept]Fist Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.PolearmWeaponConcept]Polearm Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.SkirmishingWeaponConcept]Skirmisher Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.RangedWeaponConcept]Ranged Weapon[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.HeroClassWarlock.name: Warlock
GLOBAL.HeroClassWarlock.description:
Warlocks are debuff and undeath experts, using powerful debuffs and empowering undead summons they raise during battle.

Compatible weapons:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicOrbWeaponConcept]Magic Orb Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicStaffWeaponConcept]Magic Staff Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.EldritchRelicWeaponConcept]Eldritch Relic Weapon[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.HeroClassWarrior.name: Warrior
GLOBAL.HeroClassWarrior.description:
A Hero Class that specializes in charge attacks, dealing damage, and gaining strength through fighting.

Compatible weapons:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.GreatWeaponConcept]Great Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.OneHandedWeaponConcept]One Handed Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShieldConcept]Shield[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.FistWeaponConcept]Fist Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.PolearmWeaponConcept]Polearm Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.SkirmishingWeaponConcept]Skirmisher Weapon[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.AdeptHeroSkill.name: Adept Hero Skill
GLOBAL.AdeptHeroSkill.description: Adept skills are unlocked by acquiring 2 other skills in the same category.

GLOBAL.ExpertHeroSkill.name: Expert Hero Skill
GLOBAL.ExpertHeroSkill.description: Expert skills are unlocked by acquiring 4 other skills in the same category.

GLOBAL.MasterHeroSkill.name: Master Hero Skill
GLOBAL.MasterHeroSkill.description: Master skills are unlocked by acquiring 6 other skills in the same category.

GLOBAL.HitPointConcept.name: Hit Point
GLOBAL.HitPointConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Hit Points represent the amount of damage a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] can sustain before it dies.</bullet><bullet>Most units will take [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasualtyConcept]Casualties[/hyperlink] as their Hit Points drop.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.LineOfSightConcept.name: Line of Sight
GLOBAL.LineOfSightConcept.description: Most ranged attacks need Line of Sight to target an enemy.<bulletlist><bullet>If obstacles or other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] are between the attacker and the target, the target becomes [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ObscuredConcept]Obscured[/hyperlink], reducing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AccuracyConcept]<accuracy></accuracy> Accuracy[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Units adjacent to the attacker do not cause a target to be [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ObscuredConcept]Obscured[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.MagicConcept.name: Magic
GLOBAL.MagicConcept.description:
Magic Attacks are attacks performed with magical implements such as orbs and staves.

Many of the special attacks that creatures have, such as dragon's breath, are also considered Magic attacks.

Magic attacks are resisted by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept]Resistance[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.MeleeConcept.name: Melee
GLOBAL.MeleeConcept.description:
Melee attacks are short ranged attacks performed with weapons such as swords, spears, claws and teeth.

They mostly do [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PhysicalDamageConcept]Physical Damage[/hyperlink] and are resisted by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DefenseConcept]Defense[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.HeroMountConcept.name: Hero Mount
GLOBAL.HeroMountConcept.description:
Mounts can be equipped by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HERO]Heroes[/hyperlink] in the relevant slot.
They generally grant [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FAST_MOVEMENT]Fast Movement[/hyperlink] and a small increase in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept] Hit Points[/hyperlink].
Certain powerful weapons cannot be wielded while mounted.
The mount that the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HERO]Hero[/hyperlink] starts with depends on their race and any form traits that race may have.

GLOBAL.MovementAbilityConcept.name: Movement Ability
GLOBAL.MovementAbilityConcept.description:
An ability that moves the unit using it to another location.

Cannot be used by units that are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.IMMOBILIZED]Immobilized[/hyperlink].
Cannot be used when on water unless also a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TeleportAbilityConcept]Teleport[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.MovePointConcept.name: Move Point
GLOBAL.MovePointConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Move Points represent how far a unit can move within a <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Normal terrain costs 6 Move Points to traverse.</bullet><bullet>Sometimes the Move Point cost of terrain can be reduced, such as when moving through your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink], but it can never be reduced below 2 Move Points.</bullet><bullet>In [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink] Move Points are not used, <combatspeed></combatspeed> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpeedConcept]Combat Speed[/hyperlink] is used instead.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept.name: Negative Status Effect
GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept.description:
A negative status effect is a temporary condition that weakens a unit in some way. They are often applied by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DebuffSpellConcept]Debuff Spell[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DebuffConcept]Debuff[/hyperlink] abilities.

Examples include:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUNDERED_RESISTANCE]Sundered Resistance[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.POISONED]Poisoned[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DOMINATED]Dominated[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DECAYING]Decaying[/hyperlink]
All cultures have a unit ability or spell that can remove negative status effects.

Additionally, some negative status effects have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OpposingStatusEffectsConcept]counters[/hyperlink]—for example, [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.POISONED]Poisoned[/hyperlink] can be removed by applying [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.REGENERATION]Regeneration[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.NoRefreshConcept.name: Non-Refreshable Abilities
GLOBAL.NoRefreshConcept.description: Abilities marked with "Can't be refreshed" cannot have their cooldowns and "once per battle" status reset in battle by special abilities such as [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WEAVER]Weaver[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.ObscuredConcept.name: Obscured
GLOBAL.ObscuredConcept.description: When a target is Obscured, it becomes 40% harder to hit with ranged attacks.

GLOBAL.OpportunityAttackConcept.name: Opportunity Attack
GLOBAL.OpportunityAttackConcept.description: Opportunity Attacks are a special type of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RetaliationConcept]Retaliation Attack[/hyperlink] that are triggered when an enemy unit leaves the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ZoneOfControlConcept]Zone of Control[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PositiveStatusEffectConcept.name: Positive Status Effect
GLOBAL.PositiveStatusEffectConcept.description:
A positive status effect is a temporary condition that strengthens a unit in some way. They are often applied by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BuffSpellConcept]Buff Spells[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SupportConcept]Support[/hyperlink] abilities.

Examples include:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BOLSTERED_RESISTANCE]Bolstered Resistance[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.REGENERATION]Regeneration[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HASTENED]Hastened[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STEADFAST]Steadfast[/hyperlink]
Certain rare unit abilities and spells can remove positive status effects.

Additionally, some positive status effects have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OpposingStatusEffectsConcept]counters[/hyperlink]—for example, [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.REGENERATION]Regeneration[/hyperlink] can be removed by applying [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.POISONED]Poisoned[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.RangeConcept.name: Range
GLOBAL.RangeConcept.description:
Range refers to the maximum number of hexes away from a unit that an ability can target.
Using attacks on a target at maximum range will often incur an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AccuracyConcept] Accuracy[/hyperlink] penalty.

GLOBAL.RangedConcept.name: Missile
GLOBAL.RangedConcept.description:
Missile attacks are medium to long ranged attacks performed with weapons such as bows or throwing knives.

They mostly do [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PhysicalDamageConcept]Physical Damage[/hyperlink] and are resisted by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DefenseConcept]Defense[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept.name: Resistance
GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept.description: Resistance reduces damage from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicConcept]Magic[/hyperlink] attacks and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpellConcept]Combat Spells[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.RetaliationConcept.name: Retaliation Attack
GLOBAL.RetaliationConcept.description: A Retaliation Attack is an attack triggered by another [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit's[/hyperlink] attacks or movement<bulletlist><bullet>Melee units can Retaliate once per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] (by default).</bullet><bullet>Attacking an enemy unit within the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ZoneOfControlConcept]Zone of Control[/hyperlink] triggers a Retaliation.</bullet><bullet>An enemy unit moving out of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ZoneOfControlConcept]Zone of Control[/hyperlink] triggers an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OpportunityAttackConcept]Opportunity Attack[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.RetreatingConcept.name: Retreating
GLOBAL.RetreatingConcept.description: When a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] moves onto a Retreat Point during [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink], they will immediately exit the battle. <bulletlist><bullet>Nearby friendly units will lose morale <morale></morale>.</bullet><bullet>The unit will lose Move Points <movementwalk></movementwalk> after battle.</bullet><bullet>Retreating your last unit will cause you to lose the battle.</bullet><bullet>If you lose the battle, the unit will either die, or scatter and reappear at one of your cities after a few turns.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.StatusResistanceConcept.name: Status Resistance
GLOBAL.StatusResistanceConcept.description: Status Resistance reduces the chance that a unit will be affected by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept]Negative Status Effects[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SummoningAbilityConcept.name: Summoning Ability
GLOBAL.SummoningAbilityConcept.description: An ability that summons a unit during battle.

GLOBAL.SupportConcept.name: Support
GLOBAL.SupportConcept.description: An ability that heals or applies [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PositiveStatusEffectConcept]Positive Status Effects[/hyperlink] to friendly units.

GLOBAL.TeleportAbilityConcept.name: Teleport Ability
GLOBAL.TeleportAbilityConcept.description: An ability that instantly moves this unit to another location using magic.

GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept.name: Temporary Hit Point
GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Temporary Hit Points are given to a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] when it is healed in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>When a Unit takes damage, Temporary Hit Points are lost first.</bullet><bullet>When combat ends, all Temporary Hit Points are removed.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept.name: Morale
GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept.description:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] Morale represents willingness to battle.
High Morale increases [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CriticalHitConcept] Critical Hit Chance[/hyperlink].Low Morale increases [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FumbleConcept]Fumble[/hyperlink] chance in battle and Desertion chance on the World Map.Very Low Morale further increases [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FumbleConcept]Fumble[/hyperlink] chance and can lead to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RoutingConcept]Routing[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] in battle and Desertion chance on the World Map .
Morale States:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.HighMoraleConcept]High Morale[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.NeutralMoraleConcept]Neutral Morale[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.LowMoraleConcept]Low Morale[/hyperlink].[hyperlink,GLOBAL.VeryLowMoraleConcept]Very Low Morale[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.RoutingConcept]Routing[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.UnitTierConcept.name: Unit Tier
GLOBAL.UnitTierConcept.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] Tier represents its relative strength in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink].<bulletlist><bullet>Higher tier [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] have a higher per turn [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Tier 3+ Units gain <statuseffectresistance></statuseffectresistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StatusResistanceConcept]Status Resistance[/hyperlink] which increases for higher Tiers.</bullet><bullet>Unit Tiers range from 1 to 5.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Heroes[/hyperlink] are treated as Tier 5 for relevant skills and abilities.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.WorldMapRegeneration.name: World Map Regeneration
GLOBAL.WorldMapRegeneration.description:
Units recover a certain number of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept] Hit Points[/hyperlink] each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] when not in combat.

The amount of hit points regained is higher when the unit is in your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink] near one of your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OutpostConcept]Outposts[/hyperlink]. Being in enemy domain or in the territory of a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestation[/hyperlink] reduces regeneration.

World Map Regeneration can also be increased by certain Hero Skills and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireSkillConcept]Empire Skills[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.CallToArmsConcept.name: Bounty
GLOBAL.CallToArmsConcept.description:
Bounties are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] created quests that can be offered to other Rulers in exchange for a reward. Other non-hostile Rulers may choose to accept the bounty. The Ruler that completes the objective first will receive the reward and complete the bounty.

Rulers receive 20 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink] to complete the bounty. If the time runs out before the objective is completed, then they fail the bounty. While the Bounty target is being [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeConcept]sieged[/hyperlink] or an operation is active, the timer will pause. The timer will also not run out if an AI Ruler is actively attempting the bounty.

The bounty cannot be canceled while any Ruler is attempting it after the turn in which it was created. If the bounty fails during this time, it will return 50% of the reward.

In order to create a bounty and have other Rulers accept it, specific [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CallToArmsRequirementsConcept]requirements[/hyperlink] must be met.

GLOBAL.CallToArmsRequirementsConcept.name: Bounty Requirements
GLOBAL.CallToArmsRequirementsConcept.description:
In order to create a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CallToArmsConcept]Bounty[/hyperlink], you must be at [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink] with another [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink]. Possible bounty targets are:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.OutpostConcept]Outposts[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicVictoryConcept]Bound[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonders[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.ExpansionVictoryConcept]Beacons of Unity[/hyperlink]Occupied [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SealsVictoryConcept]Seals[/hyperlink]
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CallToArmsViabilityConcept]Viability[/hyperlink] is determined for each other ruler which determines whether they can accept your bounty or not. Rulers may accept up to 3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CallToArmsConcept]Bounties[/hyperlink] from another ruler at any time.

GLOBAL.CallToWarConcept.name: Call to war
GLOBAL.CallToWarConcept.description:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] may call each other into [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink] with a Ruler who they themselves are already at war with.

The Rulers must share at least a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MutualConsulateConcept]Wizard's Bond[/hyperlink] to send a call to war. The receiving Ruler may choose to accept or decline the call. Accepting gives them a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievance[/hyperlink] bonus, whereas declining will result in considerable [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept]relations[/hyperlink] penalties.

GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept.name: Grievance
GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept.description:
Grievances determine your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept]War Justification[/hyperlink] against other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink]. They are your reason for going to war.

Obtained primarily by:Seeing a trespasser.Having another Ruler build on a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] you've claimed.[hyperlink,GLOBAL.FabricatedCasusBelliConcept]Fabricating a Grievance[/hyperlink].Being attacked.
Grievances can be exchanged for [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResourceConcept]Resources[/hyperlink] with the Ruler they're held against.

GLOBAL.RivalJustificationConcept.name: Rival Justification
GLOBAL.RivalJustificationConcept.description:
Rival justification is a one-sided [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept]War Justification[/hyperlink] that allows you to ignore the opponent's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievance[/hyperlink] points up to the same amount as your Rival Justification when declaring [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink] on them.
The opposing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] is not affected by your Rival Justification when they declare war on you, nor are you affected by their Rival Justification.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept.name: War Justification
GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept.description:
War Justification is the balance of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievances[/hyperlink] between two [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] and is used to determine the impact of declaring [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink].

When starting a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink]:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept]Alignment[/hyperlink] may be affected. [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink] income may be affected.Non-allied rulers can receive [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievances[/hyperlink].[hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept]Empire Relations[/hyperlink] with other Rulers as well as [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityRelationConcept]relations[/hyperlink] with ([hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageConcept]Vassal[/hyperlink])[hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] may be affected.
The following War Justification levels can be reached:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl3Concept]Major[/hyperlink] (51+)[hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl2Concept]Moderate[/hyperlink] (50 to 26 )[hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl1Concept]Minor[/hyperlink] (25 to 1 )[hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl0Concept]None[/hyperlink] (0 )[hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN1Concept]Unjust[/hyperlink] (-1 to -25 )[hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN2Concept]Very unjust[/hyperlink] (-26 to -50 )[hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN3Concept]Completely unjust[/hyperlink] (-51 )

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl0Concept.name: War Justification: None
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl0Concept.description:
With no [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept]War Justification[/hyperlink] (0 ), declaring [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink] becomes more damaging to your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink].

Unjustified wars are considered an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept]evil[/hyperlink] act, affect all of your relations negatively, and impact your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink] income by -20% while the war lasts. When you are involved in multiple wars which you declared, only the income effect of the war with the worst War Justification will be applied.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl1Concept.name: War Justification: Minor
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl1Concept.description:
Having only minor [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept]War Justification[/hyperlink] (25 to 1 ), means that declaring [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink] is justified but still frowned upon by other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink].

Wars are still considered an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept]evil[/hyperlink] act and your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept]Empire Relations[/hyperlink] with other Rulers will suffer a penalty.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl2Concept.name: War Justification: Moderate
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl2Concept.description: With Moderate [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept]War Justification[/hyperlink] (50 <casusBelli></casusBelli> to 26 <casusBelli></casusBelli>), declaring <rs_war></rs_war> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink] is now supported by your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageConcept]Vassal[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] as they gain a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityRelationConcept]Relations[/hyperlink] bonus, and your <influence></influence> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink] income increases by 10 while the war lasts. When you are involved in multiple wars which you declared, only the income effect of the war with the worst War Justification will be applied.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl3Concept.name: War Justification: Major
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl3Concept.description: With Major [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept]War Justification[/hyperlink] (51+<casusBelli></casusBelli>), declaring <rs_war></rs_war> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink] is fully justified. Your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageConcept]Vassal[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] gain a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityRelationConcept]Relations[/hyperlink] bonus, and your <influence></influence> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink] income increases by 20 while the war lasts. When you are involved in multiple wars which you declared, only the income effect of the war with the worst War Justification will be applied.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN1Concept.name: War Justification: Unjust
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN1Concept.description:
With negative [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept]War Justification[/hyperlink] (-1 to -25 ), declaring [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink] becomes even more damaging to your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink]!

Unjustified wars are considered an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept]evil[/hyperlink] act, affect all of your relations negatively and, impact your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink] income by -40% while the war lasts. When you are involved in multiple wars which you declared, only the income effect of the war with the worst War Justification will be applied.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN2Concept.name: War Justification: Very unjust
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN2Concept.description:
With negative [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept]War Justification[/hyperlink] (-26 to -50 ), declaring [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink] becomes even more damaging to your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink]!

Unjustified wars are considered an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept]evil[/hyperlink] act, affect all of your relations negatively and, impact your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink] income by -60% while the war lasts. When you are involved in multiple wars which you declared, only the income effect of the war with the worst War Justification will be applied.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN3Concept.name: War Justification: Completely unjust
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN3Concept.description:
With completely negative [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept]War Justification[/hyperlink] (-51 ), declaring [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink] can severely damage your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink]!

Unjustified wars are considered an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept]evil[/hyperlink] act, affect all of your relations negatively, and impact your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink] income by -80% while the war lasts. When you are involved in multiple wars which you declared, only the income effect of the war with the worst War Justification will be applied.

GLOBAL.FabricatedCasusBelliConcept.name: Fabricated Grievance
GLOBAL.FabricatedCasusBelliConcept.description:
A fabricated [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievance[/hyperlink] is a Grievance about an event that did not actually happen but can still be used as a cause for [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink].

[hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] can only have one fabricated grievance against another Ruler and can use these to declare War or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DenounceConcept]Denounce[/hyperlink] them. Fabricated Grievances can be sold to the opposing Ruler but cannot be forgiven.

Grievances can be fabricated through [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PronouncementsConcept]Pronouncements[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.DSNeutralConcept.name: Peace
GLOBAL.DSNeutralConcept.description: Peace is the default state of relations. Better terms are achieved through [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept]Negotiation[/hyperlink], or <rs_war></rs_war> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink] can be declared.

GLOBAL.DeclFriendshipConcept.name: Declaration of Friendship
GLOBAL.DeclFriendshipConcept.description:
Declare your Friendship with another [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] publicly.

A modifier that slowly increases towards +300 will be added to your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept]relations[/hyperlink] with the Ruler. Any [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievances[/hyperlink] gained against that Ruler will be reduced by -40%. When two Rulers declare Friendship with each other, each active diplomatic treaty they have increases the maximum relations bonus by +25 , up to +400 in total.

Maintaining a declaration costs 10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] upkeep per [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], which increases by 10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] for each additional declaration.

Declarations can be made and ended through [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PronouncementsConcept]Pronouncements[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.DeclRivalryConcept.name: Declaration of Rivalry
GLOBAL.DeclRivalryConcept.description:
Declare a Rivalry with another [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] publicly.

A modifier that slowly decreases towards -300 will be added to your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept]relations[/hyperlink] with the Ruler. Any [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievances[/hyperlink] gained against that Ruler will be increased by 40%. However, making treaties becomes impossible and any existing treaties will be broken.

Additionally a rising [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RivalJustificationConcept]Rival Justification[/hyperlink] modifier will be gained, which increases by 2 per [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] up to 30 .

Maintaining a declaration costs 10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] upkeep per [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], which increases by 10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] for each additional declaration.

Declarations can be made and ended through [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PronouncementsConcept]Pronouncements[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PactOfCooperationConcept.name: Pact of Cooperation
GLOBAL.PactOfCooperationConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>The <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] opens its borders.</bullet><bullet>A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept]Trade Route[/hyperlink] can be established to this city from one of your own.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Materials[/hyperlink] can be bought.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PactOfIntegrationConcept.name: Pact of Integration
GLOBAL.PactOfIntegrationConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>City ownership is given to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] forging this pact.</bullet><bullet>Ceases to exist as a diplomatic entity.</bullet><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FreeCityLordConcept]Free City Lord[/hyperlink] can be recruited as a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Hero[/hyperlink] of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] forging this pact.</bullet><bullet>Any <whisperingStone></whisperingStone> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DiplomaticTokenConcept]Whispering Stones[/hyperlink] will be released.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PactOfLoyaltyConcept.name: Pact of Loyalty
GLOBAL.PactOfLoyaltyConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>The <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] shares its vision.</bullet><bullet>The <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] allows building on claimed provinces.</bullet><bullet>Contributes 2 <recruitmentPoints></recruitmentPoints> to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Will [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ReinforcementRuleConcept]reinforce[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink] against [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MarauderConcept]Marauders[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] the <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] is at <rs_war></rs_war> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityWarConcept]War[/hyperlink] with.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageConcept.name: Pact of Vassalage
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>The <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] shares part of its <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] and <gold></gold> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] income as tribute.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Materials[/hyperlink] they control are shared with their overlord.</bullet><bullet>Other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink] may no longer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept]negotiate[/hyperlink] better [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEDiplStateConcept]Diplomatic States[/hyperlink] with the <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>The<minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] will join its overlord in any <rs_war></rs_war> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]Wars[/hyperlink] they are fighting, can assist in combat, and can be given directives in War Coordination.</bullet><bullet>Switches to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.VassalagePhaseConcept]Vassalage Phase[/hyperlink], during which further [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept]<allegiance></allegiance> Allegiance[/hyperlink] can be earned to improve the benefits of vassalage. Eventually the <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] may be [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfIntegrationConcept]integrated[/hyperlink] into the empire of its overlord.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-1Concept.name: Tributary
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-1Concept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept]Trade Routes[/hyperlink] with this <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] provide <eventColor>{incomePercentage}</eventColor>% of its income.</bullet><bullet>Shares all of its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Materials[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Contributes <eventColor>{commandPoints}</eventColor><recruitmentPoints></recruitmentPoints> to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>War Coordination is disabled and no new armies will be sent out.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-2Concept.name: Minor Tributary
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-2Concept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept]Trade Routes[/hyperlink] with this <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] provide <eventColor>{incomePercentage}</eventColor>% of its income.</bullet><bullet>Shares all of its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Materials[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Contributes <eventColor>{commandPoints}</eventColor><recruitmentPoints></recruitmentPoints> to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-3Concept.name: Denying Tributary
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-3Concept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept]Trade Routes[/hyperlink] with this <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] provide <eventColor>{incomePercentage}</eventColor>% of its income.</bullet><bullet>Shares none of its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Materials[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Contributes nothing to the Rally of the Lieges.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl0Concept.name: Vassalage
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl0Concept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept]Trade Routes[/hyperlink] with this <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] provide 10% of its income.</bullet><bullet>Shares all of its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Materials[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Contributes 2 <recruitmentPoints></recruitmentPoints> to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>War Coordination becomes available.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl1Concept.name: Bonded Vassalage
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl1Concept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept]Trade Routes[/hyperlink] with this <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] provide 15% of its income.</bullet><bullet>Shares all of its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Materials[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Contributes 3 <recruitmentPoints></recruitmentPoints> to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl2Concept.name: Flourishing Vassalage
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl2Concept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept]Trade Routes[/hyperlink] with this <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] provide 20% of its income.</bullet><bullet>Shares all of its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Materials[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Contributes 4 <recruitmentPoints></recruitmentPoints> to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>City can be [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfIntegrationConcept]integrated[/hyperlink] <influence></influence>.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl3Concept.name: Supreme Vassalage
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl3Concept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept]Trade Routes[/hyperlink] with this <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] provide 25% of its income.</bullet><bullet>Shares all of its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Materials[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Contributes 5 <recruitmentPoints></recruitmentPoints> to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>City can be [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfIntegrationConcept]integrated[/hyperlink] <influence></influence>.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept.name: Allegiance
GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept.description:
Allegiance represents the commitment of a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] to an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink].

Allegiance is primarily gained by giving a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DiplomaticTokenConcept]Whispering Stone[/hyperlink] to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FreeCityLordConcept]Free City Lord[/hyperlink] which starts [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept]Negotiations[/hyperlink]. Increasing allegiance will result in better [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEDiplStateConcept]Diplomatic States[/hyperlink] with the city, eventually leading to a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageConcept]Pact of Vassalage[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfIntegrationConcept]Pact of Integration[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.AIPressureConcept.name: Threat Level
GLOBAL.AIPressureConcept.description:
The threat level represents how threatened other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] feel.

This level is influenced by many factors that look at how well each Ruler is doing: for example if they have large [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink], many [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink], or are supported by many [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DSAllianceConcept]allies[/hyperlink].

The threat level is expressed as a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept]relations[/hyperlink] modifier.

GLOBAL.PronouncementsConcept.name: Pronouncements
GLOBAL.PronouncementsConcept.description: A statement or declaration that [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] can make towards other Rulers to enhance their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept]Relations[/hyperlink]. Includes [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FabricatedCasusBelliConcept]fabricating[/hyperlink] <casusBelli></casusBelli> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievances[/hyperlink], making declarations, [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CallToWarConcept]Calling Rulers to War[/hyperlink] and more.

GLOBAL.NegotiationPhaseConcept.name: Negotiation Phase of Free Cities
GLOBAL.NegotiationPhaseConcept.description:
During the negotiation phase, all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink] may [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept]negotiate[/hyperlink] with a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] for higher [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept] Allegiance[/hyperlink] and better diplomatic states. Once an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] has secured enough [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept] Allegiance[/hyperlink] for a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageConcept]Pact of Vassalage[/hyperlink], this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CompetitorConcept]competition[/hyperlink] ends and the \"winning\" [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] enters the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.VassalagePhaseConcept]Vassalage Phase[/hyperlink].

These are the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEDiplStateConcept]Diplomatic States[/hyperlink] of the Negotiation Phase: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityWarConcept]War[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityNeutralConcept]Neutral[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfCooperationConcept]Pact of Cooperation[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfLoyaltyConcept]Pact of Loyalty[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageConcept]Pact of Vassalage[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.VassalagePhaseConcept.name: Vassalage Phase of Free Cities
GLOBAL.VassalagePhaseConcept.description:
During the vassalage phase, only the overlord [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] may [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept]negotiate[/hyperlink] with a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink]. Other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink] can only declare [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityWarConcept]War[/hyperlink] on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] by declaring war on the Free City overlord.

These are the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEDiplStateConcept]Diplomatic States[/hyperlink] of the Vassalage Phase:{GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-3Concept.Hyperlink}{GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-2Concept.Hyperlink}{GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-1Concept.Hyperlink} [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl0Concept]Vassalage[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl1Concept]Bonded Vassalage[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl2Concept]Flourishing Vassalage[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl3Concept]Supreme Vassalage[/hyperlink]
Once [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl2Concept]Flourishing Vassalage[/hyperlink] is reached, the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfIntegrationConcept]Pact of Integration[/hyperlink] becomes available, allowing an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] to fully absorb the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.TruceConcept.name: Truce
GLOBAL.TruceConcept.description: Both [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] vow not to attack each other while the truce lasts. <rs_war></rs_war> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink] may still be declared, but counts as an <evilact></evilact> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept]evil[/hyperlink] act.

GLOBAL.TrespassingConcept.name: Trespassing
GLOBAL.TrespassingConcept.description:
Armies are considered to be trespassing when they are seen moving through the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] of another [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] without having an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OpenBordersConcept]open borders agreement[/hyperlink].

Trespassing will give other Rulers a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievance[/hyperlink] and damages the relation with free cities.

GLOBAL.PTDAlliancesConcept.name: Alliances
GLOBAL.PTDAlliancesConcept.description: The Ruler is less inclined toward hostile actions, is keen to act more in favor of good relations with other Rulers and cities and will not break their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DSAllianceConcept]Alliances[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PTDCovertConcept.name: Covert
GLOBAL.PTDCovertConcept.description: The Ruler is prone to making pronouncements and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CallToWarConcept]Calls to War[/hyperlink] more often, but is less eager to answer a call to war.

GLOBAL.PTDGainVassalsConcept.name: Gaining vassals
GLOBAL.PTDGainVassalsConcept.description: The Ruler favors gaining both cities and Rulers as vassals, but will not submit to becoming a vassal themselves.

GLOBAL.PTDGreedyConcept.name: Hard bargains
GLOBAL.PTDGreedyConcept.description: The Ruler likes to carry on [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeConcept]Trade[/hyperlink] but tends to place more value on their own side of the deal. Other Rulers may have to sweeten their offers to make a deal happen.

GLOBAL.PTDIsolationConcept.name: Isolation
GLOBAL.PTDIsolationConcept.description: The Ruler does not easily want to commit to relations and is reluctant to answer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CallToWarConcept]Calls to War[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PTDNeutralConcept.name: Neutral
GLOBAL.PTDNeutralConcept.description: The Ruler engages in all forms of diplomacy to an equal degree as opportunities arise.

GLOBAL.PTDNeverBreakTreatiesConcept.name: Never breaks Treaties
GLOBAL.PTDNeverBreakTreatiesConcept.description: The Ruler is committed to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TreatyConcept]Treaties[/hyperlink] they have with other Rulers and will always try to prevent them from being broken.

GLOBAL.PTDNeverSurrenderConcept.name: Never Surrender
GLOBAL.PTDNeverSurrenderConcept.description: The Ruler will not submit to becoming another Ruler's vassal. During <rs_war></rs_war> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink], they will not make peace of their own accord. They are more eager to call allies to war and will also more readily answer a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CallToWarConcept]Call to War[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PTDNoTreatiesConcept.name: Wary of Treaties
GLOBAL.PTDNoTreatiesConcept.description: In general, the Ruler is not interested in having [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TreatyConcept]Treaties[/hyperlink] with other Rulers, making such trades more costly for the opposing side. They are reluctant to call another Ruler to war and to answer any incoming [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CallToWarConcept]Calls to War[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PTDTradingConcept.name: Trading
GLOBAL.PTDTradingConcept.description: The Ruler is keen on making [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeConcept]Trade[/hyperlink] offers fairly often.

GLOBAL.PTDTreatiesConcept.name: Treaty
GLOBAL.PTDTreatiesConcept.description: The Ruler prefers forming [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TreatyConcept]Treaties[/hyperlink] with other Rulers and will not break any treaties or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DSAllianceConcept]Alliances[/hyperlink] they have.

GLOBAL.PTDVassalizeToStrongConcept.name: Vassalize the Strong
GLOBAL.PTDVassalizeToStrongConcept.description: The Ruler is tempted to make vassals of other strong Rulers.

GLOBAL.PTDWarDrivenConcept.name: Driven by War
GLOBAL.PTDWarDrivenConcept.description: The Ruler is easily provoked into going to <rs_war></rs_war> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink], even over minor <casusBelli></casusBelli> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievances[/hyperlink]. They will not sell or forgive any of their grievances and are more eager to send and answer a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CallToWarConcept]Call to War[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PTDWarJustifiedConcept.name: War must be justified
GLOBAL.PTDWarJustifiedConcept.description: The Ruler will not go to <rs_war></rs_war> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]Wars[/hyperlink] over minor <casusBelli></casusBelli> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievances[/hyperlink] and will want to justify their war.

GLOBAL.PersonalityPreferenceConcept.name: Personality Preference
GLOBAL.PersonalityPreferenceConcept.description:
Preferences are part of how an AI Ruler perceives other Rulers and determine which Actions or statuses they like or dislike other Rulers to pursue.

Relations with Rulers that conform to these preferences will receive a relation bonus, while Relations with Rulers that trigger Dislikes will incur a relation penalty.

GLOBAL.PersonalityStrategyConcept.name: Strategy
GLOBAL.PersonalityStrategyConcept.description: A Ruler's Strategy determines how they will act in terms of their Economy, Research, and Military, but also on a Diplomatic Level.

GLOBAL.PTSExpansionConcept.name: Expansion
GLOBAL.PTSExpansionConcept.description: The Ruler favors expanding their empire by building and absorbing cities. They focus on improving their cities and defending them.

GLOBAL.PTSExploitationConcept.name: Exploitation
GLOBAL.PTSExploitationConcept.description: The Ruler favors exploiting all forms of resources near them and will hunt down [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PickupConcept]Pickups[/hyperlink], marauders and cities with their army. Captured cities will be migrated into their own population.

GLOBAL.PTSExplorationConcept.name: Exploration
GLOBAL.PTSExplorationConcept.description: The Ruler favors exploring the map, seeking out potential resources such as [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PickupConcept]Pickups[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonders[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PTSExterminationConcept.name: Extermination
GLOBAL.PTSExterminationConcept.description: The Ruler favors capturing resources using large armies rather than building them themselves and will raze other Rulers' cities that they have occupied.

GLOBAL.PTSNeutralConcept.name: Neutral
GLOBAL.PTSNeutralConcept.description: The Ruler has no specific agenda or focus and acts more on the opportunities that present themselves.

GLOBAL.PTAstral01Concept.name: Pure Sage
GLOBAL.PTAstral01Concept.description: A knowledgeable Ruler who believes in mind over matter.

GLOBAL.PTAstral02Concept.name: Strategist Warlord
GLOBAL.PTAstral02Concept.description: An ambitious Ruler who values strategy and magical prowess.

GLOBAL.PTAstral03Concept.name: Erudite Sage
GLOBAL.PTAstral03Concept.description: A peaceful Ruler who values wisdom and learning.

GLOBAL.PTChaos01Concept.name: Militant Warlord
GLOBAL.PTChaos01Concept.description: A power-hungry Ruler who believes that might makes right.

GLOBAL.PTChaos02Concept.name: Revolutionary Diplomat
GLOBAL.PTChaos02Concept.description: A rebellious Ruler who values both freedom and alliances.

GLOBAL.PTChaos03Concept.name: Demonic Warlord
GLOBAL.PTChaos03Concept.description: A bloodthirsty Ruler who prefers treachery to weakness.

GLOBAL.PTMaterium01Concept.name: Competitive Merchant
GLOBAL.PTMaterium01Concept.description: A coin-savvy Ruler who is willing to trade... for the right price.

GLOBAL.PTMaterium02Concept.name: Solitary Isolationist
GLOBAL.PTMaterium02Concept.description: An isolated Ruler who believes in a strong defensive force.

GLOBAL.PTMaterium03Concept.name: Artisan Merchant
GLOBAL.PTMaterium03Concept.description: An expressive creator who values both matter and mind.

GLOBAL.PTMaterium04Concept.name: Economic Warlord
GLOBAL.PTMaterium04Concept.description: A greedy Ruler who will stop at nothing to achieve economic goals.

GLOBAL.PTNature01Concept.name: Persevering Diplomat
GLOBAL.PTNature01Concept.description: A peace-keeping Ruler who believes in good relations.

GLOBAL.PTNature02Concept.name: Harmonious Sage
GLOBAL.PTNature02Concept.description: A forgiving Ruler who values alliances and exploration.

GLOBAL.PTNature03Concept.name: Protective Sage
GLOBAL.PTNature03Concept.description: A vigilant Ruler who prefers vassalization and magic.

GLOBAL.PTOrder01Concept.name: Chivalrous Diplomat
GLOBAL.PTOrder01Concept.description: An honorable Ruler who believes in justice and peace.

GLOBAL.PTOrder02Concept.name: Authoritarian Diplomat
GLOBAL.PTOrder02Concept.description: A strict Ruler who believes in high civic order.

GLOBAL.PTOrder03Concept.name: Imperial Warlord
GLOBAL.PTOrder03Concept.description: An imperialistic Ruler who favors stability through subjugation.

GLOBAL.PTOrder04Concept.name: Fanatic Isolationist
GLOBAL.PTOrder04Concept.description: A secluded Ruler who values purity of mind and empire.

GLOBAL.PTShadow01Concept.name: Deceptive Spy
GLOBAL.PTShadow01Concept.description: A cunning Ruler who values power and treachery.

GLOBAL.PTShadow02Concept.name: Reserved Isolationist
GLOBAL.PTShadow02Concept.description: An individualistic Ruler who prefers peaceful co-existence.

GLOBAL.PTShadow03Concept.name: Sinister Spy
GLOBAL.PTShadow03Concept.description: A self-centered Ruler who prefers to deal with the weak.

GLOBAL.AllowClaimedSectorsConcept.name: Province-Claiming Pact
GLOBAL.AllowClaimedSectorsConcept.description: Both [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] are allowed to build on each other's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ClaimConcept]claimed[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] without triggering <casusBelli></casusBelli> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievances[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.MutualConsulateConcept.name: Wizard's Bond
GLOBAL.MutualConsulateConcept.description:
Both [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] agree to a wizard's bond to improve [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept]Empire Relations[/hyperlink] and access new [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TreatyConcept]Treaties[/hyperlink] and Diplomatic States.

Effects:The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept]Throne City[/hyperlink] of each Ruler will be revealed.Rulers can [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CallToWarConcept]call each other to war[/hyperlink].
Leads to: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DefensivePactConcept]Defensive Pact[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.OpenBordersConcept]Open Borders[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.AllowClaimedSectorsConcept]Province-Claiming Pact[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.TeleporterPactConcept]Teleporter Pact[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeAgreementConcept]Free Trade Agreement[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.DefensivePactConcept.name: Defensive Pact
GLOBAL.DefensivePactConcept.description:
A Diplomatic State in which the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] vow to come to each other's aid in defensive wars.

When war is declared on either Ruler, they will automatically send a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CallToWarConcept]Call to War[/hyperlink] to the other, asking them to aid them in the war. Answering this call to war will give the Ruler additional [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievances[/hyperlink] to use directly. Rulers may still refuse to accept this call but will break the defensive pact if they do.

Leads to: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DSAllianceConcept]Alliance[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShareVisionConcept]Share Vision[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.OpenBordersConcept.name: Open Borders
GLOBAL.OpenBordersConcept.description: Both [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] open their borders to each other. This allows [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink] to move through [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] of the opposing Ruler without [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TrespassingConcept]trespassing[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.ReturnCapturedHeroesConcept.name: Returning captured heroes.
GLOBAL.ReturnCapturedHeroesConcept.description:
When captured [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Heroes[/hyperlink] are returned to their original owner, they will become available for recruitment (for free). Heroes in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CryptConcept]Crypt[/hyperlink] will be returned to the crypt of the original owner instead.

When reaching an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DSAllianceConcept]Alliance[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] will automatically return their captured heroes to the other ruler.

GLOBAL.ShareVisionConcept.name: Share Vision
GLOBAL.ShareVisionConcept.description: Both [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] share their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.VisionRangeConcept]Vision[/hyperlink] with each other and will reveal explored areas to each other.

GLOBAL.TeleporterPactConcept.name: Teleporter Pact
GLOBAL.TeleporterPactConcept.description: Both [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] allow each other to teleport to and from their <teleporter></teleporter> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TeleporterConcept]Teleporters[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.HeroClassBattlesaint.name: Battlesaint
GLOBAL.HeroClassBattlesaint.description:
Battlesaints gain Fervor through particular actions that they spend for powerful support abilities or to empower themselves and smite their enemies.

Compatible weapons:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.GreatWeaponConcept]Great Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.OneHandedWeaponConcept]One Handed Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShieldConcept]Shield[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.FistWeaponConcept]Fist Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.PolearmWeaponConcept]Polearm Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicStaffWeaponConcept]Magic Staff Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicOrbWeaponConcept]Magic Orb Weapon[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.SkirmishingWeaponConcept]Skirmisher Weapon[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.ArchitectMonumentConcept.name: Monuments
GLOBAL.ArchitectMonumentConcept.description:
Monuments are a unique type of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvement[/hyperlink] available to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchitectConcept]Architects[/hyperlink] and built using [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WonderStoneConcept]Wonderstone[/hyperlink].
Monuments grant their owner [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AFFINITY_INCARNATE_UNIT_PROPERTY]Affinity Incarnate[/hyperlink], on higher tiers they grant additional [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink] and economic effects to their owner.

The foundation is built in the city in a manner similar to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpecialImprovementConcept]Special Province Improvements[/hyperlink]. The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink] of the Monument is chosen when this is placed down.
The Monument can be improved to further increase its effects:Stage 1 - Foundation
Architect units gain +1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AFFINITY_INCARNATE_UNIT_PROPERTY]Affinity Incarnate[/hyperlink].
+10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in the city.Stage 2 - Sanctum
Architect units gain +2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AFFINITY_INCARNATE_UNIT_PROPERTY]Affinity Incarnate[/hyperlink].
+20 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in the city.Stage 3 - Zenith
Architect units gain +3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AFFINITY_INCARNATE_UNIT_PROPERTY]Affinity Incarnate[/hyperlink].
Units gain +1 Protection of the monument's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink].
The Empire gains +1 of the monument's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink].
+20 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in the city.
+10% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitProductionConcept]Draft[/hyperlink] in the city.Stage 4 - Apex
Architect units gain +4 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AFFINITY_INCARNATE_UNIT_PROPERTY]Affinity Incarnate[/hyperlink].
Units gain +2 Protection of the monument's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink].
The Empire gains +2 of the monument's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink].
+20 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in the city.
+10% to all income in the city.Counts as a Gold [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonder[/hyperlink]Your Empire may gain up to 4 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AFFINITY_INCARNATE_UNIT_PROPERTY]Affinity Incarnate[/hyperlink] from
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchitectMonumentConcept]Monuments[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.ArchitectMonumentShortConcept.name: Monument
GLOBAL.ArchitectMonumentShortConcept.description:
Monuments are a unique type of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvement[/hyperlink] available to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchitectConcept]Architects[/hyperlink] and built using [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WonderStoneConcept]Wonderstone[/hyperlink].
Monuments cannot be hurried in the city screen, and cannot have their cost reduced.

GLOBAL.BlessedTerrainConcept.name: Blessed
GLOBAL.BlessedTerrainConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

A serene aura can be felt in the surrounding terrain. [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] annexing this province gain +5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.DragonLordConcept.name: Dragon Lord
GLOBAL.DragonLordConcept.description:
A mighty Dragon seeking new realms to shape in their vision.
Dragon Lords have access to unique combat Hero Skills.Dragon Lords gain powerful transformation [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroDedication]Hero Signature Skills[/hyperlink] based on empire [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinities[/hyperlink].Gain extra [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] through their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DragonHoardConcept]Dragon Hoard[/hyperlink].Dragon Lords are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_DRAGON_GOVERNOR]Dragon Governors[/hyperlink].Dragon Lords have a 30 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink] and cannot equip most Hero Items.

GLOBAL.BeaconOfLightConcept.name: Beacon of Light
GLOBAL.BeaconOfLightConcept.description: An [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Army[/hyperlink] can build a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SanctuaryOutpostConcept]Sanctuary Outpost[/hyperlink] on a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink]. Shielding units from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHADOW_SICKNESS]Umbral Malady[/hyperlink] and allowing annexation of nearby [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SanctuaryOutpostConcept.name: Sanctuary Outpost
GLOBAL.SanctuaryOutpostConcept.description: A type of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OutpostConcept]Outpost[/hyperlink] that can only be built in a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UmbralAbyssConcept]Umbral Abyss[/hyperlink] with a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BeaconOfLightConcept]Beacon of Light[/hyperlink].<bulletlist><bullet>Friendly [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] inside the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink] of a Sanctuary Outpost are immune to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHADOW_SICKNESS]Umbral Malady[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] cannot be founded in Sanctuary Outposts.</bullet><bullet>Once built, can be upgraded to annex 2 additional provinces.</bullet><bullet>Grants +10 <gold></gold> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink], +10 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink], and +10 <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.EldritchPactConcept.name: Eldritch Pact
GLOBAL.EldritchPactConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>The <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DwellingConcept]Dwelling[/hyperlink] shares its income and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Materials[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>The <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DwellingConcept]Dwelling[/hyperlink] shares its vision.</bullet><bullet>The <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DwellingConcept]Dwelling[/hyperlink] allows building on claimed provinces.</bullet><bullet>Contributes 5 <recruitmentPoints></recruitmentPoints> to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Will [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ReinforcementRuleConcept]reinforce[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink] against [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MarauderConcept]Marauders[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] the <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DwellingConcept]Dwelling[/hyperlink] is at <rs_war></rs_war> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityWarConcept]War[/hyperlink] with.</bullet><bullet>Allows the purchasing of special [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] and other bonuses to benefit from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink] via Cooperation.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingTruce.name: Truce
GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingTruce.description:
The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingConcept]Umbral Dwelling[/hyperlink] tolerates you.

Counts as [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityNeutralConcept]Neutral[/hyperlink] state.

Umbral Dwellings do not care about Trespassing or Province Claims.

You cannot assign a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DiplomaticTokenConcept]Whispering Stone[/hyperlink] to Umbral Dwellings. Instead, making more sacrifices will let you reach an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EldritchPactConcept]Eldritch Pact[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingWarConcept.name: War
GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingWarConcept.description:
A state of War with a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DwellingConcept]Dwelling[/hyperlink] means that [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink] can engage in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] can be attacked.

During war, Dwellings will occasionally send armies to attack their enemies.

When an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingConcept]Umbral Dwelling[/hyperlink] conquers another City. It will destroy it and create an Umbral Nest [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestation[/hyperlink].

Wars end through defeat on either side or by negotiating peace.

GLOBAL.UmbralAbyssConcept.name: Umbral Abyss
GLOBAL.UmbralAbyssConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Units in this layer suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHADOW_SICKNESS]Umbral Malady[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.OutpostConcept]Outposts[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] can't be built in this layer.</bullet><bullet><caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TerraformingSpellConcept]Terraforming Spells[/hyperlink] can't be used in this layer.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.GloomTearConcept.name: Gloom Tear
GLOBAL.GloomTearConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

A wound in reality seeping with eldritch power. Makes this province count as having [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.DeclSupremacyConcept.name: Declaration of Debt
