GLOBAL.DeclSupremacyConcept.description: Utilize Favors to keep another [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] at bay:<bulletlist><bullet>A modifier that slowly increases towards 300 <goodRelation></goodRelation> will be added to your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept]relations[/hyperlink] with the Ruler. </bullet><bullet>While the Declaration lasts, the affected player will not have any grudge affecting the relation for any of their <casusBelli></casusBelli> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievances[/hyperlink] towards you.</bullet><bullet>Maintaining a declaration costs 5 <favors></favors> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FavorsConcept]Favors[/hyperlink] upkeep per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], which increases by 5 <favors></favors> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FavorsConcept]Favors[/hyperlink] for each additional declaration.</bullet><bullet>Declarations can be made and ended through [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PronouncementsConcept]Pronouncements[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.GainingWarspoilsConcept.name: Gaining War Spoils
GLOBAL.GainingWarspoilsConcept.description:
War Spoils are gained through:

Killing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] belonging to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DwellingConcept]Dwellings[/hyperlink], or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink].[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitTierConcept]Unit tier[/hyperlink] I units grant 5 .[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitTierConcept]Unit tier[/hyperlink] II units grant 10 .[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitTierConcept]Unit tier[/hyperlink] III units grant 20 .[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitTierConcept]Unit tier[/hyperlink] IV units grant 40 .[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitTierConcept]Unit tier[/hyperlink] V units grant 80 .[hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Heroes[/hyperlink] grant 5 per level.
Conquering [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink]Gain 50 + 10 per [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] the conquered city had.[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PillagingConcept]Pillaging[/hyperlink] Provinces grants +20 .

GLOBAL.FavorsConcept.name: Favors
GLOBAL.FavorsConcept.description:
A unique resource used by the Federated [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ReaverConcept]Reavers[/hyperlink] subculture.
Favors are used to influence Free Cities, coordinate Vassals, and recruit from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].

Favors are gained by defeating [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MarauderConcept]Marauders[/hyperlink], destroying [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestations[/hyperlink], and maintaining [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl3Concept]Supreme Vassalage[/hyperlink] with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.WarSpoilsConcept.name: War Spoils
GLOBAL.WarSpoilsConcept.description:
War Spoils are a unique resource gathered by Imperial [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ReaverConcept]Reavers[/hyperlink] through conquest and battle with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DwellingConcept]Dwellings[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] as well as pillaging. They can be used to:Improve their cities with the repeatable War Trophies structure.Recruit [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUBDUED]Subdued[/hyperlink] units after combat.Recruit the Magelock Cannon unit in Imperial Reaver cities..
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.GainingWarspoilsConcept]Gaining War Spoils[/hyperlink]
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UsingWarspoilsConcept]Using War Spoils[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.TotalWarConcept.name: Total War
GLOBAL.TotalWarConcept.description: No <influence></influence> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink] income penalties from <rs_war></rs_war> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink] without [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept]War Justification[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.UsingWarspoilsConcept.name: Using War Spoils
GLOBAL.UsingWarspoilsConcept.description: War Spoils can be used to:<bulletlist><bullet>Improve your cities with the repeatable War Trophies structure.</bullet><bullet>Recruit [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUBDUED]Subdued[/hyperlink] units after combat.</bullet><bullet>Recruit the Magelock Cannon unit in Imperial Reaver cities.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingCrystalPactConcept.name: Crystal Pact
GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingCrystalPactConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Will [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ReinforcementRuleConcept]reinforce[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink] against [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MarauderConcept]Marauders[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] the <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DwellingConcept]Dwelling[/hyperlink] is at <rs_war></rs_war> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityWarConcept]War[/hyperlink] with.</bullet><bullet>Unlocks purchase of the following trade items via Cooperation:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.TOKENDEFINITION.LITHORITE_PRISM_ARTIFACT]Lithorite Prism[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.CRYSTAL_FOCUS]Crystal Focus[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.CRYSTALLIZE_ESSENCE]Crystallize Essence[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.CRYSTAL_CRASH]Crystal Crash[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.LITHORINE_SHARDLANCER]Lithorine Shardlancer[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.LITHORINE_GEMCASTER]Lithorine Gemcaster[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist></bullet><bullet>Completing Dwelling quests rewards guaranteed <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] in addition to their other rewards.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingEternalPactConcept.name: Eternal Pact
GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingEternalPactConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>The <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DwellingConcept]Dwelling[/hyperlink] shares its vision.</bullet><bullet>Unlocks purchase of the following trade items via Cooperation:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.TOKENDEFINITION.LITHORITE_ASTROLABE_ARTIFACT]Lithorite Astrolabe[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.ETERNAL_EMBASSY]Eternal Embassy[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.LITHORINE_SIMULACRUM]Lithorine Simulacrum[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.EQUIPMENT.ETERNAL_GOLDSEEKERS_PICKAXE]Eternal goldseekers pickaxe[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.EQUIPMENT.ETERNAL_LITHORINE_ORB]Eternal lithorine orb[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.EQUIPMENT.ETERNAL_SHATTERBLADES]Eternal shatterblades[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.EQUIPMENT.ETERNAL_TITANS_GREATBOW]Eternal titans greatbow[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist></bullet><bullet>Completing Dwelling quests rewards guaranteed <influence></influence> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink] in addition to their other rewards.</bullet><bullet>The <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DwellingConcept]Dwelling[/hyperlink] grants a substantial <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink] income boon.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingTruceConcept.name: Truce
GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingTruceConcept.description:
The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingConcept]Crystal Dwelling[/hyperlink] tolerates you.

Counts as [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityNeutralConcept]Neutral[/hyperlink] state.

Crystal Dwellings do not care about Province Claims.

You cannot assign a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DiplomaticTokenConcept]Whispering Stone[/hyperlink] to Crystal Dwellings. Instead, completing quests will let you reach higher diplomatic states and eventually an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingEternalPactConcept]Eternal Pact[/hyperlink].

Unlocks purchase of the following trade items via Cooperation:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.LITHORINE_CORE]Lithorine Core[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.EQUIPMENT.CRYSTALRUNNER_MOUNT]Crystalrunner mount[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.LavaRunesteleConcept.name: Lava Runestele
GLOBAL.LavaRunesteleConcept.description: Every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] within 2 Province radius of this structure:<bulletlist><bullet>Gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept]Ashlands[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChasmConcept]Chasm[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Loses [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RiverConcept]River[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FertilePlainsConcept]Grassland[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SwampConcept]Swamp[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SnowConcept]Snow[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept]Ice[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CavernFloorConcept]Cavern Floor[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FungusFieldsConcept]Fungus Fields[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.IceRunesteleConcept.name: Ice Runestele
GLOBAL.IceRunesteleConcept.description: Every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] within 2 Province radius of this structure:<bulletlist><bullet>Gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SnowConcept]Snow[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept]Ice[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Loses [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChasmConcept]Chasm[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FertilePlainsConcept]Grassland[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SwampConcept]Swamp[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RiverConcept]River[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept]Ashlands[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CavernFloorConcept]Cavern Floor[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FungusFieldsConcept]Fungus Fields[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.RockRunesteleConcept.name: Rock Runestele
GLOBAL.RockRunesteleConcept.description: Every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] within 2 Province radius of this structure:<bulletlist><bullet>Gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MountainConcept]Mountain[/hyperlink] if on the Surface or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StalagmitesConcept]Stalagmites[/hyperlink] if in the Underground.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.StormRunesteleConcept.name: Storm Runestele
GLOBAL.StormRunesteleConcept.description: Every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], a Surface [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] within 2 Province radius of this structure:<bulletlist><bullet>Gains a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RiverConcept]River[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Loses [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept]Ashlands[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChasmConcept]Chasm[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingWarConcept.name: War
GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingWarConcept.description:
A state of War with a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DwellingConcept]Dwelling[/hyperlink] means that [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink] can engage in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] can be attacked.

During war, Dwellings will occasionally send armies to attack their enemies.

Wars end through defeat on either side or by negotiating peace.

GLOBAL.ShopStructureConcept.name: Shop Structure
GLOBAL.ShopStructureConcept.description:
Shops are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LocationConcept]Locations[/hyperlink] that can appear randomly in your domain as you play. In return for [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink], they can give you access to many unique bonuses—such as new mounts and skills for your heroes, or information on the whereabouts of your foes.

You can use any shop within your domain immediately, if the shop is outside your domain you will need to move an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Army[/hyperlink] onto it to unlock it. Once unlocked, you can access the shop without your army being present.

You may choose to attack the shop if you wish—you will gain valuable rewards if you win, but don't expect your custom to be welcome if you do not!

GLOBAL.LandmarkConcept.name: Landmark
GLOBAL.LandmarkConcept.description:
Landmarks are a type of location the size of an entire region. Landmarks themselves cannot be annexed or claimed. Instead, landmarks grant effects to all adjacent [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink].

If a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] has a certain amount of provinces in their domain adjacent to one Landmark, they gain an additional bonus effect depending on the type of landmark.

Landmarks count as [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HandcraftedRegionConcept]Handcrafted Regions[/hyperlink], meaning they can be disabled with the Untouched Realm Trait.

GLOBAL.FireGiantKingConcept.name: Fire Giant King
GLOBAL.FireGiantKingConcept.description:
A searing Giant who cleaves realms by molding lava.
Capital city starts with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.WIZARD_TOWER_ITEM_FORGE]Wizard Tower: Item Forge[/hyperlink].Has the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.LAVA_FLOW]Summon Lava Runestele[/hyperlink] spell.Can build [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FarmConcept]Farms[/hyperlink] on Ashlands.Provinces with Lava or Lava Chasms provide +2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] and don't apply the extra [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] penalty normally found in these.Giant Kings are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_GIANT_GOVERNOR_FIRE]Giant King Governors[/hyperlink].Giant Kings have a 5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink] and cannot equip Mount items.

GLOBAL.FrostGiantKingConcept.name: Frost Giant King
GLOBAL.FrostGiantKingConcept.description:
An icy Giant who freezes realms by shaping glaciers.
Capital city starts with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.WIZARD_TOWER_ITEM_FORGE]Wizard Tower: Item Forge[/hyperlink].Has the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SUMMON_ICE_RUNESTELE]Summon Ice Runestele[/hyperlink] spell.Can build [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FarmConcept]Farms[/hyperlink] on Snow.Provinces with Snow or Ice provide +2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].Giant Kings are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_GIANT_GOVERNOR_FROST]Giant King Governors[/hyperlink].Giant Kings have a 5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink] and cannot equip Mount items.

GLOBAL.StoneGiantKingConcept.name: Rock Giant King
GLOBAL.StoneGiantKingConcept.description:
An adamant Giant who sculpts realms by raising mountains.
Capital city starts with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.WIZARD_TOWER_ITEM_FORGE]Wizard Tower: Item Forge[/hyperlink].Has the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SHAPE_ROCK]Summon Rock Runestele[/hyperlink] spell.Provinces with Mountains or Stalagmites provide +2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink].Giant Kings are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_GIANT_GOVERNOR_ROCK]Giant King Governors[/hyperlink].Giant Kings have a 5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink] and cannot equip Mount items.

GLOBAL.StormGiantKingConcept.name: Storm Giant King
GLOBAL.StormGiantKingConcept.description:
A thunderous Giant who levels realms by flattening peaks.
Capital city starts with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.WIZARD_TOWER_ITEM_FORGE]Wizard Tower: Item Forge[/hyperlink].Has the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ABRADE_MOUNTAIN]Summon Storm Runestele[/hyperlink] spell.Provinces with Rivers or Water provide +2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink] and +1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].Giant Kings are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_GIANT_GOVERNOR]Giant King Governors[/hyperlink].Giant Kings have a 5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink] and cannot equip Mount items.

GLOBAL.FavoredTerrainConcept.name: Favored Terrain
GLOBAL.FavoredTerrainConcept.description: The Primal culture gains various bonuses from its favored terrain:<bulletlist><bullet>Their Primal Animal gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FRENZY]Frenzy[/hyperlink] in their favored terrain.</bullet><bullet>Extra income is earned from provinces in favored terrain.</bullet><bullet>The Spirit Temple structure can alter provinces into favored terrain.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.CataclysmVictoryConcept.name: Cataclysm Victory
GLOBAL.CataclysmVictoryConcept.description:
To achieve the Cataclysm Victory, explore the Echoes of the Fracturing searching for the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArtifactConcept]Artifacts[/hyperlink] of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnmakersLoreConcept]Unmakers[/hyperlink] within Fated Regions.

Acquire 3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArtifactConcept]Artifacts[/hyperlink] to claim victory.

GLOBAL.ScavengerLootConcept.name: Loot
GLOBAL.ScavengerLootConcept.description:
Can be picked up by any unit with the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SCAVENGER]Scavenger[/hyperlink] property by moving onto this hex.
On pickup, the unit:Gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LOOTED_POWER]Looted Power[/hyperlink].Heals for +15 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept] Hit Point[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.NomadConcept.name: Nomad
GLOBAL.NomadConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Mobile units that focus on maneuvering and flanking.</bullet><bullet>Nomad Cities are able to pack up into a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NomadSettlerConcept]Nomad City Barge[/hyperlink] and relocate.</bullet><bullet>Nodes in domain of their Cities are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OverharvestingConcept]Overharvested[/hyperlink] over time, exhausting the Nodes to gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EssenceConcept]Essence[/hyperlink] in that city.</bullet><bullet>Nomad Cities require 50% more <food></food> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink] to gain <population></population> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.AggressiveExpansionConcept.name: Aggressive Expansion
GLOBAL.AggressiveExpansionConcept.description:
Aggressive Expansion rewards [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceAnnexationConcept]Province Annexation[/hyperlink] of provinces belonging to other factions.

Annexing a hostile province to a city grants a one time reward of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitProductionConcept]Draft[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink].

These rewards scale with the population of the city the province was taken from.

GLOBAL.EssenceConcept.name: Essence
GLOBAL.EssenceConcept.description:
Essences are magical objects tied to a city, granting income and other bonuses. They are obtained by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OverharvestingConcept]Overharvesting[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NodeConcept]Resource Nodes[/hyperlink] with a Nomad City.
The type of income an essence gives depends on the node they come from.Essences from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Materials[/hyperlink] grant that material to the city's owner.If a city carrying [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Material[/hyperlink] essences is razed, those [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Materials[/hyperlink] will appear as nodes nearby.
Nomads of the Scavenger tradition also gain unique Essences with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WonderScavengingConcept]Wonder Scavenging[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.OverharvestingConcept.name: Overharvesting
GLOBAL.OverharvestingConcept.description:
Nomad [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] Overharvest [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NodeConcept]Resource Nodes[/hyperlink] in their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink]. This process takes several turns but may be accelerated using [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink] proportionate to the time remaining on that particular Node.

Once Overharvested:The City gains an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EssenceConcept]Essence[/hyperlink] corresponding to that Node.The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NodeConcept]Resource Node[/hyperlink] is destroyed, becoming a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RuinedNodeConcept]Ruined Node[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.NomadSettlerConcept.name: Nomad City Barge
GLOBAL.NomadSettlerConcept.description:
Nomad [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] may pack up into a City Barge, a unit that can move around on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink].

This unit:Can Unpack into a Nomad [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink], able to immediately claim [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] as its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] allows.Can place any [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpecialImprovementConcept]Special Province Improvements[/hyperlink] it had before being packed up for free.Does not participate in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink] and is defeated immediately if not defended by other friendly units.Combat against this unit will take place on the Siege city defense map with all City Defense structures present.
If this unit is defeated in combat, it may be captured by the victor or immediately [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_RAZED]Razed[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.WonderScavengingConcept.name: Wonder Scavenging
GLOBAL.WonderScavengingConcept.description:
When an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonder[/hyperlink] is annexed to a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] belonging to Nomad Scavengers, it will be [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OverharvestingConcept]Overharvested[/hyperlink], granting the city a unique [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EssenceConcept]Essence[/hyperlink].

Overharvesting Ancient Wonders:Does not destroy the Ancient Wonder.Can only be done once per Ancient Wonder.
The type of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EssenceConcept]Essence[/hyperlink] gained is based on the Improvement type and Tier of the Ancient Wonder.

GLOBAL.RoamingCityConcept.name: Roaming City Income
GLOBAL.RoamingCityConcept.description: Roaming City Income is the amount of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResourceConcept]Resources[/hyperlink] a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NomadSettlerConcept]Nomad City Barge[/hyperlink] generates each <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] while packed up.

GLOBAL.SandstormConcept.name: Sandstorm
GLOBAL.SandstormConcept.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex:<bulletlist><bullet>Have a base 60% chance of becoming [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BLINDED]Blind[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SLOWED]Slowed[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>Units with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SAND_WALK]Sand Walk[/hyperlink] are immune to this effect.

GLOBAL.BackfireConcept.name: Spell Backfiring
GLOBAL.BackfireConcept.description:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] may have a chance of backfiring.

When a spell can backfire, the chance is displayed in the casting menu. Upon casting the spell, you will be informed if the spell backfired or not. When a spell does not backfire, the spell is resolved as normal and nothing else happens.

When a spell backfires, its original effects are still resolved, but additional effects are added to the spell. These additional effects are random and usually affect the targets of the original spell.

For example: When a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HealingSpellConcept]Healing Spell[/hyperlink] backfires, it could have the additional effect of teleporting the unit that was healed up to 3 hexes away from its location.

GLOBAL.BackfireTailwindsConcept.name: Backfire Tailwind
GLOBAL.BackfireTailwindsConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>When a healing or buffing spell [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BackfireConcept]Backfires[/hyperlink] for this player, it always triggers a positive effect.</bullet><bullet>When a damaging or debuffing spell [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BackfireConcept]Backfires[/hyperlink] for this player, it always triggers a negative effect for the enemy.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.ShroudedIsleConcept.name: Shrouded Isle
GLOBAL.ShroudedIsleConcept.description: A shrouded isle is a handcrafted region which:<bulletlist><bullet>Is only accessible through a portal on Surface or Underground.</bullet><bullet>These portals must be uncovered through a quest.</bullet><bullet>These portals are guarded by inhabitants.</bullet><bullet>Contains a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.SHROUDED_ARCANUM]Shrouded Arcanum[/hyperlink]. Which unlocks a Secret [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spell[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Contains other valuable [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LocationConcept]Locations[/hyperlink] in the region which are not guarded by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MarauderConcept]Marauder[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.BreachedIsleConcept.name: Breached Isle
GLOBAL.BreachedIsleConcept.description: A breached isle is a handcrafted region which:<bulletlist><bullet>Is only accessible through a portal on Surface or Underground.</bullet><bullet>These portals are accessible at the start and are not guarded.</bullet><bullet>Contains a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.BREACHED_ARCANUM]Breached Arcanum[/hyperlink] and various other valuable [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LocationConcept]Locations[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.BloodDrainConcept.name: Blood Drain
GLOBAL.BloodDrainConcept.description: The blood draining abilities of a Vampire: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DRAINING_BITE]Draining Bite[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SIPHON_BLOOD]Siphon Blood[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.CrimsonCourtMagistrateConcept.name: Crimson Court Magistrate
GLOBAL.CrimsonCourtMagistrateConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Gain 50 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] on successfully [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PillagingConcept]Pillaging[/hyperlink] a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvement[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Gain 50 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] on successfully [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RazingConcept]Razing[/hyperlink] a conquered [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] per <population></population> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvement[/hyperlink] that hasn't been Pillaged.</bullet><bullet>Gain 30 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] on successfully [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MigratingConcept]Migrating[/hyperlink] a conquered [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] per <population></population> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink]. But the City loses additional <population></population> Population afterward.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEVassalConcept]Vassals[/hyperlink] grant 10 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] income per <population></population> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SunlessConcept.name: Sunless
GLOBAL.SunlessConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink]

The absence of sunlight has spread thorny and dark flora dotted with crimson roses.
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] annexing this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] suffer -5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink].[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] regenerate -5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept] Hit Points[/hyperlink] per [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink].[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] receive 25% less [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept] Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink] when healed in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink].Units and Cities that have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEARTLESS]Heartless[/hyperlink] or are of an empire led by a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.VampireLordConcept]Elder Vampire[/hyperlink] are immune to these effects.

GLOBAL.VampireLordConcept.name: Elder Vampire
GLOBAL.VampireLordConcept.description:
A deathless Vampire who drains the life from enemies under cover of night.
An [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UNDEAD]Undead[/hyperlink] unit with an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUNLIGHT_WEAKNESS]aversion to light[/hyperlink].Has access to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.LORD_CASTLE_FOUNDATION]Vampire Castle: Foundation[/hyperlink] which replaces the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.WIZARD_TOWER_FOUNDATION]Wizard Tower: Foundation[/hyperlink] and grants the use of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThrallConcept]Thralls[/hyperlink] to cast powerful ritual [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink].Drains 20% of the combat [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept] Experience[/hyperlink] earned by Turned Vampire heroes.Faction is immune to Sunless terrain's penalties to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink].Elder Vampires are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_VAMPIRE_GOVERNOR]Elder Vampire Governors[/hyperlink].Elder Vampires have a 5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.DevotionConcept.name: Devotion
GLOBAL.DevotionConcept.description:
Reflects how devoted to its oath your empire is based on its actions. Devotion influences:The strength of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HARMONIZE]Harmonize[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.NOBILITY]Nobility[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WARRIORS_SOUL]Warrior's Soul[/hyperlink] culture unit abilities. [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in your cities.
Levels of Devotion:120 to 130: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.Devotion3Concept]Paragon[/hyperlink]70 to 119: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.Devotion2Concept]Devotee[/hyperlink]20 to 69: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.Devotion1Concept]Adherent[/hyperlink]0 to 19: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.Devotion0Concept]Neutral[/hyperlink]-1 to -40: {GLOBAL.Devotion-1Concept.Hyperlink}

GLOBAL.MistConcept.name: Mist
GLOBAL.MistConcept.description: Units that end their turn on this hex gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CLINGING_MIST]Clinging Mist[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.CataclysmConcept.name: Cataclysm
GLOBAL.CataclysmConcept.description:
A Cataclysm can trigger due to the Devouring Winds. When it triggers:
All provinces that were marked are struck:If a structure is present in the center of the province, it is destroyed or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PillagingConcept]Pillaged[/hyperlink].A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.FLEETING_FRACTURED_INFESTATION]Fleeting Fractured Infestation[/hyperlink] is placed in the center of the province if able.The province is no longer marked.All [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] permanently gain +10% chance of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BackfireConcept]Backfiring[/hyperlink].All [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink] gain a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievance[/hyperlink] against the Empire that triggered the Cataclysm.The Cataclysm Meter is reset and its level increases by 1.

GLOBAL.FortificationDamageConcept.name: Fortification Damage
GLOBAL.FortificationDamageConcept.description:
Fortification Damage represents the speed at which a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeConcept]Siege[/hyperlink] progresses to breach the defenses of a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink]

Fortification Damage is subtracted from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FortificationHealthConcept]Fortification Health[/hyperlink] of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] during a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeConcept]Siege[/hyperlink] until it is reduced to 0.

Fortification Damage in a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeConcept]Siege[/hyperlink] comes from:A base value of 10[hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeProjectConcept]Siege Projects[/hyperlink] the besieger is undertaking.Besieging [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SIEGE_BREAKER]Siege Breaker[/hyperlink] that are adjacent to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.FortificationHealthConcept.name: Fortification Health
GLOBAL.FortificationHealthConcept.description:
Fortification Health represents how long the duration of a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeConcept]Siege[/hyperlink] will be on a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink]. The greater the Fortification Health, the longer the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeConcept]Siege[/hyperlink] will take.

During a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeConcept]Siege[/hyperlink], the besieger will try and reduce the City's Fortification Health to 0 by dealing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FortificationDamageConcept]Fortification Damage[/hyperlink]. Fortification Health cannot increase during a Siege.

[hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityDefenseStructureConcept]City Defense Structures[/hyperlink] are the primary source of Fortification Health.

A City with Fortification Health still requires any Wall structure to be present before a siege is required.

GLOBAL.AlignmentAgendaConcept.name: Alignment Agenda
GLOBAL.AlignmentAgendaConcept.description:
The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HighConcept]High[/hyperlink] Culture has an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept]Alignment[/hyperlink] Agenda, which grants bonuses for the following alignment levels:
Slightly Good: +10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] income in all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink]. Very Good: +20 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] income in all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink]. Pure Good: +30 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] income in all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink]. Slightly Evil: +10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] income in all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink]. Very Evil: +20 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] income in all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink]. Pure Evil: +30 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] income in all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept.name: Alignment
GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept.description:
Determines how [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] and other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink] see you. Affected by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] traits and various actions.

Affects relations with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink] with Neutral or better Alignment. In addition a Good Alignment (or better) will increase the chance of positive random events occurring, while an Evil Alignment (or worse) will make negative random events more likely.

[hyperlink,GLOBAL.HighConcept]High[/hyperlink] Culture has an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AlignmentAgendaConcept]Alignment Agenda[/hyperlink].

[hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept]Empire Relations[/hyperlink] for each Alignment level: {PureGoodMinValue} to {PureGoodMaxValue}: Pure Good: {PureGoodRelationValue} {VeryGoodMinValue} to {VeryGoodMaxValue}: Very Good: {VeryGoodRelationValue} {GoodMinValue} to {GoodMaxValue}: Good: {GoodRelationValue} {NeutralMaxValue} to {NeutralMinValue}: Neutral: No effects{EvilMaxValue} to {EvilMinValue}: Evil: {EvilRelationValue} {VeryEvilMaxValue} to {VeryEvilMinValue}: Very Evil: {VeryEvilRelationValue} {PureEvilMaxValue} to {PureEvilMinValue}: Pure Evil: {PureEvilRelationValue}

GLOBAL.CompetitorConcept.name: Competitor
GLOBAL.CompetitorConcept.description:
Competitors are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] that have at least negotiated a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfCooperationConcept]Pact of Cooperation[/hyperlink] with a Free City and are actively negotiating with that City.

Competing Rulers will receive a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievance[/hyperlink] against a Ruler that [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEVassalConcept]vassalizes[/hyperlink] their desired city.

GLOBAL.DwellingConcept.name: Dwellings
GLOBAL.DwellingConcept.description:
Dwellings are independent [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] that usually have unique ways to influence and offer unique benefits.

Like [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] they:Have a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FreeCityLordConcept]Free City Lord[/hyperlink].Have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEDiplStateConcept]diplomatic standings[/hyperlink] with you that can be improved.Do not belong to an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink].
Dwellings are not affected by Realm Traits or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] that affect Free Cities.

GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept.name: Empire Relations
GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept.description:
Represents the degree to which two [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink] are on good terms with one another.

Good Empire Relations are required to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeConcept]negotiate[/hyperlink] a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MutualConsulateConcept]Wizard's Bond[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TreatyConcept]Treaties[/hyperlink]. Eventually good relations can lead to an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DSAllianceConcept]Alliance[/hyperlink].

Bad Empire Relations increase the chance of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink] being declared.

Empire Relations can be improved by:High [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept]Alignment[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.PronouncementsConcept]Pronouncements[/hyperlink]Gifts[hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeConcept]Trades[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept.name: Free City
GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept.description:
Free Cities are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] that do not belong to an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink]. They have a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FreeCityLordConcept]Free City Lord[/hyperlink] with whom it is possible to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept]negotiate[/hyperlink].

With a higher [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEDiplStateConcept]Diplomatic State[/hyperlink], a Free City offers:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityTradeConcept]Trading[/hyperlink]. [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RecruitmentPointsConcept]Recruitment Points[/hyperlink] for the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].Shared Income.
When an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] reaches the highest [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEDiplStateConcept]Diplomatic State[/hyperlink] with a Free City, the city may become part of that empire through a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfIntegrationConcept]Pact of Integration[/hyperlink]. Alternatively [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityWarConcept]War[/hyperlink] may be declared to acquire the Free City through conquest.

GLOBAL.FreeCityLordConcept.name: Free City Lord
GLOBAL.FreeCityLordConcept.description:
A Free City Lord or Lady is the designated ruler of a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink]. They represent their Free City in all diplomatic interactions with an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] and fight for their city as [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Heroes[/hyperlink] on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink].

When the Free City Lord dies (and their Free City has not been conquered or integrated) they will be replaced by their heir, who will become the new Free City Lord after 3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink]. The free city will not be able to cast [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpellConcept]Combat Spell[/hyperlink] until this has happened.

GLOBAL.PvEDiplStateConcept.name: Free City Diplomatic State
GLOBAL.PvEDiplStateConcept.description:
The diplomatic state with a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] is the formal expression of their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept] Allegiance[/hyperlink]. A newly met [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] will be on [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityNeutralConcept]neutral terms[/hyperlink] with an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] (in some cases [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityWarConcept]War[/hyperlink] is declared instantly). By sending their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FreeCityLordConcept]Free City Lord[/hyperlink] a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DiplomaticTokenConcept]Whispering Stone[/hyperlink], the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept] Allegiance[/hyperlink] of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] with that [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] will improve over time.

Higher [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept] Allegiance[/hyperlink] leads to better diplomatic states with more valuable benefits. This [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept]negotiation process[/hyperlink] is divided into the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegotiationPhaseConcept]Negotiation Phase[/hyperlink] and the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.VassalagePhaseConcept]Vassalage Phase[/hyperlink], which eventually leads to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfIntegrationConcept]Pact of Integration[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.IndependentCityRelationConcept.name: Free City relations
GLOBAL.IndependentCityRelationConcept.description: Relations with a <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] represent their opinion of a Ruler. The relation value can affect the amount of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept]<allegiance></allegiance> Allegiance[/hyperlink] gained during [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept]Negotiations[/hyperlink] and with very low relations the free city may also declare <rs_war></rs_war> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityWarConcept]War[/hyperlink] when on the <rs_neutral></rs_neutral> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityNeutralConcept]Neutral[/hyperlink] diplomatic state.

GLOBAL.IndependentCityTradeConcept.name: Free City Trade
GLOBAL.IndependentCityTradeConcept.description:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] may be asked to focus on a particular resource by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] that share at least a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfCooperationConcept]Pact of Cooperation[/hyperlink] with the City.

They may also provide any [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Materials[/hyperlink] located in the domain of the city in exchange for payment.

A Free City will only agree to one active trade at a time, after the trade has expired a new trade can be made.

GLOBAL.IndependentCityWarConcept.name: War with a Free City
GLOBAL.IndependentCityWarConcept.description:
A state of War with a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] means that [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink] can engage in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] can be attacked.

During war, Free Cities will occasionally send armies to attack their enemies.

Wars end through defeat on either side or by negotiating peace.

GLOBAL.NegotiationsCollectedConcept.name: Negotiation
GLOBAL.NegotiationsCollectedConcept.description: There are two different types of negotiations:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeConcept]Negotiations[/hyperlink] between [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept]Negotiations[/hyperlink] between Rulers and <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept.name: Negotiation with Free City
GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept.description:
Negotiations increase the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept] Allegiance[/hyperlink] of a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] leading to better [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEDiplStateConcept]Diplomatic States[/hyperlink] with an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink].

Negotiations happen automatically when a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DiplomaticTokenConcept]Whispering Stone[/hyperlink] is assigned or the city is [hyperlink,GLOBAL.VassalagePhaseConcept]vassalized[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.TradeConcept.name: Negotiation
GLOBAL.TradeConcept.description: Negotiations allow Rulers to exchange strategic resources, locations and contact information among other things, but it also allows them to manage their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept]relations[/hyperlink] and establish new [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TreatyConcept]Treaties[/hyperlink] and diplomatic states.

GLOBAL.WarConcept.name: War
GLOBAL.WarConcept.description:
A state of War with an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] means their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink] can engage in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] can be attacked.

Wars end through defeat on either side or peacefully when:Two Empires [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeConcept]negotiate[/hyperlink] a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TruceConcept]Truce[/hyperlink].By negotiating [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityNeutralConcept]Peace[/hyperlink] with a Free City.
Defeat occurs when one side loses its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept]Throne City[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.ResearchConcept.name: Research
GLOBAL.ResearchConcept.description: Research is where <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink] is spent to unlock items from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TomeConcept]Tomes[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept.name: Enchantments and Single Shot Attacks
GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept.description:
Damage and chance-based effects from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitEnchantmentConcept]Unit Enchantments[/hyperlink] and Hero Skills have increased potency on Single Shot attacks, like [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BASE_MELEE_CHARGE]Flyby Melee Charge[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BASE_MAGIC_BLAST]Magic Blast[/hyperlink].

Usually flat damage values are doubled, and the chances of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept]Negative Status Effects[/hyperlink] are increased by 30%

GLOBAL.AstralBoonConcept.name: Astral Boon
GLOBAL.AstralBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the Astral forces strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in all of your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Astral Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.ChaosBoonConcept.name: Chaos Boon
GLOBAL.ChaosBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the forces of Chaos strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in all of your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Chaos Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.MateriumBoonConcept.name: Materium Boon
GLOBAL.MateriumBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the forces of Materium strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in all of your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Materium Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.NatureBoonConcept.name: Nature Boon
GLOBAL.NatureBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the forces of Nature strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in all of your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Nature Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.OrderBoonConcept.name: Order Boon
GLOBAL.OrderBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the forces of Order strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in all of your cities.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Order Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.ShadowBoonConcept.name: Shadow Boon
GLOBAL.ShadowBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the forces of Shadow strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in all of your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Shadow Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.AffinityCheckConcept.name: Affinity Check
GLOBAL.AffinityCheckConcept.description:
When the empire of a player has reached a high enough [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink] score, this can unlock special character actions in story events. Within those actions the player Ruler or one of their heroes attempts to channel the respective [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink] to perform a challenging action.

Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink] check has a strength X, which determines how the option behaves:

The option is hidden as long as the empire [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink] is lower than X.50% base chance to succeed when the empire [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink] is exactly X.This chance increases by 10% for every Empire [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink] Point above X.

GLOBAL.AstralCrisisConcept.name: Astral Crisis
GLOBAL.AstralCrisisConcept.description:
Your struggle with the Astral forces weakens your rule, temporarily decreasing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in all of your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Astral Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.ChaosCrisisConcept.name: Chaos Crisis
GLOBAL.ChaosCrisisConcept.description:
Your struggle with the forces of Chaos weakens your rule, temporarily decreasing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in all of your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Chaos Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.MateriumCrisisConcept.name: Materium Crisis
GLOBAL.MateriumCrisisConcept.description:
Your struggle with the forces of Materium weakens your rule, temporarily decreasing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in all of your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Materium Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.NatureCrisisConcept.name: Nature Crisis
GLOBAL.NatureCrisisConcept.description:
Your struggle with the forces of Nature weakens your rule, temporarily decreasing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in all of your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Nature Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.OrderCrisisConcept.name: Order Crisis
GLOBAL.OrderCrisisConcept.description:
Your struggle with the forces of Order weakens your rule, temporarily decreasing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in all of your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Order Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.BattleQuestConcept.name: Battle Quest
GLOBAL.BattleQuestConcept.description: Battle Quests ask you to defeat an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Army[/hyperlink] of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MarauderConcept]Marauder[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink]. They may only be resolved through [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink] and will fail when another non-ally [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PlayerConcept]Player[/hyperlink] defeats the quest army.

GLOBAL.BefriendCityQuestConcept.name: Befriend City Quest
GLOBAL.BefriendCityQuestConcept.description: Befriend City Quests ask you to reach a higher diplomatic state with a <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink]. This can be achieved by giving that Free City a <whisperingStone></whisperingStone> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DiplomaticTokenConcept]Whispering Stone[/hyperlink] and improving their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept]<allegiance></allegiance> Allegiance[/hyperlink] with you over time. If the Free City becomes [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEVassalConcept]vassalized[/hyperlink] or conquered by another [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PlayerConcept]Player[/hyperlink], the quest will fail.

GLOBAL.BuildImprovementQuestConcept.name: Build Improvement Quest
GLOBAL.BuildImprovementQuestConcept.description: Build Improvement Quests ask you to construct a number of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvements[/hyperlink] of a certain type. You can build a Province Improvement whenever one of your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] grows new <population></population> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink]. When you dismantle a Province Improvement of the matching type this will subtract progress from the quest.

GLOBAL.ConquerCityQuestConcept.name: Conquer City Quest
GLOBAL.ConquerCityQuestConcept.description: Conquer City quests ask you to conquer a <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink]. This requires you to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityWarConcept]declare war[/hyperlink] on that Free City and may involve a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeConcept]Siege[/hyperlink] if there are any [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityDefenseStructureConcept]City Defense Structures[/hyperlink]. If the Free City becomes conquered by another [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PlayerConcept]Player[/hyperlink] (even an ally) the quest will fail.

GLOBAL.DestroyInfestationQuestConcept.name: Destroy Infestation Quest
GLOBAL.DestroyInfestationQuestConcept.description: Destroy Infestation quests ask you to destroy an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestation[/hyperlink] on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink]. Beware of the roaming [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink] inside the Infestation's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink]! If the Infestation is destroyed by another non-ally [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PlayerConcept]Player[/hyperlink] the quest will fail.

GLOBAL.EncounterQuestConcept.name: Encounter Quest
GLOBAL.EncounterQuestConcept.description: Encounter Quests ask you to deal with an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Army[/hyperlink] of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MarauderConcept]Marauder[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink]. When engaging the quest army, there will be narrative choices that may alter [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink] in your favor or even completely avoid it for a price.

GLOBAL.MagicMaterialQuestConcept.name: Magic Material Quest
GLOBAL.MagicMaterialQuestConcept.description: Magic Material Quests ask you to obtain a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Material[/hyperlink]. This can be either achieved by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceAnnexationConcept]annexing[/hyperlink] a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] with a Magic Material Node in its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink] or by acquiring the Magic Material through a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityTradeConcept]trade[/hyperlink] with a <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PlayerConcept]Player[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PrimalCheckConcept.name: Primal Check
GLOBAL.PrimalCheckConcept.description:
When a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]monster ruler[/hyperlink] has reached a high enough [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept] Level[/hyperlink], this can unlock special character actions in story events. Within those actions, the player ruler attempts to channel their primal powers to perform a challenging action.

Each Primal Check has a strength X, which determines how the option behaves:

The option is hidden as long as the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept] Ruler Level[/hyperlink] is lower than X.50% base chance of success when the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept] Ruler Level[/hyperlink] is exactly X.This chance increases by +10% for every [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept] Ruler Level[/hyperlink] above X.

GLOBAL.ExpansionVictoryConcept.name: Expansion Victory
GLOBAL.ExpansionVictoryConcept.description:
To achieve an Expansion Victory, an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] needs to control enough provinces to unlock the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.BEACONOFUNITY] Beacons of Unity[/hyperlink]. After building three beacons in different cities, you can light the Beacons, during which hostile armies are spawned in an attempt to destroy them. If you can defend the Beacons for 15 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], you will be victorious.

Provinces count when they belong to your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] directly, or when they belong to your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] with at least a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl1Concept]Bonded Vassalage[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.ResourceConcept.name: Resource
GLOBAL.ResourceConcept.description: Resources are used to pay for various actions and are primarily obtained in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink]. Some resources can only be spent in the city itself, whereas other resources can be used everywhere.

GLOBAL.VisitSiteConcept.name: Visit Site
GLOBAL.VisitSiteConcept.description:
Visit Sites are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LocationConcept]Locations[/hyperlink] that grant benefits by visiting them with an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Army[/hyperlink]. Unlike most Locations, they are not protected by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MarauderConcept]Marauders[/hyperlink].
Some Visit Sites will show a button to press when having them selected and occupied by one of your Armies in order to activate the benefits. They will then grant buffs to the Army currently occupying the Visit Site.

GLOBAL.AffinitiesLoreConcept.name: Magic Affinities
GLOBAL.AffinitiesLoreConcept.description:
The six affinities are the cosmic forces that shape and define all that exists. [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OrderConcept]Order[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NatureConcept]Nature[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowConcept]Shadow[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MateriumConcept]Materium[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralConcept]Astral[/hyperlink] are the powers that encompass the cosmos, each vastly different in its domain, applications and nature. When channeling magic, the aspects of these cosmic forces will be invoked.

The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] are dedicated to studying the six affinities in order to harness their powers to the greatest effect. Their findings are inscribed in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TomeLoreConcept]Tome[/hyperlink], true testaments to the godly ambitions of their authors.

GLOBAL.AllfatherLoreConcept.name: Allfather
GLOBAL.AllfatherLoreConcept.description:
The "Allfather" is one of the names given to a supreme being shrouded in mystery. Worshiped as a force of creation, they are known by many different identities throughout the cosmos. Some say they shaped the mythical [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TheWellLoreConcept]Well of Creation[/hyperlink] while others believe that the being and the Well form a holy duality that cannot be separated.

The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink] have spread the faith of the "Allfather" to many [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds[/hyperlink], the being's manifestation morphing toward the perception of the various races. While the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink] claim to be the "Allfather's" celestial servants, there are no trustworthy sources that would demonstrate the being's intentions or any will to interfere with the dealings of mortals.

GLOBAL.AncientKrazuraLoreConcept.name: Ancient Krazura
GLOBAL.AncientKrazuraLoreConcept.description:
In ages past, long before the rise of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] on [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagehavenLoreConcept]Magehaven[/hyperlink], the Ancient Krazura were the sages of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink], knowledgeable and gifted in the arcane unlike any others. Their counsel and magecraft was sought by many, above all by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink] who grew to depend on the Ancient Krazura during the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EndailonCrisisLoreConcept]Endailon Crisis[/hyperlink]. Together they devised the Vaultsphere, the World Seals and eventually [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GrexolisLoreConcept]Grexolis[/hyperlink], bringing an end to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EndailonCrisisLoreConcept]Endailon Crisis[/hyperlink] and largely restoring Archon order on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds Within[/hyperlink].

Around that time, however, the Ancient Krazura mysteriously vanished and any record of their civilization and works became lost in the ages to follow. Only after the opening of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GrexolisLoreConcept]Grexolis[/hyperlink] and the return of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EndailonLoreConcept]Endailon[/hyperlink] is their history and heritage being rediscovered.

GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept.name: Archons
GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept.description: The Archons believe they were created by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AllfatherLoreConcept]Allfather[/hyperlink] himself as the first sentient race, and tasked with advancing his works of creation. Through the ages, they have proudly called themselves the Allfather's divine guardians against evil, protecting new [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds[/hyperlink] from the dangers of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink]. However, in recent ages they have withdrawn from many Worlds and only rarely seek contact with the non-celestial races.

GLOBAL.ArchvampireLoreConcept.name: Archvampire
GLOBAL.ArchvampireLoreConcept.description: A myth even among Vampires themselves, the Archvampires are said to have been bitten by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrvatoghLoreConcept]Deathless God[/hyperlink], the very first Vampire to roam the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds Within[/hyperlink]. They are ancient and proud, dismissing the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ElderVampireLoreConcept]Elder Vampires[/hyperlink] that sprang from their own fangs. Or so it is told in the tales of the Crimson Reign. Yet the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrvatoghLoreConcept]Deathless God[/hyperlink], his dominion and consorts all vanished in the mists of time.

GLOBAL.AscendedChampLoreConcept.name: Ascended Champion
GLOBAL.AscendedChampLoreConcept.description: Ascended Champions are mortals who joined the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PantheonLoreConcept]Pantheon of Godir[/hyperlink] at [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagehavenLoreConcept]Magehaven[/hyperlink] through their mastery of the arcane arts. They bear resemblance to their mortal origins and have a close connection with and understanding of the people they rule.

GLOBAL.AstralFlowsLoreConcept.name: Astral Flows
GLOBAL.AstralFlowsLoreConcept.description: The Astral Flows are the magical currents within the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink] that connect all worlds and living beings. Where these flows breach the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]material realm[/hyperlink] they consolidate their magic into Mana Nodes. Here, magic users can tap into the flow to power their spells. Powerful beings may enter the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink] through these breaches to follow the Astral Flows to other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]worlds[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept.name: Astral Sea
GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept.description:
The Astral Sea is the primal source of arcane powers, a vast aetherial ocean containing and connecting the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds Within[/hyperlink]. This ocean ebbs and flows, pushes and pulls, seeps into the material world through Mana Nodes. It contains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralDwellersLoreConcept]beings of pure magical energy[/hyperlink] such as the Node Serpent and is traversed by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SoulsLoreConcept]souls of the dead[/hyperlink] on their final journey to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TheWellLoreConcept]the Well[/hyperlink].

Powerful mages may follow the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralFlowsLoreConcept]Astral Flows[/hyperlink] to travel between worlds, but it is a dangerous journey where they may be lured away into the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralVoidLoreConcept]Astral Void[/hyperlink] or become a victim of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralMonstersLoreConcept]Astral Sea Monsters[/hyperlink]. A much safer method involves the use of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldGateLoreConcept]World Gates[/hyperlink], which however require great knowledge and skill to be created or used.

GLOBAL.AstralDwellersLoreConcept.name: Astral Sea Dwellers
GLOBAL.AstralDwellersLoreConcept.description: Though alien to most visitors from the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds Within[/hyperlink], the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink] is not empty or dead. In between its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralFlowsLoreConcept]Astral Flows[/hyperlink], an entire ecosystem thrives, where creatures and plants intertwine with the arcane energy as it ebbs and flows. Natural predators and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralMonstersLoreConcept]Monsters[/hyperlink] roam the astral depths, while lone wanderers of the ancient [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MaerLoreConcept]Maer[/hyperlink] bear rare witness to a once great civilization.

GLOBAL.AstralMonstersLoreConcept.name: Astral Sea Monsters
GLOBAL.AstralMonstersLoreConcept.description: Astral Sea Monsters are denizens of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink]. These mana-hungry creatures come in a variety of shapes, from the jellyfish like Astral Syphoner to the horrifically tragic [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LostWizardLoreConcept]Lost Wizard[/hyperlink]. They are all designed to thrive in the harsh environment of the Astral Sea, with many leeching life from any traveler caught unaware. However, not all Astral Sea creatures are malevolent, as the gentle [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MaerLoreConcept]Maer[/hyperlink] are prove.

GLOBAL.AstralVoidLoreConcept.name: Astral Void
GLOBAL.AstralVoidLoreConcept.description: Beyond the reach of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink] lies the Astral Void, a place where the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralFlowsLoreConcept]Astral Flows[/hyperlink] do not reach, a place of nothingness. A wizard may be banished and cast into the Void, where they drift around until they either manage to find a flow leading them back to a safe place or succumb to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowTrialLoreConcept]Torment of Shadows[/hyperlink] and perish as one of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LostWizardLoreConcept]Lost Wizards[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.AstralVortexLoreConcept.name: Astral Vortex
GLOBAL.AstralVortexLoreConcept.description: Sometimes the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralFlowsLoreConcept]Astral Flows[/hyperlink] converge into astral vortices, paradoxical culminations of magic energy that bend all meaning of time and space. When entered by beings powerful enough to withstand their shearing forces, they may be used to traverse large distances within the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink]. However, many prefer the use of the much safer—but also rarer—[hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldGateLoreConcept]World Gates[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept.name: Athla
GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept.description: Athla is one of the oldest [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds Within[/hyperlink] the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink] with a potent convergence of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralFlowsLoreConcept]Astral Flows[/hyperlink]. It is the home to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ValleyofWondersLoreConcept]Valley of Wonders[/hyperlink] and Inioch's court. Through the ages Athla has played a pivotal role in events that shaped the cosmos, be it as a realm to conquer, a scene of cosmic battles, or the origin of powerful beings. Many known [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] originate from this world.

GLOBAL.AuldwealdLoreConcept.name: Auldweald
GLOBAL.AuldwealdLoreConcept.description: Auldweald is said to be the original homeworld of the First Elves, from where they first traveled to other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds[/hyperlink] in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink]. Many elven songs idolize its lush valleys and evergreen forests, and it is said that all elven [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SoulsLoreConcept]Souls[/hyperlink] long to return to this world.

GLOBAL.BloodClanLoreConcept.name: Blood Clan
GLOBAL.BloodClanLoreConcept.description: Often looked down on by the other Giant Clans, the Blood Clan is a conglomeration of any breed of Demigiant imaginable. Loosely organized, the trolls and ogres of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds Within[/hyperlink] indulge in their savage hierarchies—where for once no [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantKingLoreConcept]actual Giant[/hyperlink] may boss them around.

GLOBAL.CageOfBindingLoreConcept.name: Cage of Binding
GLOBAL.CageOfBindingLoreConcept.description: For a powerful [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink], who can regularly escape death, there are few things more terrifying than a Cage of Binding. For such an enchanted shell, crafted from rare magic materials, represents the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralVoidLoreConcept]Astral Void[/hyperlink] and an eternity of nothingness. When sealed inside a Cage of Binding, a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] will lose their arcane abilities and is rendered completely helpless. However, capturing a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] inside is no small feat, and only few records in history speak of a wizard unfortunate enough to suffer such a gruesome fate.

GLOBAL.CircleOfDeogaiLoreConcept.name: Circle of Deogai
GLOBAL.CircleOfDeogaiLoreConcept.description:
After the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TheFracturingLoreConcept]terrible disasters[/hyperlink] unleashed by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnmakersLoreConcept]Unmakers[/hyperlink], the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink] began to establish the Circles of Deogai throughout the cosmos. They were councils of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] set on the most disputed worlds, each presided by an Archon arbiter. Through those Circles the Archons fostered stability and monitored the new magics devised by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WizardKingLoreConcept]Wizard Kings[/hyperlink] with a watchful eye.

By the time of the Fourth Age, most Circles of Deogai have either been destroyed or dispersed, and the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] turned to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagehavenLoreConcept]Magehaven[/hyperlink] as their primary forum of council. Yet some Circles are said to still persist, transformed by the ages until they were given new purpose.

GLOBAL.ColtLoreConcept.name: Company of Lost Treasures
GLOBAL.ColtLoreConcept.description: Renowned for their wealth, the Company of Lost Treasures is extending its influence across the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink]. Specialized in hiring and outfitting skilled adventurers, the Company of Lost Treasures is uncovering and plundering the riches of ancient empires, above all from the ruined jewel of Giant kin, [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MyrridaLoreConcept]Myrrida[/hyperlink]. Often accused of shady practices, the officials of the Company have repeatedly proven that their contracts are always honored—one simply must pay attention to all the footnotes.

GLOBAL.CommonwealthLoreConcept.name: Commonwealth
GLOBAL.CommonwealthLoreConcept.description:
The empire of the Commonwealth was initially formed as a joining of races and cultures on [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept]Athla[/hyperlink], aimed at the sharing of knowledge and the mutual protection of all. While these benign precepts held true for a time, ambition and technological advancement soon outgrew the concepts of the original charter, leading to much strife between factions within and without.

When the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldGateLoreConcept]World Gates[/hyperlink] on Athla were reopened the most important figureheads of the Commonwealth, including Edward Portsmith, were defeated or disappeared. In the chaos and under the pressure of returning [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WizardKingLoreConcept]Wizard Kings[/hyperlink], the powerful empire dismantled into factions they once sought to unite.

GLOBAL.CovenantFactionLoreConcept.name: Covenant
GLOBAL.CovenantFactionLoreConcept.description: The Covenant are a faction within the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PantheonLoreConcept]Pantheon of Godir[/hyperlink], who seek to uphold ancient agreements of peace and stability, as written by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink] in ages past. Their lawful tendencies often put them in direct opposition to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadraiFactionLoreConcept]Shad'rai[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.DemonicOverlordLoreConcept.name: Demon Overlord
GLOBAL.DemonicOverlordLoreConcept.description:
Few dare speak of them, lest it invite infernal notice or provoke their wrath. The inscrutable masters of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DemonicPrinceLoreConcept]Demonic Regency[/hyperlink], and of many [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ObbadothLoreConcept]Obbadothan horrors[/hyperlink] besides, Demon Overlords are counted among the mightiest of their kind. Some believe they are ancient fiends ascended through ages of carnage, while others claim they are primordial evils woven into the very fabric of creation.

Whatever their true nature, Demon Overlords are ever eager to bargain. To those deemed worthy, they offer power drawn from the depths of Obbadoth, binding supplicants through pacts both potent and perilous. In this way, they became the unseen architects behind countless infernal covenants that ripple across the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.DemonicPrinceLoreConcept.name: Demonic Prince
GLOBAL.DemonicPrinceLoreConcept.description:
The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ObbadothLoreConcept]Obbadothan Royalty[/hyperlink] are a loose and ever-shifting assembly bound by infernal pacts. Each member has bargained with a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DemonicOverlordLoreConcept]Demon Overlord[/hyperlink], trading autonomy for power. As such, entry into the regency is largely open to anyone, or anything willing to make the trade.

Most infamous among them are the Demonic Princes, who, next to their own sinister ambitions, act as the chief commanders of their Overlord across all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds Within[/hyperlink]. Though ever wary that failure—or maliciously twisted pact clause—might see them swiftly supplanted or dragged down screaming into damnation.

GLOBAL.DragonsLoreConcept.name: Dragons
GLOBAL.DragonsLoreConcept.description:
Dragons are among the first creatures that the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AllfatherLoreConcept]Allfather[/hyperlink] gifted with life. The first of these, known as the Elder Dragons, would utilize their vast intelligence and mastery of the elements to aid the Archons in shaping the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds[/hyperlink] within the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink] as well as in crafting powerful artifacts. In all of this, they would be forced to work alongside the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantsLoreConcept]Giants[/hyperlink], which led to much conflict.

Dragons come in three forms: firstly, the Elder Dragons who were born at the beginning of creation and on occasion ascend to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godirhood[/hyperlink] through their primal mastery of the arcane arts. Secondly, their offspring, the more common Dragons. Lastly, the far younger and less sophisticated Wyverns, who were hatched in ages since that primordial time. Beyond that, Dragons come in myriad types that are mostly associated with a different element, and some have even been raised as undead versions of their previous selves.

GLOBAL.DreamersLoreConcept.name: The Dreamers
GLOBAL.DreamersLoreConcept.description: The origin and nature of the Dreamers is debated with controversy among [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink]. Their protectors, the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomwatchLoreConcept]Gloomwatch[/hyperlink], claim they are the children of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AllfatherLoreConcept]Allfather[/hyperlink] and that they were sent to bring an end to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrrathLoreConcept]Urrath’s corruption[/hyperlink]. In the records of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomwatchLoreConcept]Gloomwatch[/hyperlink], the Dreamers are attributed with immense creative powers, dreaming creatures, people, and entire worlds into existence. Such pure creation from nothingness is otherwise only observable with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TheWellLoreConcept]the Well[/hyperlink], which indeed some beliefs identify as the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AllfatherLoreConcept]Allfather[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.DuathaLoreConcept.name: Duatha
GLOBAL.DuathaLoreConcept.description: Duatha, also known as the Fey Realm, is the home [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]world[/hyperlink] to some of the most notorious creatures. It is a place filled with deception and trickery, where nothing is as it seems and any expectations of common sense can be defied. Those who dare stray into Duatha’s mists are doomed to get lost in it forever—and said to be brought before the realm’s lords, the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DuathadaeLoreConcept]Duathadae[/hyperlink], for judgment.

GLOBAL.DuathadaeLoreConcept.name: Duathadae
GLOBAL.DuathadaeLoreConcept.description:
Shrouds and mysteries surround the Duathadae, lords of the Fey realm [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DuathaLoreConcept]Duatha[/hyperlink]. For all that is known, they are very protective of the lands under their undisputed rule, and their subjects, sometimes capricious, sometimes outright malicious, obey their word, be it through fear or adoration.

There is occasional evidence that their arcane powers may outmatch those of even a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink], but never have the Duathadae been known to leave their realm [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DuathaLoreConcept]Duatha[/hyperlink]; nor was a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] to this day foolish enough to challenge them in their own domain.

GLOBAL.ElderVampireLoreConcept.name: Elder Vampire
GLOBAL.ElderVampireLoreConcept.description:
Elder Vampires are ageless undead blessed with nightborn powers, dominating the minds of their thralls and drinking the blood of their enemies. They must shun the sun, but thrive in their Sunless domains spreading from the shadows of their castles.

All Elder Vampires are connected through ancient blood lines, dating back to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchvampireLoreConcept]Archvampires[/hyperlink] and the curse of the storied [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrvatoghLoreConcept]Pale Prince[/hyperlink]. Due to this, a strong awareness of origin dictates the hierarchies among Vampires and their undead nobility. Still, even an Elder Vampire Hybrid may rise to fame after devouring the power of many Purebloods...

GLOBAL.EldritchSovereignLoreConcept.name: Eldritch Sovereign
