Forced March can be used to force your units to move further on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink] than they would normally be able to in a single [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].

When Forced March is activated units gain 100% of their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MovePointConcept]Move Points[/hyperlink] but lose 30% of their current [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept] Hit Points[/hyperlink]. They also become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXHAUSTED]Exhausted[/hyperlink] for 2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink]. Forced March costs 10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] per unit in the army.

The ability to use Forced March can be unlocked through [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireDevelopmentConcept]Empire Development[/hyperlink] .

GLOBAL.CryptConcept.name: Crypt
GLOBAL.CryptConcept.description:
When you defeat an enemy [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Hero[/hyperlink] in combat, they have a chance to go to your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PrisonConcept]Prison[/hyperlink] or your crypt.

The remains of these heroes can be sold to get their equipment and some gold.

GLOBAL.DamageDebuffSpellConcept.name: Damage/Debuff Spell
GLOBAL.DamageDebuffSpellConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Damages and debuffs enemies in battle.</bullet><bullet>Costs <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] and <optactical></optactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.DamageHealingSpellConcept.name: Damage/Healing Spell
GLOBAL.DamageHealingSpellConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Damages enemies and heals allies in battle.</bullet><bullet>Costs <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] and <optactical></optactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.DamageSpellConcept.name: Damage Spell
GLOBAL.DamageSpellConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Damages enemies in battle.</bullet><bullet>Costs <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] and <optactical></optactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.DebuffSpellConcept.name: Debuff Spell
GLOBAL.DebuffSpellConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Debuffs enemies in battle.</bullet><bullet>Costs <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] and <optactical></optactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.DormantConcept.name: Dormant
GLOBAL.DormantConcept.description: Dormant skills do not grant any gameplay effects and cannot be reset.

GLOBAL.EmpireBonusConcept.name: Empire Bonus
GLOBAL.EmpireBonusConcept.description: Empire bonuses provide passive effects, new options or new mechanics. Once researched, they are immediately active and do not require a spell to be cast.

GLOBAL.EmpireConcept.name: Empire
GLOBAL.EmpireConcept.description:
An empire consists of a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink], their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].

An empire that has lost both its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept]Throne City[/hyperlink] is defeated.

GLOBAL.EnemyArmySpellConcept.name: Enemy Army Spell
GLOBAL.EnemyArmySpellConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Affects an enemy army.</bullet><bullet>Costs <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] and <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.EquipmentConcept.name: Equipment
GLOBAL.EquipmentConcept.description:
Equipment is items such as weapons and armor that [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Heroes[/hyperlink] can equip to gain bonuses and abilities in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink] or in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink].

Equipment can typically be gained from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PickupConcept]Pickups[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonders[/hyperlink], and Quests.

Equipment that is not equipped is shared between the Ruler and all Heroes of the same Empire.

Rulers and Heroes have a number of equipment slots where 1 equipment item can be assigned of the corresponding type.

Types of equipment slots are:Primary Secondary Head Torso Legs Mount Ring Miscellaneous

GLOBAL.ExcavationConcept.name: Excavation
GLOBAL.ExcavationConcept.description:
Excavation is a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink] ability available to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] which allows them to dig through tunnels and clear out [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UndergroundConcept]Underground[/hyperlink] that lies underneath [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Earthen[/hyperlink] terrain.

Excavation can open up new paths, uncover buried [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PickupConcept]Treasure[/hyperlink], or even discover hidden [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LocationConcept]Locations[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.FeudalHouseConcept.name: Feudal Houses
GLOBAL.FeudalHouseConcept.description:
Cities belonging to players of the Feudal Aristocracy subculture gain an associated House.
The Governor becomes the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LIEGE_LORD]Liege Lord[/hyperlink] of that city's House.Units produced in that City gain that City's House, gaining reduced upkeep and increased health regeneration while in their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LIEGE_LORD]Liege Lord[/hyperlink]'s army.Units belonging to the house additionally gain a powerful boost in combat while in the army of their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LIEGE_LORD]Liege Lord[/hyperlink].These benefits increase based on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LIEGE_LORD]Liege Lord[/hyperlink]'s [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RenownConcept]Renown[/hyperlink] Level.In addition, when the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LIEGE_LORD]Liege Lord[/hyperlink] gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RenownConcept]Renown[/hyperlink], the units belonging to their house gain a small amount of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept] Experience[/hyperlink].
Units summoned on the Strategic Map or gained through events join the house of the most powerful nearby friendly army.
Units recruited through Rally of the Lieges gain the House of the City they're recruited to.

When a Governor is first assigned to a City, you may choose the House's name and banner.
This can be edited at any time in the same manner one changes the city's name, by clicking the name in the city panel.

GLOBAL.FeudalLordConcept.name: Feudal Lord
GLOBAL.FeudalLordConcept.description: The Feudal Culture can grant {herocount} Hero special Feudal Lord titles as Hero Skills. They grant bonuses to the City these Hero are governor of or World Map bonuses to their Army. The Hero Skills are:S K I L L S. F E U D A L_ L O R D_ W A RS K I L L S. F E U D A L_ L O R D_ C R O P SS K I L L S. F E U D A L_ L O R D_ K N O W L E D G ES K I L L S. F E U D A L_ L O R D_ M A G I CS K I L L S. F E U D A L_ L O R D_ P R O D U C T I O N

GLOBAL.FogOfWarConcept.name: Fog of War
GLOBAL.FogOfWarConcept.description:
Hexes on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink] that have been previously revealed but you currently have no vision of through [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LocationConcept]Locations[/hyperlink] owned by you are covered by Fog of War.

Hexes within Fog of War appear darker than when revealed by vision, but will still reveal terrain types, roads and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LocationConcept]Locations[/hyperlink]. Neutral and Hostile [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink] are not visible within Fog of War unless sensed by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SensorRangeConcept]Sensing Range[/hyperlink].

Through [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TreatyConcept]Treaties[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEDiplStateConcept]Diplomatic States[/hyperlink] you may reveal other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink]. But they will still be covered by Fog of War.

GLOBAL.FoundingConcept.name: Founding Cities
GLOBAL.FoundingConcept.description:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.OutpostConcept]Outposts[/hyperlink] can be transformed into [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] by spending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink].

Pay attention to your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityCapConcept]City Cap[/hyperlink] when founding new cities, you will suffer economic penalties if you have too many cities!

GLOBAL.FriendlyArmySpellConcept.name: Friendly Army Spell
GLOBAL.FriendlyArmySpellConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Affects a friendly army.</bullet><bullet>Costs <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] and <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.GovernorConcept.name: Governor
GLOBAL.GovernorConcept.description:
A Governor is a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Hero[/hyperlink] assigned to govern a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink].

Each hero has a Governance Trait that determines the bonuses they give to their city. These bonuses can be increased with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RenownConcept]Renown[/hyperlink] earned from fulfilling the hero's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AmbitionConcept]Ambition[/hyperlink].

A Ruler is always the Governor of their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept]Throne City[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.HandcraftedRegionConcept.name: Handcrafted Region
GLOBAL.HandcraftedRegionConcept.description:
Handcrafted Regions are a collection of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] that are custom made rather than fully randomly generated. They generally contain the same type of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LocationConcept]Locations[/hyperlink] as normal Provinces but can contain special visuals, shapes or an unique combination of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Features[/hyperlink].


Certain Realm Traits, such as Legends of Myrrida can add additional Handcrafted Regions that would otherwise never be added to a realm.

GLOBAL.HealingSpellConcept.name: Healing Spell
GLOBAL.HealingSpellConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Heals allies in battle.</bullet><bullet>Costs <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] and <optactical></optactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.HeroCapConcept.name: Hero Cap
GLOBAL.HeroCapConcept.description:
The hero cap represents the number of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Heroes[/hyperlink] your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] can support.

You cannot recruit more heroes beyond the cap. The cap will increase automatically as the game goes on. You can spend [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink] to increase it instantly.

GLOBAL.HyperlinkConcept.name: Hyperlink
GLOBAL.HyperlinkConcept.description: As you can see, this tooltip opened as you hovered over the hyperlink. Now try hovering over this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TooltipConcept]Hyperlink[/hyperlink] to open a tooltip within the tooltip!

GLOBAL.InfusionConcept.name: Infusion
GLOBAL.InfusionConcept.description:
Infusions are individual improvements that can be put on created items in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ItemForgeConcept]Item Forge[/hyperlink]. These can be Passive Properties, Active Abilities or Damage Channels.

An Infusion has an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfusionPointConcept]Infusion Point[/hyperlink] cost, which increases the cost to forge that item.

Each Infusion after the first also increases the total price of forging the item by 20%.

GLOBAL.InfusionPointConcept.name: Infusion Point
GLOBAL.InfusionPointConcept.description:
Every [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfusionConcept]Infusion[/hyperlink] has a specific Infusion Point cost ranging from 1 to 5. Normally an item can have no more than 5 Infusion Points.

The Infusion Point total determines the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ItemTierConcept]Item Tier[/hyperlink] as follows:Item Tier I: 1 or 2 Infusion PointsItem Tier II: 3 Infusion PointsItem Tier III: 4 Infusion PointsItem Tier IV: 5+ Infusion Points

GLOBAL.ItemForgeConcept.name: Item Forge
GLOBAL.ItemForgeConcept.description:
The Item Forge is used to create new custom hero items. Forging items costs [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BindingEssenceConcept]Binding Essence[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink], and time. Only a single item can be forged at a time.

The cost and time to forge an item depend on the amount of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfusionPointConcept]Infusion Points[/hyperlink] used to forge the item. The amount of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfusionConcept]Infusions[/hyperlink] also increases the cost.

The Infusions available are dependent on the types of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Materials[/hyperlink] that you have collected. Collecting more of the same Magic Material will unlock more powerful Infusions.

The Item Forge can be build in your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WizardTowerConcept]Wizard Tower[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.ItemTierConcept.name: Item Tier
GLOBAL.ItemTierConcept.description:
An item's tier is an indication of its power. The damage of Primary Weapons increases with each tier based on what type of weapon it is.

In the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ItemForgeConcept]Item Forge[/hyperlink], the item tier is determined by the amount of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfusionConcept]Infusions[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.EldritchRelicWeaponConcept.name: Eldritch Relic Weapon
GLOBAL.EldritchRelicWeaponConcept.description:
These are powerful weapons exclusive to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EldritchSovereignLoreConcept]Eldritch Sovereigns[/hyperlink]. They grant two attacks, one long range and one melee range.

Usable by:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassRitualist]Hero Class: Ritualist[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassMage]Hero Class: Elementalist[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.FistWeaponConcept.name: Fist Weapon
GLOBAL.FistWeaponConcept.description:
These are small weapons that are used in each hand. They grant the hero melee attacks that often have a special effect on the third attack.

Usable by:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassDefender]Hero Class: Defender[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassWarrior]Hero Class: Warrior[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassDeathKnight]Hero Class: Death Knight[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassSpellblade]Hero Class: Spellblade[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.MagicOrbWeaponConcept.name: Magic Orb Weapon
GLOBAL.MagicOrbWeaponConcept.description:
Magical artifacts that let the hero do non-physical attacks from a distance.

Usable by:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassRitualist]Hero Class: Ritualist[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassMage]Hero Class: Elementalist[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.MagicRangedConcept.name: Magic Ranged
GLOBAL.MagicRangedConcept.description:
Magical artifacts such as staves and magical orbs that let the hero do non-physical attacks from a distance.

Usable by:Hero Class RitualistHero Class Mage

GLOBAL.MagicStaffWeaponConcept.name: Magic Staff Weapon
GLOBAL.MagicStaffWeaponConcept.description:
Magical artifacts that let the hero do non-physical attacks from a distance. Grant the hero [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DEFENSES.WARDING]Defense Mode: Warding[/hyperlink].

Usable by:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassRitualist]Hero Class: Ritualist[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassMage]Hero Class: Elementalist[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.OneHandedWeaponConcept.name: One Handed Weapon
GLOBAL.OneHandedWeaponConcept.description:
These are smaller melee weapons such as swords, maces, and daggers. They leave the left hand free to use a shield.

Usable by:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassDefender]Hero Class: Defender[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassWarrior]Hero Class: Warrior[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.PolearmWeaponConcept.name: Polearm Weapon
GLOBAL.PolearmWeaponConcept.description:
These are long melee weapons such as spears, polearms, and glaives. They grant the hero [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FirstStrikeConcept]First Strike[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHARGE_RESISTANCE]Charge Resistance[/hyperlink].

Usable by:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassDefender]Hero Class: Defender[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassWarrior]Hero Class: Warrior[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassDeathKnight]Hero Class: Death Knight[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassSpellblade]Hero Class: Spellblade[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.RangedWeaponConcept.name: Ranged Weapon
GLOBAL.RangedWeaponConcept.description:
These are weapons such as bows, crossbows, and muskets. They let the hero do non-physical attacks from a distance.

Usable by:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassRanger]Hero Class: Ranger[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.ShieldConcept.name: Shield
GLOBAL.ShieldConcept.description:
Shields are defensive weapons that can be wielded with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OneHandedWeaponConcept]One Handed Weapon[/hyperlink] weapons. They grant the hero [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DEFENSES.SHIELD_WALL]Defense Mode: Shield Wall[/hyperlink].

Usable by:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassDefender]Hero Class: Defender[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassWarrior]Hero Class: Warrior[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassDeathKnight]Hero Class: Death Knight[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassSpellblade]Hero Class: Spellblade[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.SkirmishingWeaponConcept.name: Skirmisher Weapon
GLOBAL.SkirmishingWeaponConcept.description:
These are weapon pairs, such as a crossbow and dagger, that allow a hero to make both melee and ranged attacks.

Usable by:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassRanger]Hero Class: Ranger[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassDefender]Hero Class: Defender[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassWarrior]Hero Class: Warrior[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassDeathKnight]Hero Class: Death Knight[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassSpellblade]Hero Class: Spellblade[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.GreatWeaponConcept.name: Great Weapon
GLOBAL.GreatWeaponConcept.description:
These are larger melee weapons such as great swords and great axes. They grant the hero a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChargeConcept]Charge[/hyperlink] attack.

Usable by:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassWarrior]Hero Class: Warrior[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassDeathKnight]Hero Class: Death Knight[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroClassSpellblade]Hero Class: Spellblade[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.KeeperConcept.name: Keeper
GLOBAL.KeeperConcept.description:
The Race Keeper is the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] whose [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] has the biggest presence of a race, through owned [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEVassalConcept]Vassals[/hyperlink]. You are always the Keeper of the race you start with.

To become the Keeper of a Race you need to have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MISC.RACE_POPULATION_THRESHOLD]Race population threshold[/hyperlink]% of the race's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] in your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink]. If the race already has a Race Keeper you need [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MISC.RACE_POPULATION_OVERTAKE_THRESHOLD]Race population overtake threshold[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] more than them to take it from them.

To become the Keeper of another player's starting race the player would have to be defeated first.

The Race Keeper is the only [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] who can apply [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MajorRaceTransformationConcept]Major Race Transformations[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MinorRaceTransformationConcept]Minor Race Transformations[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.LavaConcept.name: Lava
GLOBAL.LavaConcept.description:
Lava is a type of terrain that can appear both on the surface and underground. When a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] annexes a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] with lava, they suffer a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] penalty. This penalty can be avoided by having either the Underground or Desolate Adaptation.

If the center of a province is in lava, then you will be able to build a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MineConcept]Mine[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ConduitConcept]Conduit[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvement[/hyperlink].

Units that can traverse lava need to have one of the following:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLYING_MOVEMENT]Flying[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLOATING_MOVEMENT]Floating[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LAVA_WALK]Lava Walk[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.MajorRaceTransformationConcept.name: Major Race Transformation
GLOBAL.MajorRaceTransformationConcept.description:
A powerful [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spell[/hyperlink] that transforms the essence of an entire race, granting powerful bonuses to all the race's units, even those not under the caster's control.
The caster must be the race's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KeeperConcept]Keeper[/hyperlink].A race can have only one Major Race Transformation at a time.

GLOBAL.MigratingConcept.name: Migrating
GLOBAL.MigratingConcept.description: Migrating a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] makes it part of your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] under your direct control, replacing its original race and culture with yours.

GLOBAL.MinorRaceTransformationConcept.name: Minor Race Transformation
GLOBAL.MinorRaceTransformationConcept.description:
A powerful [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spell[/hyperlink] that transforms the essence of an entire Race, granting a bonus to all the race's units, even those not under the caster's control.
The caster must be the race's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KeeperConcept]Keeper[/hyperlink].A race can have a number of Minor Race Transformations at once.

GLOBAL.NatureConcept.name: Nature Affinity
GLOBAL.NatureConcept.description:
Nature [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink] governs the energies of life, promoting growth and revitalization. It is associated with farming, druidism and control over the living world.

Nature Affinity is opposed by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowConcept]Shadow Affinity[/hyperlink]. [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] with opposing affinities will suffer relation penalties.

GLOBAL.OpposingStatusEffectsConcept.name: Status Effects Countering
GLOBAL.OpposingStatusEffectsConcept.description:
Sometimes a status effect counters another. This means:
You can remove a status effect by applying the status effect that counters it.When a status effect counters another, it is not applied itself.

GLOBAL.OrderConcept.name: Order Affinity
GLOBAL.OrderConcept.description:
Order [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink] is the power that brings structure to the Cosmos and to the lives of mortals. Associated with light, faith, justice, and the government of empires.

Order Affinity is opposed by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos Affinity[/hyperlink]. [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] with opposing affinities will suffer relation penalties.

GLOBAL.AscendedTransformationConcept.name: Ascended Transformation
GLOBAL.AscendedTransformationConcept.description: Ascended transformations are <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RaceTransformationConcept]Race Transformations[/hyperlink] that a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] had when they ascended to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PantheonLoreConcept]Pantheon[/hyperlink]. The ascended transformations only apply to the Ruler (not their race) when they next appear on a realm.

GLOBAL.AscendedConcept.name: Ascended
GLOBAL.AscendedConcept.description:
An ascended [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] has proven worthy to join the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PantheonLoreConcept]Pantheon[/hyperlink] and can be selected to appear as either a recruitable [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Hero[/hyperlink] or as Ruler.

Ascended Rulers may receive an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AscensionTraitConcept]Ascension Trait[/hyperlink] and can keep [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RaceTransformationConcept]Race Transformations[/hyperlink] for when they next appear on a realm.

GLOBAL.AscensionTraitConcept.name: Ascension Trait
GLOBAL.AscensionTraitConcept.description: An ascension trait is received by a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] upon conquering a realm. A Ruler can only have one ascension trait and can choose a trait based on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TomeConcept]Tomes[/hyperlink] they have unlocked on the realm.

GLOBAL.PillagingConcept.name: Pillaging
GLOBAL.PillagingConcept.description:
Some locations such as [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvement[/hyperlink] cannot be [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RazingConcept]Razed[/hyperlink] but can be pillaged instead, granting [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResourceConcept]Resource[/hyperlink] rewards.
When a province improvement is pillaged it is turned into Ruins.Ruins can be rebuilt at the cost of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink].Ruins from enemy [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] can be [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceAnnexationConcept]Annexed[/hyperlink] to your own.

GLOBAL.PopulationConcept.name: Population
GLOBAL.PopulationConcept.description:
Population represents the size of a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink]. It allows the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] to build new [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvements[/hyperlink] and expand its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].

Population increases with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink] income and requires [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationUpkeepConcept]Population Upkeep[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PopulationUpkeepConcept.name: Population Upkeep
GLOBAL.PopulationUpkeepConcept.description:
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] in a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] costs 3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink] and 5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink].

Negative Food income can lead to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StarvationConcept]Starvation[/hyperlink]!

GLOBAL.PrisonConcept.name: Prison
GLOBAL.PrisonConcept.description:
When you defeat an enemy [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Hero[/hyperlink] in combat, they have a chance of going to your prison or your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CryptConcept]Crypt[/hyperlink].

Heroes in your prison can be granted their freedom to get their equipment and to improve relations with the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] they belong to.

Certain Heroes can never go to the Prison:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.FreeCityLordConcept]Free City Lords[/hyperlink] cannot go to Prison, and will go to the Crypt instead.[hyperlink,GLOBAL.MarauderConcept]Marauder[/hyperlink] Heroes cannot go to Prison, and will go to the Crypt instead.[hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] can never be captured, and will go to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RulerVoidConcept]Void[/hyperlink] instead.

GLOBAL.ProductionQueueConcept.name: Production Queue
GLOBAL.ProductionQueueConcept.description:
Production Queues in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] allow for the construction of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStructureConcept]City Structures[/hyperlink] and recruitment of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink].

[hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitProductionConcept]Draft[/hyperlink] resources are used up when building the first item in the Production Queue. Items in the queue can be reprioritized after being added.

GLOBAL.RaceTransformationConcept.name: Race Transformation
GLOBAL.RaceTransformationConcept.description:
A powerful [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spell[/hyperlink] that transforms the essence of an entire race, granting a bonus to all the race's units, even those not under the caster's control.
The caster must be the race's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KeeperConcept]Keeper[/hyperlink].A race can have any number of Minor Race Transformations at once.A race can have only one Major Race Transformation at a time.

GLOBAL.RazingConcept.name: Razing
GLOBAL.RazingConcept.description:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink] can remove an empire's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink] from a province by razing the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OutpostConcept]Outpost[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] at its center. [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvements[/hyperlink] cannot be razed, but can be [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PillagingConcept]Pillaged[/hyperlink] instead.

Razing cities leaves behind ruins which can be rebuilt at the cost of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept.name: Rally of the Lieges
GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept.description:
This is where you can draft [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] into your empire or to help defend [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEVassalConcept]Vassal Cities[/hyperlink] using [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RecruitmentPointsConcept]Recruitment Points[/hyperlink].

The pool of available units consists primarily of units made available to you by loyal [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] and annexed [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonders[/hyperlink]. The number of units available depends on how many Recruitment Points you have available. The units made available by cities will be randomly selected based on the units that city can produce, focusing on higher tier units.

Rallies will be held every 15 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink] and only at that point will the pool of units and the number of points you can spend refresh. You can, however, use a boost to halve the amount of remaining turns once per Rally.

GLOBAL.RitualAlacrityConcept.name: Ritual of Alacrity
GLOBAL.RitualAlacrityConcept.description:
Players can activate the Ritual of Alacrity on any owned Barbarian [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OutpostConcept]Outposts[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].

When activated, friendly [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] on the center of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OutpostConcept]Outpost[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] will restore 50% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept] Hit Points[/hyperlink], 100% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MovePointConcept]Move Points[/hyperlink], and removes [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXHAUSTED]Exhausted[/hyperlink] from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpeedMarchConcept]Forced March[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.RulerVoidConcept.name: Ruler in the Void
GLOBAL.RulerVoidConcept.description: When a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] perishes during battle or otherwise, they will be cast into the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralVoidLoreConcept]Astral Void[/hyperlink]. If that Ruler still holds their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept]Throne City[/hyperlink], they will materialize there in 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink]. If that Ruler has lost their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept]Throne City[/hyperlink], their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] is defeated. While in the Void, the Ruler's empire is in chaos and subject to the following penalties:<bulletlist><bullet>-20 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in each city.</bullet><bullet>Governor bonuses are not applied.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResearchConcept]Research[/hyperlink] is paused.</bullet><bullet>No [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] can be cast.</bullet><bullet>Active [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicVictoryConcept]Magic Victory[/hyperlink] spells are canceled and their progress reset.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.ScoutProspectingConcept.name: Scout Prospecting
GLOBAL.ScoutProspectingConcept.description:
When Industrious [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SCOUT_UNIT]Scout Units[/hyperlink] stand within a friendly or neutral [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] that contains a Cliff, Mountain or Stalagmite, the player that owns the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SCOUT_UNIT]Scout Unit[/hyperlink] can prospect the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] for [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] rewards.

Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] can only be prospected once.

GLOBAL.SensorRangeConcept.name: Sensing Range
GLOBAL.SensorRangeConcept.description: Sensing Range is the number of hexes within which the presence of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] can be detected in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FogOfWarConcept]Fog of War[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.ShadowConcept.name: Shadow Affinity
GLOBAL.ShadowConcept.description:
Shadow [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink] relates to the realm of death, decay and ice, as well as deception and instilling and exploiting weakness.

Shadow Affinity is opposed by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NatureConcept]Nature Affinity[/hyperlink]. [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] with opposing affinities will suffer relation penalties.

GLOBAL.SiegeConcept.name: Siege
GLOBAL.SiegeConcept.description:
If a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] has a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityWallStructureConcept]Wall Structure[/hyperlink] and you wish to conquer it, you first need to besiege it and breach its defenses.

A Siege can be initiated by attacking any of the 7 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] hexes with at least 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Army[/hyperlink] led by a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Hero[/hyperlink] which must remain adjacent to the city until the siege is completed or else the Siege is lifted.

While sieging the City's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FortificationHealthConcept]Fortification Health[/hyperlink] is lowered by the besieger's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FortificationDamageConcept]Fortification Damage[/hyperlink].

[hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeProjectConcept]Siege Projects[/hyperlink] can be used to speed up the siege by dealing more [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FortificationDamageConcept]Fortification Damage[/hyperlink]. They can also remove defenses and give the besieger an advantage.

Once [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FortificationHealthConcept]Fortification Health[/hyperlink] reaches 0, the attacker can move into the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] for a decisive battle.

GLOBAL.SiegeProjectConcept.name: Siege Project
GLOBAL.SiegeProjectConcept.description:
Siege Projects can be used during a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeConcept]Siege[/hyperlink] to speed up the siege by adding more [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FortificationDamageConcept]Fortification Damage[/hyperlink]. They can also remove defenses and give the besieger an advantage.

Siege Projects can only be added and removed in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeConcept]Siege[/hyperlink] was initiated.

You can only have as many siege projects added as you can have slots. More slots can be gained through [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireSkillConcept]Empire Skills[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SpecialImprovementConcept.name: Special Province Improvement
GLOBAL.SpecialImprovementConcept.description:
Special [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvement[/hyperlink] are built from the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProductionQueueConcept]Production Queue[/hyperlink] and replace an existing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvement[/hyperlink].

Effects can include:Improved income based on adjacent [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink].[hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Army[/hyperlink] effects in and around the Special Province Improvement.[hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Army[/hyperlink] spawn points.[hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Army[/hyperlink] visit bonuses.
Special Province Improvements are unlocked with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TomeConcept]Tomes[/hyperlink] and cultures.

GLOBAL.SpellSlotsConcept.name: Spell Slots
GLOBAL.SpellSlotsConcept.description:
Spell slots are used to prepare spells ready for casting. Once your spell slots are full you will need to cast or cancel a prepared spell before you can start preparing any new spells.

You can gain another spell slot by building the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.CHANNELINGCHAMBER]Wizard Tower: Channeling Chamber[/hyperlink] in your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept]Throne City[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SpellVictoryConcept.name: Spell Victory
GLOBAL.SpellVictoryConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Casting this spell has a global effect and is required to reach [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicVictoryConcept]Magic Victory[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>This spell requires time to channel once cast.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.StarvationConcept.name: Starvation
GLOBAL.StarvationConcept.description:
When [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationUpkeepConcept]Population Upkeep[/hyperlink] is higher than [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink] income, the city's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] will starve.

Starvation leads to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] dying and a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvement[/hyperlink] leaving the city every 3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept.name: World Map
GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept.description: The World Map is where [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] are built, [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink] are moved, and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LocationConcept]Locations[/hyperlink] are explored.

GLOBAL.StrategicSummonSpellConcept.name: World Map Summon Spell
GLOBAL.StrategicSummonSpellConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Summons a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MAGIC_ORIGIN]Magic Origin[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Can be cast on any hex adjacent to your heroes, ruler, or one of your cities.</bullet><bullet>Units with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LAND_MOVEMENT]Land Movement[/hyperlink] cannot be summoned onto water hexes.</bullet><bullet>Costs <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] and <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.StructureQueueConcept.name: Structure Queue
GLOBAL.StructureQueueConcept.description: The Structure Queue is where [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStructureConcept]City Structures[/hyperlink] are built by spending <gold></gold> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] and <structureprod></structureprod> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SustainedCitySpellConcept.name: Sustained City Spell
GLOBAL.SustainedCitySpellConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Can affect the targeted city and its domain.</bullet><bullet>The effect lasts as long as you pay mana each turn.</bullet><bullet>Costs <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] and <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SustainedWorldSpellConcept.name: Sustained World Spell
GLOBAL.SustainedWorldSpellConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>The effect lasts as long as you pay mana each turn.</bullet><bullet>Costs <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] and <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SwallowedConcept.name: Swallowed
GLOBAL.SwallowedConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Unit is removed from combat.</bullet><bullet>If another unit is swallowed, the previous swallowed unit dies.</bullet><bullet>If the unit that ate the unit is killed, the last unit swallowed is released.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.CombatConcept.name: Combat
GLOBAL.CombatConcept.description:
Combat occurs when an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Army[/hyperlink] encounters an enemy [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Army[/hyperlink], or while exploring [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonders[/hyperlink].

Combat occurs on a separate map and is [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink]-based.

With the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ReinforcementRuleConcept]Reinforcement Rule[/hyperlink], up to 6 armies can participate in the battle.

The battle is won by the last combatant that has [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] left.

GLOBAL.TerraformingSpellConcept.name: Terraforming Spell
GLOBAL.TerraformingSpellConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.TerraformingConcept]Terraforms[/hyperlink] one or more [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Costs <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] and <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept.name: Throne City
GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept.description: Your Throne City is the capital of your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink]. Losing it and your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] simultaneously ends your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.TomeConcept.name: Tome
GLOBAL.TomeConcept.description:
A Tome is a collection of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] and other skills that you can [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResearchConcept]Research[/hyperlink]. Tomes also have initial bonuses you get for free.

Tier 1 tomes are always available, to unlock higher tier tomes:Research 2 Tomes of any tier.Tier 3 tomes require you to have 3 points of a single [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink].Tier 4 tomes require you to have 6 points of a single [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink].Tier 5 Tomes require you to have 8 points of a single [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink].Tomes can contain:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpecialImprovementConcept]Special Province Improvements[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStructureConcept]City Structures[/hyperlink][hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeProjectConcept]Siege Projects[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.TomePassiveConcept.name: Tome Passive
GLOBAL.TomePassiveConcept.description: A passive bonus that is immediately active once the tome has been chosen.

GLOBAL.TooltipConcept.name: Tooltip
GLOBAL.TooltipConcept.description: Well done! Use this useful feature to learn about concepts and systems as you go. You can string together tooltips endlessly, however older ones will close as you go [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TooltipConcept]deeper[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.TurnConcept.name: Turn
GLOBAL.TurnConcept.description:
The unit of time in which [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PlayerConcept]Players[/hyperlink] carry out all of their actions.

On the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink], turns take the form of either [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ClassicTurnConcept]Classic Turns[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SimultaneousTurnConcept]Simultaneous Turns[/hyperlink].

Turns during [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink] are taken one [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PlayerConcept]Player[/hyperlink] after another.

GLOBAL.UndergroundConcept.name: Underground
GLOBAL.UndergroundConcept.description: The layer of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink] that can be accessed with Underground Passages.

GLOBAL.UninhabitedProvinceConcept.name: Uninhabited Province
GLOBAL.UninhabitedProvinceConcept.description: An uninhabited province is a province that isn't part of anyone's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink] and doesn't contain an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonder[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.UnitConcept.name: Unit
GLOBAL.UnitConcept.description:
Units are the forces that make up your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink].

Units can explore the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink] and engage in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink].

Can be recruited in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] or summoned using [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink].

Units require [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] upkeep each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.UnitUpgradeUpkeepConcept.name: Unit Enchantment Upkeep
GLOBAL.UnitUpgradeUpkeepConcept.description: Each <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitEnchantmentConcept]Unit Enchantment[/hyperlink] has its own upkeep cost in <gold></gold> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] and <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] which is added to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink] of each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] that is using it.

GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept.name: Unit Upkeep
GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept.description:
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink], you must pay [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] to maintain your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink]. High tier units also require [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink]. If you cannot afford this, your units will lose [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink]!

A unit's upkeep depends on: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitTierConcept]Unit tier[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitEnchantmentConcept]Unit Enchantments[/hyperlink]Some Empire Skills and Hero Skills can reduce the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] upkeep, but never below 50% of its value.

GLOBAL.CallToArmsViabilityConcept.name: Viability
GLOBAL.CallToArmsViabilityConcept.description:
Viability describes how likely it is for a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] to complete the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CallToArmsConcept]Bounty[/hyperlink] objective.
Other Rulers may not be at war with you if they want to accept the bounty. They must also have met the target Ruler or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink], and AI controlled Rulers must be at war with the target.

For AI controlled Rulers, their army power and proximity to the target are also taken into account, as well as how strongly the target is defended. The viability also influences the chances of AI controlled Rulers accepting the bounty.

GLOBAL.VisionRangeConcept.name: Vision Range
GLOBAL.VisionRangeConcept.description: Vision Range is the number of hexes that remove [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FogOfWarConcept]Fog of War[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.WorldMapSpellConcept.name: World Map Spell
GLOBAL.WorldMapSpellConcept.description:
These are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] that are cast on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink], using [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink].

Types of World Map Spells are: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CitySpellConcept]City Spell[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnemyArmySpellConcept]Enemy Army Spell[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FriendlyArmySpellConcept]Friendly Army Spell[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MajorRaceTransformationConcept]Major Race Transformation[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MinorRaceTransformationConcept]Minor Race Transformation[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellVictoryConcept]Spell Victory[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StrategicSummonSpellConcept]Summon Spell[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SustainedCitySpellConcept]Sustained City Spell[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SustainedWorldSpellConcept]Sustained World Spell[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TerraformingSpellConcept]Terraforming Spell[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitEnchantmentConcept]Unit Enchantment[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldSpellConcept]World Spell[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.RaceRelationRewardConcept.name: Reward: Race Relation
GLOBAL.RaceRelationRewardConcept.description: This quest hands out race relation as a guaranteed reward. This means all owned [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] of that race will receive a temporary <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] bonus, and all met <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] receive a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityRelationConcept]Relations[/hyperlink] bonus.

GLOBAL.SurpriseBonusRewardConcept.name: Reward: Unknown Bonus
GLOBAL.SurpriseBonusRewardConcept.description: Unknown rewards can be earned after completion.

GLOBAL.MysteryBonusRewardConcept.name: Reward: Mystery Bonus
GLOBAL.MysteryBonusRewardConcept.description: Bonus rewards can be earned through different story event choices after completion.

GLOBAL.OutnumberedConcept.name: Outnumbered
GLOBAL.OutnumberedConcept.description: A unit is outnumbered if the number of units on the opposing side is greater than the number of units on their own side.

GLOBAL.UnknownTraitConcept.name: Unknown Trait
GLOBAL.UnknownTraitConcept.description: Unknown traits are hidden when the game begins, and are slowly revealed as it progresses.

GLOBAL.CavernFloorConcept.name: Cavern Floor
GLOBAL.CavernFloorConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

Rough, nearly barren rock. A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HutConcept]Hut[/hyperlink] can be built here.
Underground-adapted factions can build a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FarmConcept]Farm[/hyperlink] here instead.

GLOBAL.DiggableEarthConcept.name: Diggable Earth
GLOBAL.DiggableEarthConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

Can be [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ExcavationConcept]Excavated[/hyperlink] one [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] at a time by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] once the Excavation Empire Skill is acquired.

GLOBAL.SwampConcept.name: Swamp
GLOBAL.SwampConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

Swampy marshlands. A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FarmConcept]Farm[/hyperlink] can be built here, but factions without Swamp Adaptation will suffer -2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.UndergroundWaterConcept.name: Underground Water
GLOBAL.UndergroundWaterConcept.description:
A water [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

A province of water in the underground. A water [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FarmConcept]Farm[/hyperlink] can be built here.

GLOBAL.UninhabitableConcept.name: Uninhabitable
GLOBAL.UninhabitableConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

This province is uninhabitable. You cannot build an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OutpostConcept]Outpost[/hyperlink] here, nor can you annex this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] to a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.MarauderConcept.name: Marauder
GLOBAL.MarauderConcept.description: Marauders are hostile [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink] threatening the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink] that are not affiliated with a <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.MangroveForestConcept.name: Mangrove Forest
GLOBAL.MangroveForestConcept.description:
A water [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

A forest with its roots submerged in water. A water [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ForesterConcept]Forester[/hyperlink] can be built here.

GLOBAL.VoidConcept.name: Void
GLOBAL.VoidConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

A void is present in the province which blocks all movement and cannot be built upon.

GLOBAL.TerraformingConcept.name: Terraforming
GLOBAL.TerraformingConcept.description:
Terraforming effects can change the appearance and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Features[/hyperlink] in a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink]. Terraforming can change what [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvements[/hyperlink] can be built in a Province, but does not destroy or change already built Province Improvements.

When terraforming originates from a source, such as a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] or Province Improvement, then removing the source will revert the terraforming effects. When there is no source that can be removed, terraforming is permanent until overwritten by a new terraforming effect.

[hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapSpellConcept]World Map Spells[/hyperlink] can apply terraforming effects. When you cancel a sustained effect such as a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SustainedWorldSpellConcept]Sustained World Spell[/hyperlink], its terraforming changes will not be reverted.

Certain provinces or features, such as Lava, Water, and Uninhabitable provinces, cannot normally be terraformed.

GLOBAL.MortalChampionConcept.name: Champion
GLOBAL.MortalChampionConcept.description:
A Ruler risen from the ranks of their people.
Mortal Champions have access to unique army leadership hero skills.Mortal Champion Rulers gain +20% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept] Experience[/hyperlink].Start with +100 Relation with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityRelationConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink].Mortal Champion Rulers start with the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SPUR_TO_ACTION]Spur to Action[/hyperlink] ability in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink].Mortal Champions are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_CHAMPION_GOVERNOR]Champion Governors[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.WizardKingConcept.name: Wizard King
GLOBAL.WizardKingConcept.description:
A powerful Wizard seeking dominion over a new realm.
Wizard Kings have access to unique [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpellConcept]Combat Spell[/hyperlink] enhancing hero skills.All [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ConduitConcept]Conduits[/hyperlink] grant +5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].Start with +10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink] and +10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink].Wizard Kings start with the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.OVERCHANNEL_ABILITY]Channeling Ritual[/hyperlink] ability in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink].Wizard Kings are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_WIZARD_GOVERNOR]Wizard Governors[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.CreepingConcept.name: Creeping
GLOBAL.CreepingConcept.description: At the end of the <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], this obstacle replicates itself to an adjacent hex once.

GLOBAL.DrainingConcept.name: Draining
GLOBAL.DrainingConcept.description: Units passing through or ending their turn in this position suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISRUPTION_TOOLTIP_PROPERTY]Disrupted[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink]. If that unit has [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MAGIC_ORIGIN]Magic Origin[/hyperlink] it also suffers [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DECAYING]Decaying[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.AIPersonalityConcept.name: AI Personality
GLOBAL.AIPersonalityConcept.description:
The AI personality is an optional setting which determines the personality of a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] when you encounter them as an AI controlled Ruler in different sessions. This setting does not affect your empire when you are playing as this Ruler.

The personality affects the choices and behavior of AI Rulers in terms of Diplomacy, Research, Economy, and Military. When using the Default option, the system will pick a personality based on the starting [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept]Alignment[/hyperlink] of your custom Ruler when it is AI controlled.

GLOBAL.AerelazaliarLoreConcept.name: Aerelazaliar
GLOBAL.AerelazaliarLoreConcept.description:
Having hatched only ten cosmic cycles ago, Aerelazaliar would be considered "young" among his Dragonkin. Perhaps it is his youth that drives his curiosity and kindness towards those his kin would deem inferior. He pays their comments no mind, for Aerelazaliar's gaze drifts beyond his nature of creation and destruction and he dares to question "why".

The Starbred Salamanders were created in Aerelazaliar's own image. It is rare for a Dragon to create their own people, and many wonder what the consequences of Aerelazaliar's "vain splurge in divinity" will be. His people, however, are forever grateful for their draconic father's care.

GLOBAL.AfflictingMiasmaHazard.name: Afflicting Miasma
GLOBAL.AfflictingMiasmaHazard.description:
Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex will be inflicted with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WEAKENED]Weakened[/hyperlink].
Units on this hex have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AFFLICTING_MIASMA_STATUS_EFFECT]Afflicted[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.AlfredElderstoneLoreConcept.name: Alfred Elderstone
GLOBAL.AlfredElderstoneLoreConcept.description:
When he was a young prince, Alfred saw the deaths of his parents at the hands of an invading [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WizardKingLoreConcept]Wizard[/hyperlink]. In order to protect his people, he united the splintered factions of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept]Athla[/hyperlink] under one banner and started the search for a new home.

After the return of the Wizard Kings, the many human factions of Athla were unable to rise against the invasion. It took a great hero—a young prince who knew tremendous loss, to unite them under the banner of the Destined Humans.

GLOBAL.AngelizeConcept.name: Angelic Transformation
GLOBAL.AngelizeConcept.description: Turns the target race into angelic beings, granting them:<bulletlist><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CELESTIAL]Celestial[/hyperlink] unit type.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLYING_MOVEMENT]Flying[/hyperlink] Movement, which increases mobility.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FAITHFUL]Faithful[/hyperlink], which reduces [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Decreased number of units in formation.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.AnonLoreConcept.name: Anon
GLOBAL.AnonLoreConcept.description:
A simple old man in appearance, Anon represents [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archon[/hyperlink] virtues like few others. As a Pacifist, Scholar, and Oracle he presides over the Order of Augurs, ensuring that their divine prophecies are chronicled and debated with great care. His wisdom and patience are renowned even among the Archons' enemies.

The Archon Diviners are the enlightened followers of Anon. They dwell at the Lakes of Sagacity, attending to the Order of Augurs and their divine Observatories. When the starlight leads them away from the blessed shores of Emnora, the Archon Diviners will stand against evil and fight for the fulfillment of their prophecies.

GLOBAL.ArachnaLoreConcept.name: Arachna
GLOBAL.ArachnaLoreConcept.description:
A spinner of exquisite crafting, she sings a luring melody from the hidden place, feeling the vibrations in the strings of her many tangled web. The weaver Arachna spins intrigue, ensnaring lost souls that wander into darkness to hide their shame. Her dark servants move about the world, while she lurks deep in the nest of shadows.

Arachna discovered that some Goblins were so distasteful that her beloved spiders refused to consume them. With that, her Reclusive Spiderlings were born. These symbiotic fiends love lurking unnoticed in the recesses of the world. They breed their arachnids, which have now grown to such enormous proportions that they ride them into combat.

GLOBAL.ArcaneInspirationConcept.name: Arcane Inspiration
GLOBAL.ArcaneInspirationConcept.description:
For Mystic Spell Arcanists, each spell has a potential benefit that can be extracted by using it after gaining enough inspiration for it.[hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpellConcept]Combat Spells[/hyperlink] gain inspiration upon completing a combat in which the spell was used at least once.[hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapSpellConcept]World Map Spells[/hyperlink] gain inspiration for each use.
Once a spell has gained maximum inspiration, it can be exploited, locking the spell away temporarily in return for the effects of its potential.
The potential of each spell is randomly assigned, scaling with the tier of the spell. When a spell has been exploited and becomes available again, it will gain a new potential.

GLOBAL.ArchitectConcept.name: Architect
GLOBAL.ArchitectConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Has higher <structureprod></structureprod> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] income.</bullet><bullet>Collect <wonderstone></wonderstone> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WonderStoneConcept]Wonderstone[/hyperlink] to build impressive <monument></monument> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchitectMonumentConcept]Monuments[/hyperlink] to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinities[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet><monument></monument> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchitectMonumentConcept]Monuments[/hyperlink] grant [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AFFINITY_INCARNATE_UNIT_PROPERTY]Affinity Incarnate[/hyperlink] to Architect Units.</bullet><bullet>Architect culture units deal damage matching the Empire's dominant [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.ArticaLoreConcept.name: Artica
GLOBAL.ArticaLoreConcept.description:
Her icy filigree sparkles, catching iridescent sheets of boreal ghost-light. Think not to captivate this one, for her heart is frigid. Artica haunts the snowy drifts of winter, leaving no footprints. Goddess to her Frostling subjects, they alone tolerate her frigid isolation.

Specialized people who adore the ice and snow, Frostlings thrive in inhospitable glacial realms. Their frigid adaptation allows them to raid the rich lands that border the frozen wastes, spreading their cold unfeeling ice as a blizzard.

GLOBAL.ArtifactHoardConcept.name: Equipment Hoard
GLOBAL.ArtifactHoardConcept.description: Hero Items in the arsenal grant additional <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] income.<bulletlist><bullet>Tier I - 1 <mana></mana></bullet><bullet>Tier II - 3 <mana></mana></bullet><bullet>Tier III - 5 <mana></mana></bullet><bullet>Tier IV - 9 <mana></mana></bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.ArvikLoreConcept.name: Arvik the Dark
GLOBAL.ArvikLoreConcept.description:
Arvik was a talented necromancer from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept]Athla[/hyperlink], standing next to the Elven Court and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CommonwealthLoreConcept]Commonwealth[/hyperlink] when his home world was invaded. Together with his people, Arvik was cast into the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralVoidLoreConcept]Astral Void[/hyperlink], but the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PrimalSpiritsLoreConcept]Primal Spirit[/hyperlink] of the Glacial Mammoth gave him the strength to escape his [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowTrialLoreConcept]Torment of Shadows[/hyperlink].

The Risen Frostlings originate from Athla, but have since evolved under Arvik's cold rule. They believe power lies in strength of both mind and body, worshiping the resilient Glacial Mammoth as they fight to reclaim their frozen empire once more.

GLOBAL.AscendedInsectoidLoreConcept.name: Naz'ru Ka'zorak
GLOBAL.AscendedInsectoidLoreConcept.description:
Naz'ru isn't the smartest of his people, nor the wisest, or most charismatic. Above all, he is the biggest and the most protective, and among the first to shed the corruption of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrrathLoreConcept]Urrath[/hyperlink]. Under his rule, the dwellings of the Shadir'ko have evolved into thriving cities.

The Shadir'ko were once mindless thralls under the rule of Lithyl, corrupted by Urrath. Only after ages of neglect were they able to slowly and through much loss find their own identities, which they now viciously defend.

GLOBAL.AsgeraLoreConcept.name: Asgera Spinesplitter
GLOBAL.AsgeraLoreConcept.description:
Brutality is Asgera Spinesplitter! She rallies her Orcs with a covenant of conquest, and nothing stands forever against her might.

Bloodfang Orcs are not known for their love of flower arranging or carving fruit into the shapes of tiny animals. They do enjoy the rhythm and visual poetry that results from repeatedly bashing a foe's skull against a bloody rock until it caves in with a beautiful scarlet display of fleshy fireworks.

GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept.name: Ashlands
GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

A sprawling expanse of gray dust and ash. A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HutConcept]Hut[/hyperlink] can be built here.
Cities with Desolate Adaptation can build a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FarmConcept]Farm[/hyperlink] instead.

GLOBAL.AstralAttunementConcept.name: Astral Attunement
GLOBAL.AstralAttunementConcept.description: Links the target race to the Astral Sea, granting them:<bulletlist><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ETHEREAL]Ethereal[/hyperlink] unit type.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ATTUNEMENT_ASTRAL_OMEN]Attunement: Astral Omen[/hyperlink], granting a random [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PositiveStatusEffectConcept]Positive Status Effect[/hyperlink] when a spell is cast in combat.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.AstralBarrensConcept.name: Astral Barrens
GLOBAL.AstralBarrensConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

These lands have been eroded by a wind that rips all forms of magic from everyone and everything.
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MAGIC_ORIGIN]Magic Origin[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] do not regenerate [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept] Hit Points[/hyperlink] in this province.[hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapSpellConcept]World Map Spells[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpellConcept]Combat Spells[/hyperlink] cast in this province gain a 20% chance of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BackfireConcept]Backfiring[/hyperlink].No [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] income can be gained from this Province.[hyperlink,GLOBAL.NodeConcept]Resource Nodes[/hyperlink] in the province become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RuinedNodeConcept]Ruined[/hyperlink].Ruined Nodes cannot be restored while this province has Astral Barrens.Terrain cannot be altered by most spells and effects.

GLOBAL.AstralConcept.name: Astral Affinity
GLOBAL.AstralConcept.description:
Astral [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink] seeks to unravel the cosmic powers and harness the pure magic that shapes reality. Associated with Scrying, Illusions, Enchantment, Summoning, and Meta-magic.

Astral Affinity is opposed by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MateriumConcept]Materium Affinity[/hyperlink]. [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] with opposing affinities will suffer relation penalties.

GLOBAL.AstralEchoConcept.name: Astral Echoes
GLOBAL.AstralEchoConcept.description:
Astral Echoes are special resources gained through:
Astral Echoes [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PickupConcept]Pickups[/hyperlink], only visible to and collectible by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] of certain Mystic Subcultures.

This resource is used for [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EchoCastingConcept]Echo Casting[/hyperlink] by the Mystic School of Attunement.

This resource is used for [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EchoInfusionConcept]Echo Infusion[/hyperlink] by the Mystic School of Summoning.

GLOBAL.AyaLoreConcept.name: Aya the Enlightened
GLOBAL.AyaLoreConcept.description:
Aya's gaze has always drifted beyond the limits of the physical realm. It was her mind that elevated her to become guide to her people and ascended her to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godirhood[/hyperlink]. She has seen many futures and guides her people through them with kindness, but prejudice.

The Simians of the Open Hand value wisdom and harmony above all else, aiming for a life of peace and study. Once threatened, however, they use their inner strength to exploit the weaknesses of their adversaries.

GLOBAL.AzanyaLoreConcept.name: Azanya
GLOBAL.AzanyaLoreConcept.description:
Azanya was a solitary [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MaerLoreConcept]Maer[/hyperlink] who encountered a wandering wizard in the far reaches of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink]. Touched by his story and quest to find his lost love, Azanya eventually guided him to a dark realm named Tharru'Cath. She ignored her urge to flee the threatening darkness until it was too late, and both she and her wizard friend were captured. Since then, the corruption of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowRealmLoreConcept]Umbral Abyss[/hyperlink] has twisted her into something she barely recognizes.

The Enthralled Syrons are defined by their imprisonment on Tharru'Cath, where they laid eyes on their mythical ruler for the first time. Through better and worse, they follow their ruler's guiding song with a near-mindless fervor.

GLOBAL.BarbarianConcept.name: Barbarian
GLOBAL.BarbarianConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Has higher <food></food> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink] and <unitprod></unitprod> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitProductionConcept]Draft[/hyperlink] income.</bullet><bullet>Units have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.PRIMAL_MARK]Savage Strike[/hyperlink], dealing extra damage on a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CriticalHitConcept]Critical Hit[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.RitualAlacrityConcept]Ritual of Alacrity[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.BedrockConcept.name: Bedrock
GLOBAL.BedrockConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

Solid, unbreakable bedrock. Not viable for exploitation.

GLOBAL.BhajifLoreConcept.name: Bhajif Erranstar
GLOBAL.BhajifLoreConcept.description:
Be there an ancient artifact to uncover or a cosmic event to unfold, the Wanderer is ever present. Many question whether he follows the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralFlowsLoreConcept]Astral Flows[/hyperlink] to fortune, or whether fortune follows him instead. Is he the moth or the flame?

Bhajif refers to those who follow him as the Lost Travelers, for they walk in the footsteps of a man without direction. When his followers ask Bhajif what path they should take, he always replies: "Travelers, there is no path, for the path is made through walking."

GLOBAL.BirchfootLoreConcept.name: Birchfoot the Hermit
GLOBAL.BirchfootLoreConcept.description:
Birchfoot was never ambitious, but his spiritual visions ensured his rise within Grasshorn society. He is deemed a wise and thoughtful, albeit fretful ruler. When the burden of leadership becomes too heavy, Birchfoot seeks solace in the eye of a thunderstorm, where his connection to the Storm Crow is strongest.

Grasshorns believe themselves to be born from the roots of a lightning bolt, carrying their own likeness of the storms' strikes on their heads. They worship the Storm Crow and see wisdom as their greatest virtue.

GLOBAL.BlintUnderdelverLoreConcept.name: Blint the Underdelver
GLOBAL.BlintUnderdelverLoreConcept.description:
Blint listens. The earth trembles and he hears its murmurs. Patiently he waits below, hoarding his resources, until his means are sufficient to overwhelm the fools who waste their efforts on works of rock and stone to fortify themselves.

Blint's Mole-folk, dubbed by many as the Deep Dwellers, are known for outstanding levels of patience and cunning. They possess the knowledge and instinctive ability to both raise glorious structures as well as tear them down in the most efficient manner possible.

GLOBAL.BroodmasterConcept.name: Broodmaster
GLOBAL.BroodmasterConcept.description: <helpcolor>A ruler of Umbral Thralls, tainted by Urrath's corruption.</helpcolor>

GLOBAL.CaliothLoreConcept.name: Calioth
GLOBAL.CaliothLoreConcept.description:
Once an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archon[/hyperlink] Titan, Calioth fell during the Archon war against [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MyrridaLoreConcept]Myrrida[/hyperlink]. Recently, eldritch magic brutally tore him from his eternal rest, harnessing his rage against enemies he would once call ally. If any spark of light endures within him, it is long buried beneath the shroud of his dark, decaying flesh.

The Ancient [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RevenantsLoreConcept]Revenants[/hyperlink] were once Archons who fought and fell in the name of their divine purpose. Even in death, their struggle endures, for the very darkness they fought now pulls their strings.

GLOBAL.CapturedNoWarspoilsConcept.name: Captured
GLOBAL.CapturedNoWarspoilsConcept.description: Captured units may be recruited after combat by spending <gold></gold> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.ChasmConcept.name: Chasm
GLOBAL.ChasmConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

A gaping chasm full of lava cuts through this province. [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] annexing this province suffer -5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.CinrenLoreConcept.name: Cinren Toliath
GLOBAL.CinrenLoreConcept.description:
An attractive elf who nevertheless evokes an aura of haughty superiority, Cinren wears a perpetual sneer of lecherous intent. It is said that he has devoted much of his existence to the magical honing of carnal delights, often careening down dark and morally ambiguous pathways in order to reach undiscovered realms of pleasure.

The group of elves known as the Ashborn Hedonists follow Cinren Toliath and revere his godlike pursuit of pleasure. Powerful practitioners of magic in their own right, they seek to bring all under the sway of their master in order to provide more fodder towards his lecherous machinations.

GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept.name: City Stability
GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept.description:
City Stability represents your overall control over a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink].
High Stability boosts [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitProductionConcept]Draft[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] income.Low Stability reduces all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityIncomeConcept]City Income[/hyperlink].Very Low Stability can lead to the city losing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink].It drops as the city's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink] grows, and can be regained by building certain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStructureConcept]City Structures[/hyperlink].
80 to 100: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityHarmony]Harmony[/hyperlink].40 to 79: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityOrderly]Orderly[/hyperlink].10 to 39: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityStable]Stable[/hyperlink].-9 to 9: Neutral.-39 to -10: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityUnstable]Unstable[/hyperlink].-79 to -40: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityUnrest]Unrest[/hyperlink].-100 to -80: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityRioting]Rioting[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.CityStabilityRioting.name: Rioting
GLOBAL.CityStabilityRioting.description: -50% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityIncomeConcept]City Income[/hyperlink]. There is a chance that the provinces might defect from the city.

GLOBAL.CleansingFlamesHazard.name: Cleansing Flames
GLOBAL.CleansingFlamesHazard.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex:<bulletlist><bullet>Non-[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ZEAL]Zeal[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FAITHFUL]Faithful[/hyperlink] suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BURNING]Burning[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ZEAL]Zeal[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FAITHFUL]Faithful[/hyperlink] units lose -1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept]Negative Status Effects[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CONDEMNED]Condemned[/hyperlink] units lose -1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PositiveStatusEffectConcept]Positive Status Effects[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.CliffConcept.name: Cliff
GLOBAL.CliffConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

A steep cliff formed by a rocky drop-off. A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.QuarryConcept]Quarry[/hyperlink] can be built here.

GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept.name: Combat Casting Point
GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept.description:
These represent your ability to channel the precise magical energies needed to cast [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] during [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink].

They are refilled at the start of each battle.

GLOBAL.CriticalHitChanceConcept.name: Critical Hit Chance
GLOBAL.CriticalHitChanceConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>If a unit's attack is a Critical Hit, its damage is increased by +50%.</bullet><bullet>Critical Hits are usually caused by high <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Critical Hit chance can never be higher than an attack's chance to hit.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.CrocodileTempleConcept.name: Mire Crocodile Temple
GLOBAL.CrocodileTempleConcept.description: Annexed [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] with a Mire Crocodile Den and Provinces within a radius equal to the city tier:<bulletlist><bullet>Grant +5 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], one of the provinces gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SwampConcept]Swamp[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>Per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], one of the provinces loses [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChasmConcept]Chasm[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SnowConcept]Snow[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept]Ice[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept]Ashlands[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.CrowTempleConcept.name: Storm Crow Temple
GLOBAL.CrowTempleConcept.description: Annexed [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] with a Storm Crow Den and Surface Provinces within a radius equal to the city tier:<bulletlist><bullet>Grant +5 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], one of the Provinces gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FertilePlainsConcept]Grassland[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], one of the Provinces loses [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChasmConcept]Chasm[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SwampConcept]Swamp[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SnowConcept]Snow[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept]Ice[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept]Ashlands[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingConcept.name: Crystal Dwelling
