GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingConcept.description:
Crystal Dwellings are a type of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DwellingConcept]Dwelling[/hyperlink] inhabited by remnants of the Giant Kings in Lithorine forms.
Only 1 Crystal Dwelling exists within a realm.The only way to improve [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept] Allegiance[/hyperlink] with the Dwelling is through Quests.Having a Pact with the Crystal Dwelling will unlock several trading options with them, such as [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TomeConcept]Tome[/hyperlink] content, [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArtifactConcept]Artifacts[/hyperlink], Lithorine [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink], and revealing points of interests on the map.Once captured, a Crystal Dwelling is immediately destroyed and awards some of the Dwelling's trade items to the conqueror.

GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingStonePactConcept.name: Stone Pact
GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingStonePactConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingConcept]Crystal Dwelling[/hyperlink] opens its borders.</bullet><bullet>Unlocks purchase of the following trade items via Cooperation:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.TOKENDEFINITION.LITHORITE_SCROLL_ARTIFACT]Lithorite Scroll[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.LITHORINE_NEEDLER]Lithorine Needler[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.EQUIPMENT.GOLDSEEKERS_PICKAXE]Goldseekers pickaxe[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.EQUIPMENT.LITHORITE_ORB]Lithorite orb[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.EQUIPMENT.SHATTER_BLADES]Shatter blades[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.EQUIPMENT.TITANS_GREATBOW]Titans greatbow[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist></bullet><bullet>Completing Dwelling quests rewards guaranteed hero items in addition to their other rewards.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.DSAllianceConcept.name: Alliance
GLOBAL.DSAllianceConcept.description: The strongest bond two [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PlayerConcept]Players[/hyperlink] can share. While in an alliance, allied victories are possible when enabled, and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PlayerConcept]Players[/hyperlink] are automatically [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CallToWarConcept]called[/hyperlink] for aid in <rs_war></rs_war> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]Wars[/hyperlink]. Both sides will [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ReturnCapturedHeroesConcept]return their captured heroes[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.DafalDeaLoreConcept.name: Dafal Dea
GLOBAL.DafalDeaLoreConcept.description:
When the sharp mind of an Amphibian is driven by a divine calling, it can reach quite erudite heights. When, as in the case of Dafal, it ascends to roaming the seas to bring justice, it becomes a force to be reckoned with indeed.

The followers of Dafal Dea are as zealous as they are naturally amphibious. Long conversations about philosophy and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godirhood[/hyperlink] can often be heard drifting through the sea fog, to the accompaniment of excited croaks, when one of their vessels is close by.

GLOBAL.DarkConcept.name: Dark
GLOBAL.DarkConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Aggressive units that focus on damage over defense and healing.</bullet><bullet>Exploit defeated enemy heroes, depending on the chosen subculture.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.DecimusLoreConcept.name: Decimus the Unwavering
GLOBAL.DecimusLoreConcept.description:
Decimus was hand-picked by Nimue as a Ruler of her then latest created race, and proudly named Nimue's tenth favorite. He wore this honor with pride and responsibility, until his creator Goddess grew disappointed with him and his people for reasons unknown to any but herself. It was this guilt that led him to pursue a life of righteousness for him and his people, and it was this weight of responsibility that started him on his path to ascension.

The Atoning Toadmen were created by Nimue and once rose above many others, but must now answer for their sins. What sins and how, they are not sure, but they must atone nonetheless, and lead others on the same path of righteousness before their former Goddess, Nimue, can love them again.

GLOBAL.DeepOceanConcept.name: Deep Ocean
GLOBAL.DeepOceanConcept.description:
A water [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

Oceans can only be traversed through seafaring.

GLOBAL.DefaultPersonalityConcept.name: Default Personality
GLOBAL.DefaultPersonalityConcept.description: The default personality makes sure that the system will choose a personality for this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] automatically when it is AI controlled. Each personality has ties to one or several [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinities[/hyperlink] and may also have a preferred [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept]Alignment[/hyperlink], the combination of these, at the start of a session, determines which personality will be chosen automatically for your ruler if you encounter them as an AI ruler.

GLOBAL.DefaultVictoryConcept.name: Military Victory
GLOBAL.DefaultVictoryConcept.description: To achieve the Military Victory, an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] needs to defeat all other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DSAllianceConcept]Non-Allied[/hyperlink] empires. To defeat an empire, its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] needs to be [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RulerVoidConcept]Forced into the Astral Void[/hyperlink] and its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept]Throne City[/hyperlink] must be captured. If a Ruler is forced into the Astral Void, they will respawn at their Throne City unless it is captured by another empire.

GLOBAL.DemonkinConcept.name: Demonkin
GLOBAL.DemonkinConcept.description: Turns the target race into demonic beings, which grants them:<bulletlist><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.INFERNAL_FIEND]Infernal Fiend[/hyperlink] unit type.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLYING_MOVEMENT]Flying[/hyperlink], increasing mobility.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FRENZY]Frenzy[/hyperlink], increasing damage as they attack.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] of this race ignore the <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] penalty from Chasm and Lava in their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.DenounceConcept.name: Denounce
GLOBAL.DenounceConcept.description:
A denouncement is a verbal warning about a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievance[/hyperlink] that affects the targeted Ruler and their relations with other AI Rulers that you both have met.

A Ruler may only be denounced once for each unique Grievance a Ruler has against them.

Denouncing a Ruler using [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FabricatedCasusBelliConcept]Fabricated Grievances[/hyperlink] will cause them to have a grievance against you!

Denouncements can be made through [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PronouncementsConcept]Pronouncements[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.DestinyTraitConcept.name: Racial Destiny Traits
GLOBAL.DestinyTraitConcept.description:
When a race adapts to its surroundings and the actions of their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KeeperConcept]race keeper[/hyperlink], the race council may decide to proclaim a new era for their people. When they do, they approach the race keeper in an event, where it is decided if this change will manifest into a destiny trait.

Destiny traits change a race's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept]Alignment[/hyperlink] and need to be accepted with care, since they come with an inherent up- and downside.

GLOBAL.Devotion0Concept.name: Neutral
GLOBAL.Devotion0Concept.description: A neutral devotion level without broad benefits or detriments.

GLOBAL.DevouringVoidConcept.name: Devouring Void
GLOBAL.DevouringVoidConcept.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex:<bulletlist><bullet>Sustain 30 <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PhysicalDamageConcept]Physical Damage[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>Lose 3 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.DistractingConcept.name: Distracting
GLOBAL.DistractingConcept.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex will become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISTRACTED]Distracted[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.DragonHoardConcept.name: Dragon Hoard
GLOBAL.DragonHoardConcept.description: Hero Items in the Dragon's arsenal grant additional <gold></gold> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] income.<bulletlist><bullet>Tier I - 1 <gold></gold></bullet><bullet>Tier II - 3 <gold></gold></bullet><bullet>Tier III - 5 <gold></gold></bullet><bullet>Tier IV - 9 <gold></gold></bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.DungeonConcept.name: Dungeon
GLOBAL.DungeonConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

Underground terrain shaped into a fortified structure.

GLOBAL.EchoCastingConcept.name: Echo Casting
GLOBAL.EchoCastingConcept.description:
Echo casting allows the use of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralEchoesConcept]Astral Echoes[/hyperlink] to replace casting points, letting the user cast spells beyond the limit their casting points would otherwise allow.

Tactical spells that cost more [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Point[/hyperlink] than remain may substitute them with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralEchoesConcept]Astral Echoes[/hyperlink].
Strategic spells may be rushed while they are priming in the spellbook, costing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralEchoesConcept]Astral Echoes[/hyperlink] to substitute the remaining [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Point[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.EchoInfusionConcept.name: Echo Infusion
GLOBAL.EchoInfusionConcept.description:
Echo Infusion allows the use of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralEchoesConcept]Astral Echoes[/hyperlink] to empower [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MAGIC_ORIGIN]Magic Origin[/hyperlink] units granting them additional ranks.

The cost of this infusion is based on the remaining [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept] Experience[/hyperlink] required before the unit reaches the next rank.

GLOBAL.EdwardLoreConcept.name: Edward Portsmith
GLOBAL.EdwardLoreConcept.description:
Ever the resourceful and honest dreadnought, Edward Portsmith has been a beacon of hope for many who still uphold the values of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CommonwealthLoreConcept]Commonwealth[/hyperlink]. Since the World Seals on [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept]Athla[/hyperlink] were opened, his legend has only grown. Playing the role of the hero, however, can take its toll on those who don't process their own torment.

The soldiers of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CommonwealthLoreConcept]Commonwealth[/hyperlink] were the first line of defense when the World Seals on Athla were opened, but rather than glorious battle they found themselves adrift in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink]. After what seems like an eternity of torment, the Commonwealth Remnants struggle to uphold the values they once stood for.

GLOBAL.EldritchSovereignConcept.name: Eldritch Sovereign
GLOBAL.EldritchSovereignConcept.description:
An eldritch sorcerer commanding powers beyond mortal comprehension.
Eldritch Sovereigns have access to powerful control Hero Skills.Eldritch Sovereigns gain powerful unique [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroDedication]Hero Signature Skills[/hyperlink].Use [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThrallConcept]Thralls[/hyperlink] to cast powerful ritual [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink].Start with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.CLAIRVOYANCE_RITUAL]Clairvoyance Ritual[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ENTRHALL_POPULATION]Enthrall Population[/hyperlink].Eldritch Sovereigns are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_ELDRITCH_GOVERNOR]Eldritch Governors[/hyperlink].Eldritch Sovereigns have a 5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink] and cannot equip Leg and Mount items.

GLOBAL.ElectricallyChargedConcept.name: Electrically Charged
GLOBAL.ElectricallyChargedConcept.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex will become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ELECTRIFIED]Electrified[/hyperlink] for <eventColor>{timer}</eventColor> <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.EmbalmedSacrificeConcept.name: Embalmed Sacrifices
GLOBAL.EmbalmedSacrificeConcept.description:
Embalmed Sacrifices are gained by Embalming Heroes in your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CryptConcept]Crypt[/hyperlink].

Embalmed Sacrifices are used by the Dark Cult of Death for powerful city structures and a unique strategic spell.

GLOBAL.EternalCouncilConcept.name: Council Prolocutor
GLOBAL.EternalCouncilConcept.description: <helpcolor>Souls of ancient Elder Giants encased in crystal, who govern their Crystal Dwelling with a singular voice.</helpcolor>

GLOBAL.ExplosiveConcept.name: Explosive
GLOBAL.ExplosiveConcept.description: This obstacle will explode when destroyed, dealing damage to adjacent units.

GLOBAL.FangirLoreConcept.name: Fangir
GLOBAL.FangirLoreConcept.description:
When the stars light up the night's sky, it is said they are sparks from Fangir's Astral anvil. Once a talented Dwarven artificer, Fangir traveled to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink] and emerged with expanding interests. Where first he controlled rock and earth, he now aims to mold the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralFlowsLoreConcept]Astral Flows[/hyperlink] themselves.

Originating from Athlan Dwarves, the Moonrock Dwarves are great builders and runesmiths. When they followed Fangir into the Astral Sea to hunt for riches, they emerged with new insights and aspirations. Why dig and fight for one realm, when the stars themselves are there to be mined?

GLOBAL.FausterTheMeticulousLoreConcept.name: Fauster the Meticulous
GLOBAL.FausterTheMeticulousLoreConcept.description:
In a harsh society where the strongest thrived, Fauster was the weakest chick in a nest of seven. It was his intelligence and social aptitude that helped him survive and even thrive. Fauster has since then more than made up for his physical disadvantage and become the Avian Reavers' Master Alchemist.

The society of Avian Reavers took shape by their ruler's discovery of alchemy and Magelock weaponry, which revolutionized their so-called "primitive" heritage into a society of science and more efficient shows of force. Before, one's tail feathers decided one's social successes. Now the size of their guns and explosions matter most.

GLOBAL.FertilePlainsConcept.name: Grassland
GLOBAL.FertilePlainsConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

Rolling fields of fertile grassland. A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FarmConcept]Farm[/hyperlink] can be built here.

GLOBAL.FflammychLoreConcept.name: Fflammych Fyre-Heart
GLOBAL.FflammychLoreConcept.description:
Like many of his kin, Fflammych was born and raised amidst the rivalry between [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantsLoreConcept]Giants[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DragonsLoreConcept]Dragons[/hyperlink]. As the guardian of his hearth, Fflammych has seen many a battle and has always protected his kin and people with fire and blood. Recently, however, revelations of greater dangers than Dragons have dimmed the vengeance in his heart. Some say he even dares to question the ancient rivalries.

Fflammych's Hearthkin believe their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SoulsLoreConcept]Souls[/hyperlink] are forged in the heart of their Giant King, and thus they follow Fflammych with unwavering loyalty. As wielders of the soul-flame, their pyromancers are revered like priests.

GLOBAL.FjallaLoreConcept.name: Fjalla Tor-Builder
GLOBAL.FjallaLoreConcept.description:
A proud descendant of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantKingLoreConcept]Giant Kings[/hyperlink] of old, Fjalla carries the responsibility of her royal ancestors on her shoulders. Her father taught her about the beauty of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MyrridaLoreConcept]Myrrida[/hyperlink], and Fjalla vowed to see its glory reborn.

Fjalla's Jordvolk are proud artisans whose ancestry dates back to the empire of Myrrida, where they served Giant King Thrudgelmir before they pledged their loyalty to his daughter. Under the rule of Fjalla, they honed their craft to perfection, and feel confident of bringing the glory of Myrrida to the Realms once more.

GLOBAL.FloraObstacleConcept.name: Flora
GLOBAL.FloraObstacleConcept.description: Flora Obstacles are all obstacles that are plants.

GLOBAL.ForeignCityConcept.name: Foreign City
GLOBAL.ForeignCityConcept.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] belonging to an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] other than your own.

GLOBAL.ForestConcept.name: Forest
GLOBAL.ForestConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

A province full of various trees. A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ForesterConcept]Forester[/hyperlink] can be built here.

GLOBAL.FracturingWindsConcept.name: The Devouring Winds
GLOBAL.FracturingWindsConcept.description:
The Devouring Winds make casting [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapSpellConcept]World Map Spells[/hyperlink] dangerous, eventually culminating in a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CataclysmConcept]Cataclysm[/hyperlink].
Casting a World Map Spell adds its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink] cost to the Cataclysm Meter.When the Cataclysm meter is filled to 50% or more, [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] become marked for the next Cataclysm.When the Cataclysm Meter reaches the maximum. a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CataclysmConcept]Cataclysm[/hyperlink] is triggered.The higher the Level of the Cataclysm Meter, the more Provinces will be marked and struck during a Cataclysm.The Cataclysm Meter decreases by 10 per [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].For every Level of the Cataclysm Meter, all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] have 10% chance of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BackfireConcept]Backfiring[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.FredricLoreConcept.name: Fredric the Twice-Cursed
GLOBAL.FredricLoreConcept.description:
The fate of Fredric is a tragic one: cursed in life by the Lizardfolk and again in death by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrrathLoreConcept]Urrath's[/hyperlink] followers, Fredric and his kin of Archon descendants rose as undead [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RevenantsLoreConcept]Revenants[/hyperlink], driven by evil. Yet when the seals on [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept]Athla[/hyperlink] were shattered, their souls broke free from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrrathLoreConcept]Urrath's[/hyperlink] vile influence.

Since then, Fredric seeks a cure to the Revenant curse, fighting for the right of his people to exist and retain their Archon legacy.

GLOBAL.FrikkaLoreConcept.name: Frikka Dynosis
GLOBAL.FrikkaLoreConcept.description:
Frikka is an ancient Godir in the guise of a Halfling, with a penchant for cunning and frivolity. Her sharp mind and quicker wit are testament to the time spent learning from the Archons before their withdrawal. Ever a fickle being, her motivations are as changeable as the winds. Mischief and mayhem are interchangeable with seemingly selfless acts of kindness that leave those who deal with her reeling with confusion and reaching for an understanding that is simply unattainable!

The Gleeful Miscreants are the aptly named race of rat-like folk that worship Frikka as master and muse. They delight in the mischief she is so talented in sowing and will, at her behest, occasionally pretend to capture her in order to lure in hapless would-be rescuers. Like Frikka herself, their looks often serve to deceive those who gaze upon them and see only helpless vermin.

GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept.name: Ice
GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

A sprawl of icy flats. A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HutConcept]Hut[/hyperlink] can be built here.

GLOBAL.FungusFieldsConcept.name: Fungus Fields
GLOBAL.FungusFieldsConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

Sprawling fields full of nutritious mushrooms. A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FarmConcept]Farm[/hyperlink] can be built here, but factions without Underground Adaptation will suffer -2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.GaiasChosenConcept.name: Gaia's Chosen
GLOBAL.GaiasChosenConcept.description: Infuse the target race with the blessing of Nature. They gain:<bulletlist><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.PLANT]Plant[/hyperlink] unit type.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept]Negative Status Effects[/hyperlink] last -1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], with a minimum of 1.</bullet><bullet>+3 <statuseffectresistance></statuseffectresistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StatusResistanceConcept]Status Resistance[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>+20 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.GloomHooknailLoreConcept.name: Gloom Hooknail
GLOBAL.GloomHooknailLoreConcept.description:
Gloom Hooknail, the Dark Lady, rewards cruelty. She is fickle and deliberately impulsive, keeping her servants in a state of constant fear while competing for her favor. She loves cruel assassins and rewards the most deplorable acts of depravity, for they amuse her.

They creep deep in the dark, which they love and despise. Corrupted Goblins see the fair and laughing souls and let hate and envy fill them. They may not be strong in might, but their minds are devious and filled with a cruelty that horrifies.

GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept.name: Gloom
GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept.description:
Gloom terrain is normally only found in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowRealmLoreConcept]Umbral Abyss[/hyperlink].

[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] except [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MarauderConcept]Marauders[/hyperlink] within Gloom provinces suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHADOW_SICKNESS]Umbral Malady[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] suffer -10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] for every annexed Gloom [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] within their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.GoldtouchedConcept.name: Goldtouched
GLOBAL.GoldtouchedConcept.description: Makes the target race gain an affinity for gold, granting them:<bulletlist><bullet>+2 <resistance></resistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept]Resistance[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>+1 <gold></gold> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] per <population></population> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] in their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.HamBingerLoreConcept.name: Ham Binger
GLOBAL.HamBingerLoreConcept.description:
Ham Binger is a legendary Halfling whose curiosity endowed him with a form of immortality that is unique among his people. Notorious for escaping impossible situations, his people know that when Ham disappears, it’s time to make oneself scarce.

Wholesome Halflings pursue a life of simple joys and unsophisticated celebration. They thrive in communities that harbor cooperation, raising livestock and farming verdant hills.

GLOBAL.HeroConcept.name: Hero
GLOBAL.HeroConcept.description:
Heroes are important units that can lead [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink] and become powerful battle [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink].
Heroes are immune to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MIND_CONTROLLED]Final Ultimatum[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DOMINATED]Dominated[/hyperlink].

They are needed to:Explore [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonders[/hyperlink].Initiate a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeConcept]Siege[/hyperlink].Govern [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].Build [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OutpostConcept]Outposts[/hyperlink].
If a Hero dies and the opponent is victorious, the Hero will go to their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PrisonConcept]Prison[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CryptConcept]Crypt[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.HighConcept.name: High
GLOBAL.HighConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Has higher <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] and <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink] income.</bullet><bullet>Units are strengthened with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AWAKENED]Awakened[/hyperlink], revealing their hidden potential.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.AlignmentAgendaConcept]Alignment Agenda[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.HighMoraleConcept.name: High
GLOBAL.HighMoraleConcept.description:
The unit is in high spirits and confident of victory.

Effects:20% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CriticalHitConcept] Critical Hit Chance[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.HostageAllegianceConcept.name: Hostage Diplomacy
GLOBAL.HostageAllegianceConcept.description: The Dark Subculture "Cult of Tyranny" uses heroes in their prison to take control of Free Cities and exploit Vassals.<bulletlist><bullet>Defeated [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Heroes[/hyperlink] belonging to <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] become Hostages in your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PrisonConcept]Prison[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Hostages provide [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept]<allegiance></allegiance> Allegiance[/hyperlink] every turn and count as an assigned <whisperingStone></whisperingStone> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DiplomaticTokenConcept]Whispering Stone[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Conquered Cities released as Vassals also immediately grant you a Hostage.</bullet><bullet>When Vassalizing a city that belonged to another [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink], all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Heroes[/hyperlink] of that empire in your prison become hostages of this new Vassal instead.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.HrimisLoreConcept.name: Hrímis Glacier-Carver
GLOBAL.HrimisLoreConcept.description:
Hrímis was a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantsLoreConcept]Giant[/hyperlink] serving the ancient [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantKingLoreConcept]Giant Kings[/hyperlink] until the Giant Empire of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MyrridaLoreConcept]Myrrida[/hyperlink] fell to the combined forces of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DragonsLoreConcept]Dragons[/hyperlink]. Since then, she has been a recluse and avoids any contact with outsiders unless absolutely necessary. Perhaps the encroaching corruption by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowRealmLoreConcept]Umbral Abyss[/hyperlink] is one such necessity.

The Kaldbörn are the devoted servants of Hrímis, thriving within the frigid depths of the underground. Much like their Empress, they shun direct conflict, choosing instead to observe from the shadows as great empires crumble.

GLOBAL.HutConcept.name: Hut
GLOBAL.HutConcept.description:
A hut is a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvement[/hyperlink] that is available in extreme environments when a race does not have the adaptation to build farms in that climate.

A hut provides food but not as much as a farm.

GLOBAL.HykaLoreConcept.name: Hyka-Tha Agatare
GLOBAL.HykaLoreConcept.description:
In life, Hyka-Tha was a Grand Architect, known, respected, and revered. In death, she has risen as the advocate of the Awakened. Upon regaining consciousness, she sought her former allies for guidance and support in her corrupted state... But her prayers were answered with a sword wreathed in flames. Now, she wages war—not for vengeance, but for her kin.

More and more Awakened gather under Hyka-Tha's command. Now that they have regained awareness, they ask themselves: If the living also destroy and consume relentlessly, why are the undead denied the right to exist? And so, the deceased raise their necropolises—and their fallen kin—building an empire for those who once fell.

GLOBAL.IndependentCityNeutralConcept.name: Neutral diplomatic state with a Free City
GLOBAL.IndependentCityNeutralConcept.description: The default [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEDiplStateConcept]Diplomatic State[/hyperlink]. The <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free City[/hyperlink] and the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] have not yet [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept]negotiated[/hyperlink] any better terms. This can be done using a <whisperingStone></whisperingStone> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DiplomaticTokenConcept]Whispering Stone[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.IndustriousConcept.name: Industrious
GLOBAL.IndustriousConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Has higher <structureprod></structureprod> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] income.</bullet><bullet>Through [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BOLSTERING]Bolstering[/hyperlink], units get sturdier as they get hit in battle.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.ScoutProspectingConcept]Scout Prospecting[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.InsectoidWardenLoreConcept.name: Ryc'turi
GLOBAL.InsectoidWardenLoreConcept.description:
Once, Ryc'Turi was nothing but one drone in the hive-mind of her people, following the orders of their Sovereign Lithyl without question. In her absence, however, Ryc'Turi was the first of her people to take initiative beyond the direct orders she was given. Where this newly-found ambition will lead her, she herself hardly knows.

Born and raised on Tharru'Cath, the Shadac'har know very little beyond oppressive violence and blind loyalty to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrrathLoreConcept]Urrath[/hyperlink] and their overlords. Over time, however, they developed the power to communicate with other peoples and started to show an eagerness to build that their former Sovereign would undoubtedly deem mildly concerning.

GLOBAL.JuliaLoreConcept.name: Julia of House Inioch
GLOBAL.JuliaLoreConcept.description:
The last remaining Keeper of Life, Empress Julia stood against Death’s bloody star, defending flawed mortality even when its forces unleashed plagues upon a pristine paradise. She is one of the few remaining ancient immortal elves, uncorrupted by the ages and hardship she has endured. Torn from her family and homeland by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LithylTrueLoreConcept]Lithyl Nightweaver[/hyperlink], Julia was captured in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowRealmLoreConcept]Umbral Abyss[/hyperlink] and forced to watch helplessly as [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MerlinLoreConcept]Merlin[/hyperlink] traded his soul for her freedom. Despite it all, she balances life's resilience, allies with the peaceable way of nature, and despises those with vast ambitions and narrow visions.

The Exalted Elves have flocked to Julia like moths to a kind and peaceful flame. Like Julia, they aim to bring peace to ravaged realms, rebuilding them in harmony with nature.

GLOBAL.KarissaLoreConcept.name: Karissa the Red
GLOBAL.KarissaLoreConcept.description:
Love and hate burn as blinding embers in Karissa’s lusty savage eyes. She claims the impulse that drives life to the brink of violence. Strength begets strength. Ruthlessly, she will crush any weakness and they praise her for it. She is the true flame burning in the bosom of every mortal being.

Trusting in axe and spear, Enthralled Orcs crush their enemies. Every tradition is focused upon the sole purpose of domination and destruction. They enslave weaker beings to do the disparaging tasks like farming and gathering resources, but the best treasures are plundered from the soft.

GLOBAL.KhirUranonLoreConcept.name: Khir Uranon
GLOBAL.KhirUranonLoreConcept.description:
The name Khir Uranon has often been spoken in dreaded whisper. Those that know his name know him to be a demonic manipulator, whose mastery of the forge is fueled by a callous disregard for the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SoulsLoreConcept]souls[/hyperlink] he infuses his creations with.

The Blackfurred Forgelings are known for their prodigious strength and merciless cruelty, both aspects forged in the fires of their masters' ancient crucibles. Here, they help him utilize the souls of those that fall before them to power demonic artifacts.

GLOBAL.KledasLoreConcept.name: Kledas the Artist
GLOBAL.KledasLoreConcept.description:
Kledas once created for the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink], uniting nature and megaliths into breathtaking works of art. But his ambition drove him to create a wonder that defied the gods; and for that, he was cast out to suffer the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowTrialLoreConcept]Torment of Shadows[/hyperlink]. Now, Kledas roams the world, searching [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Wonders[/hyperlink] for remnants of his lost creations, desperate to remember who he was... and what he was capable of.

The Dwarves who follow Kledas are both his worshipers and his pupils. They consider him the ultimate artist, a creator of poetry in timeless forms. Every pupil strives to express their art in an unique way, guided by the teachings of their tormented master.

GLOBAL.KruulBlightlordLoreConcept.name: Kruul Blightlord
GLOBAL.KruulBlightlordLoreConcept.description:
Kruul embodies the prowess of his kin, despising any lies propagated against his people. He especially hates the one regarding their origins that suggests they were the result of a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir's[/hyperlink] experimentation crossbreeding rodents and humans, and that in a moment of bloodlust they ate their own creator. Any hint of that story will drive him into a murderous frenzy.

The Fiendish Rodents strive to embody their master's best qualities. As such, they are driven by an insatiable bloodlust and almost gleeful addiction to malevolence and pain.

GLOBAL.LaryssaLoreConcept.name: Laryssa Mirabilis
GLOBAL.LaryssaLoreConcept.description:
A powerful and cunning sorceress of Athla, Laryssa Mirabilis has played a pivotal role in forming the Torchbearers, who revealed a grand conspiracy involving [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept]Athla's[/hyperlink] most powerful nations. After being cast adrift together with her companion Edward Portsmith, Laryssa has used her skills to keep her people alive and their ideals upheld.

Laryssa's followers are those who value the spirit over the letter of the law. Rather than a supreme ruler, the Commonwealth Philosophers are led by a council that Laryssa represents. To these sorcerers, politics and intrigue are like a game of chess, and they take glee in playing it.

GLOBAL.LeaderConcept.name: Ruler
GLOBAL.LeaderConcept.description:
A Ruler is a unit who both represents and leads an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink]. They can lead [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink] and become powerful battle [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink].

Like a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Hero[/hyperlink], they are needed to:Explore [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonders[/hyperlink].Initiate a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeConcept]Siege[/hyperlink].Govern [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].Build [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OutpostConcept]Outposts[/hyperlink].
If a Ruler loses all of their HP in battle, they are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RulerVoidConcept]Forced into the Astral Void[/hyperlink].
If a Ruler is forced into the Astral Void and their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept]Throne City[/hyperlink] is captured, they lose the game.

GLOBAL.LithylLoreConcept.name: Lithyl Nightweaver
GLOBAL.LithylLoreConcept.description:
Rumors surround the origins of enigmatic Lithyl Nightweaver, the half-masked wizard who seemed to appear from the Astral Void itself. Shortly after her arrival on Magehaven she joined the Shad'rai on their quest for power over others. Charming and conniving, she seems to be one of many mad Godir, haunted by her Torment of Shadows. But Lithyl specifically stands out for her talent of appearing and disappearing at opportune times.

Not all who wander the Astral Sea are Godir. Many mortals find themselves lost in its depths, forgotten, with no divine power to save them. One Godir has taken it upon herself to save these lost souls. Lithyl Nightweaver reaches out an eldritch hand to pull the Forgotten Ones from the void, no matter how haunted and scarred it left them. Whatever her ulterior motives may be, Lithyl has won her people's undying devotion.

GLOBAL.LithylTrueLoreConcept.name: Lithyl Nightweaver (True Form)
GLOBAL.LithylTrueLoreConcept.description:
Once a powerful Wizard, Lithyl Nightweaver fell to her [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowTrialLoreConcept]Torment of Shadows[/hyperlink] and became [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LostWizardLoreConcept]Lost[/hyperlink], before the dark god [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrrathLoreConcept]Urrath[/hyperlink] twisted her blind insanity and broken body into something considerably more menacing. After a time of imprisonment wrought upon her by the Elven princess Sundren, Lithyl returns to exact her revenge on her captor, [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept]Athla[/hyperlink], and the entire [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink].

Not all who wander the Astral Sea are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink]. Many mortals find themselves lost in its depths, forgotten, with no divine power to save them. Still, some may consider oblivion a more merciful fate than to be found by Lithyl Nightweaver, the Harbinger of Urrath, who extends an eldritch hand and strangles those in her grasp until they are nothing but mindless thralls in her game of corruption.

GLOBAL.LowMoraleConcept.name: Low
GLOBAL.LowMoraleConcept.description:
The unit is wavering and doubtful of victory.

Effects:Fumble Chance: 20%.

GLOBAL.MaelLoreConcept.name: Mael
GLOBAL.MaelLoreConcept.description:
Her mother was the ocean, her father the storm. Mael was born from the fury of a tempest, there where the sea meets the sky. Sailors swear she is the voice that follows the lightning, the Singer of Storms. And so they chant her song when black clouds darken their sails, praying for her mercy.

If you have ever crossed the sea, you have heard the tale of those who ride the waves, belting out the oncoming storm. The story of a civilization who harmonize and magically amplify their voices to sing with the tempest—or to summon it. Some even say that this is why the primordial appears in the likeness of an Elf, drawn by the devotion of the Storm Choir.

GLOBAL.MagelockLoreConcept.name: Magelock Weaponry
GLOBAL.MagelockLoreConcept.description:
Magelock weapons are magic-powered ranged weapons, derived from the ordnance created by mighty empires long since fallen. By fusing the arcane with the physical, Magelock mechanisms allow skilled marksmen to hit faraway targets with great impact and accuracy.

Magelock weaponry permeates all corners of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink], implying analogous origins on various realms, yet the remnants of the ruined [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CommonwealthLoreConcept]Commonwealth[/hyperlink] remain most infamous for wielding these terrible weapons.

GLOBAL.MagicStrikeConcept.name: Magic Strike
GLOBAL.MagicStrikeConcept.description:
Magic Strikes are a type of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicConcept]Magic[/hyperlink] attack with a range of 1 hex.

They are available to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MAGIC_FIGHTER]Magic Fighter Units[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Heroes[/hyperlink] with Magic Strike weapons.

GLOBAL.MagicVictoryConcept.name: Magic Victory
GLOBAL.MagicVictoryConcept.description:
To achieve the Magic Victory, an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] needs to cast and sustain a number of Bind Gold [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonder[/hyperlink] spells, unlocked when you choose a Tier III [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TomeConcept]Tome[/hyperlink].

When you choose a Tier V [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TomeConcept]Tome[/hyperlink], you unlock the Magic Victory Spell of the same affinity as the tome. You may cast it when having enough Bound Ancient Wonders.

Channeling the spell takes 15 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink] until victory is achieved. If you lose a bound Ancient Wonder and would no longer have a sufficient amount, the spell will be canceled.

GLOBAL.MalielLoreConcept.name: Maliel
GLOBAL.MalielLoreConcept.description:
When the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink] cast their Celestial hosts into war, Archpaladin Maliel steers his heavenly chariot headmost. With cleansing flame he descends on the wicked and with zealous conviction he drills his sacred warriors. He is a Paragon of the Order of Highmen and as such propagates their beliefs across the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink].

The Highmen are the disciples of an Archon Order with high emphasis on martial prowess. Their history is deeply interwoven with the Human race, who they fostered on many [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds Within[/hyperlink]. Through virtuous lives some of those Humans would then ascend to Archonhood—and become Highmen themselves.

GLOBAL.MammothTempleConcept.name: Glacial Mammoth Temple
GLOBAL.MammothTempleConcept.description: Annexed [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] with a Glacial Mammoth Den and Provinces within a radius equal to the city tier:<bulletlist><bullet>Grant +5 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], one of the Provinces gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SnowConcept]Snow[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept]Ice[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>Per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], one of the Provinces loses [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChasmConcept]Chasm[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FertilePlainsConcept]Grassland[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SwampConcept]Swamp[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RiverConcept]River[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept]Ashlands[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CavernFloorConcept]Cavern Floor[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FungusFieldsConcept]Fungus Fields[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.MateriumConcept.name: Materium Affinity
GLOBAL.MateriumConcept.description:
Materium [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink] relates to physical magic. It is associated with resource extraction, transmutation and mastery over the mundane physical world.

Materium Affinity is opposed by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralConcept]Astral Affinity[/hyperlink]. [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] with opposing affinities will suffer relation penalties.

GLOBAL.MeandorLoreConcept.name: Meandor
GLOBAL.MeandorLoreConcept.description:
A harbinger of intrigue, Meandor is the first Prince of the ancient tradition of Dark Elves. He plots against allies and enemies alike. He once experienced death and found it unsatisfying. He now respects his sister Julia, but won't hesitate to stab a dagger through her plans. His followers see him as a symbol of vengeance, but he prefers to shirk ideologies. He revels in remaining a wild card in the realm of diplomatic games. Yet, he, too, is haunted by his own demons.

Dark Elves lurk in the deep shadows, plotting vengeance upon humanity and the fair races that tolerate them. They will never forget how men stole their lands. Dark Elves enslave weaker races and train them in cruelty, using them to achieve their nefarious purposes. They are masters of stealth, known to favor a well placed blade in the back over a fair fight.

GLOBAL.MegairaLoreConcept.name: Megaira the Scalded
GLOBAL.MegairaLoreConcept.description:
Megaira was born in the fires of her burning parental home. Since then she has fought for her place in the world of the Pyrekin. She has slain many who challenged her, and even more who happened to be in her way, with tooth and fist if necessary. Thus, she was given the title of Thornfist.

The Pyrekin believe they were born from the heart of the flame that devours the worlds, and thus they need to feed the flame in their hearts. No challenge unanswered, no deed undone, they charge into battle like an inferno and burn all they deem unworthy.

GLOBAL.MelenisLoreConcept.name: Melenis
GLOBAL.MelenisLoreConcept.description:
The cruelest Dark Elf assassins revere this Godir, Dancer of Death, Melenis. Once the lithe mistress to Prince Meandor, she died and rose a deadly creature of undeath. Vanquished in that form, she revived anew as queen to Dark Elf assassins. Some say her mad dance between life and death leaves her fixated upon vengeance. Her bitter life taught her that all succumb to death and only fools dare hope.

These sinister Undead Lichbringers seek to master the ghastly secrets of their deadly mistress, Melenis. They tread a trail of stolen lives, steeped in tragedy. They know of no atrocity that will stay their hand from the relentless pursuit of life and death and unlife and undeath, through cultic means and forbidden lore.

GLOBAL.MerlinLoreConcept.name: Merlin
GLOBAL.MerlinLoreConcept.description:
As a young human prince, Merlin was chosen by the Archon Gabriel to restore the balance of power on [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept]Athla[/hyperlink]. The Wizard's Circle, the All-Devourer, the Shadowborn—as a masterful wizard of the cosmos, Merlin protected the people of Athla throughout the Ages even after he had withdrawn from power, exploring large parts of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink]. At last he was betrayed by his own love, falling into the clutches of Lithyl Nightweaver in a desperate attempt to save Julia of House Inioch from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrrathLoreConcept]Urrath's grasp[/hyperlink]. Now, reshaped into an Eldritch Sovereign through Urrath's vile corruption, all that Merlin desires appears to be for the cosmos to swiftly end so that all suffering and agony of the world may forever be forgotten.

The Umbral Humans are Merlin's instrument of annihilation. They bring oblivion to the realms he treads, as oblivion is what their master desires.

GLOBAL.MesharaLoreConcept.name: Meshara the Radiant
GLOBAL.MesharaLoreConcept.description:
Meshara grew up as the daughter of a knight and a priest. Her people say divine righteousness runs through her blood. Yet, she tries to stay humble—or as humble as one can be, when one is named the Prophetess of her entire people.

The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink] are said to be the most legendary protectors of the worlds, and the Human Paladins believe themselves to be a close second. Led by their Prophetess, they aim to bring justice to all living beings on the realms they decide to save.

GLOBAL.MoistConcept.name: Water
GLOBAL.MoistConcept.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex will become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WET]Wet[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.MountainConcept.name: Mountain
GLOBAL.MountainConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

A habitable province with some mountains. A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.QuarryConcept]Quarry[/hyperlink] can be built here.

GLOBAL.MushroomForestConcept.name: Mushroom Forest
GLOBAL.MushroomForestConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

A dense forest full of enormous mushrooms. A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ForesterConcept]Forester[/hyperlink] can be built here.

GLOBAL.MysticConcept.name: Mystic
GLOBAL.MysticConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Has higher <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] income.</bullet><bullet>Powerful interactions with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink], depending on their subculture.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.NekronLoreConcept.name: Nekron the Risen
GLOBAL.NekronLoreConcept.description:
Driven by hunger, Nekron brings death to everyone and anyone impartially. He prefers to rule cities of undead, freed from disturbing qualities like free thought and disobedience. Control your emotions, for Nekron is attracted to suffering.

The Cruel Deathbringers were once something one could call Human. Now, they are little more than soulless husks who follow the bidding of their Arch Lich.

GLOBAL.NeutralMoraleConcept.name: Neutral
GLOBAL.NeutralMoraleConcept.description:
The unit is content and ready for battle.

Effects:None.

GLOBAL.NimueLoreConcept.name: Nimue
GLOBAL.NimueLoreConcept.description:
Her mind is a torrent of unpredictable chaos. She wills it and her children rise from the surge, breathing her very lifeblood. Like the tide beating against the changing coastline, so too is Nimue among the Godir. Her power is undeniable, yet her moods swirl like waves in a tide pool. Her children all accept that, inevitably, all will find themselves drowned in a watery grave.

Obsequious and ever condescending, Nimue's Chosen Children know that their time as her favored creations is limited, and if they're not careful, they will all end up drowned in the depths. Fortunately, these clever amphibians have an affinity for water, and know ways of quietly slipping beneath the surface when her storms start churning up the muck.

GLOBAL.NoctusLoreConcept.name: Noctus
GLOBAL.NoctusLoreConcept.description:
Only one day after being named High Chancellor of his people, Noctus was poisoned. His feats of necromancy allowed him to not only return from the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralVoidLoreConcept]Astral Void[/hyperlink] as a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WizardKingLoreConcept]Wizard King[/hyperlink], but also to bring back the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SoulsLoreConcept]souls[/hyperlink] of his forefathers, who taught him the secrets of death and eternity... and exacted revenge on those who wronged him.

The Erudite Orcs share an almost obsessive interest in history and death. Always searching for a way to extend their massive libraries, they thread the needle between archaeology and grave robbing as they sometimes bring back the dead themselves to verify their research.

GLOBAL.OathOfHarmony.name: Oath of Harmony
GLOBAL.OathOfHarmony.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DevotionConcept]Devotion[/hyperlink] by:<bulletlist><bullet>Having a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEVassalConcept]Vassal[/hyperlink] of another Race +20 <devotedact></devotedact>.</bullet><bullet>Clearing an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestation[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonder[/hyperlink] +15 <devotedact></devotedact>.</bullet><bullet>Making a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TruceConcept]Truce[/hyperlink] +10 <devotedact></devotedact>.</bullet><bullet>Forgiving a <casusBelli></casusBelli> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievance[/hyperlink] +5 <devotedact></devotedact>.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet><bullet>Lose [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DevotionConcept]Devotion[/hyperlink] by:<bulletlist><bullet>Starting a <rs_war></rs_war> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink] -30 <undevotedact></undevotedact>.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.RazingConcept]Razing[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MigratingConcept]Migrating[/hyperlink] a hostile [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] -20 <undevotedact></undevotedact>.</bullet><bullet>Fabricating a <casusBelli></casusBelli> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievance[/hyperlink] -20 <undevotedact></undevotedact>.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.OathOfRighteousness.name: Oath of Righteousness
GLOBAL.OathOfRighteousness.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DevotionConcept]Devotion[/hyperlink] by:<bulletlist><bullet>Having good alignment, +1 <devotedact></devotedact> per <reputation6></reputation6> point.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet><bullet>Lose [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DevotionConcept]Devotion[/hyperlink] by:<bulletlist><bullet>Having evil alignment, -1 <undevotedact></undevotedact> per <reputation2></reputation2> point.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.OathOfStrife.name: Oath of Strife
GLOBAL.OathOfStrife.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DevotionConcept]Devotion[/hyperlink] by:<bulletlist><bullet>Entering <rs_war></rs_war> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]Wars[/hyperlink] +15 <devotedact></devotedact>.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.RazingConcept]Razing[/hyperlink] a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] +10 <devotedact></devotedact>.</bullet><bullet>Not letting units rout in events +5 <devotedact></devotedact>.</bullet><bullet>Winning in combat:<bulletlist><bullet>With lower army power +4 <devotedact></devotedact>.</bullet><bullet>With higher army power +2 <devotedact></devotedact>.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist></bullet><bullet>Lose [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DevotionConcept]Devotion[/hyperlink] by:<bulletlist><bullet>Entering a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TruceConcept]Truce[/hyperlink] -20 <undevotedact></undevotedact>, <rs_defensivepact></rs_defensivepact> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DefensivePactConcept]Defensive Pact[/hyperlink] -15 <undevotedact></undevotedact>, or <rs_alliance></rs_alliance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DSAllianceConcept]Alliance[/hyperlink] -30 <undevotedact></undevotedact>.</bullet><bullet>Making a <rs_vassalage></rs_vassalage> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageConcept]Pact of Vassalage[/hyperlink] -20 <undevotedact></undevotedact>.</bullet><bullet>Losing an owned [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] -10 <undevotedact></undevotedact>.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.OathswornConcept.name: Oathsworn
GLOBAL.OathswornConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Has higher <unitprod></unitprod> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitProductionConcept]Draft[/hyperlink] income.</bullet><bullet>Swear [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DevotionConcept]Devotion[/hyperlink] to an oath that guides their people.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.OceanConcept.name: Ocean
GLOBAL.OceanConcept.description:
A water [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

One or more bodies of water is present in this province. A water [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FarmConcept]Farm[/hyperlink] can be built here.

GLOBAL.OnFireConcept.name: On Fire
GLOBAL.OnFireConcept.description:
Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex will be inflicted with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BURNING]Burning[/hyperlink].
Has a chance of spreading to nearby flammable obstacles.

GLOBAL.OneronLoreConcept.name: O'neron
GLOBAL.OneronLoreConcept.description:
Born as a thrall within the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowRealmLoreConcept]Umbral Abyss[/hyperlink], O'neron returned his people their freedom when he joined arms with the Wizard Kings of the Second Age on [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept]Athla[/hyperlink] to destroy the All-Devourer. Since then, he has traveled the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink], reaching other realms of free Syron civilizations. Through the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomwatchLoreConcept]Gloomwatch[/hyperlink], he rediscovered his history and heritage, forever linked to Athla.

The Gloomwatch Syrons sail the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink] in search and protection of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DreamersLoreConcept]Dreamers[/hyperlink]. They are gifted in the arcane and have developed high versatility when resisting the fell reach of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrrathLoreConcept]Urrath[/hyperlink] and its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowRealmLoreConcept]Umbral Abyss[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.OttoDiscardedLoreConcept.name: Otto the Discarded
GLOBAL.OttoDiscardedLoreConcept.description:
Once, Otto was Nimue's eighth favorite, and for a short while everything was good. Being abandoned by his Goddess initiated his ascension to Godirhood, although he fears what these powers may do to him. Now he leads the people who call themselves Recreants, wearing the shame of Nimue's abandonment as a banner. Whether Godirhood is a blessing or a curse to the created Otto… only time will tell.

The Drowned Recreants were once named Nimue's Chosen Children and a friend to beast and man alike. They were loved by their Goddess, and they loved her in return. She, however, eventually grew disappointed with their flaws and discarded them, drowning many in her wrath. Now, those who remain call themselves the Drowned Recreants and are trying to start a civilization of their own, though many still fear the wrath of their former Goddess.

GLOBAL.PersonalityDislikeConcept.name: Dislike
GLOBAL.PersonalityDislikeConcept.description: Dislikes are part of how an AI Ruler perceives other Rulers and determines which Actions or statuses of another Ruler they will dislike. Relations with Rulers that trigger these dislikes will incur a relation penalty.

GLOBAL.PetrasCelenaLoreConcept.name: Petras Celena
GLOBAL.PetrasCelenaLoreConcept.description:
There have always been people like Petras: those born with such a profound sensitivity to the stars that the constellations themselves emerge upon their flesh. But destiny had something even greater prepared for Petras, and so she awakened the Eye of Prophecies. For she is the Weaver of Fates, the one who mends unraveled destinies and guides the Children of the Stars.

As Oracles read the skies, the Stars' Children read their own skin, following the dictates of their marks as a duty to fulfill. They are guided towards mysterious tasks, whose consequences they do not seek to understand. Yet, some whisper that their Weaver is able to see the threads combine into the greater story called the Tapestry of Destiny.

GLOBAL.PlayerConcept.name: Players
GLOBAL.PlayerConcept.description: A player is a human or AI commanding an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] and its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PoisonousConcept.name: Poisonous
GLOBAL.PoisonousConcept.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex will become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.POISONED]Poisoned[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PrimalConcept.name: Primal
GLOBAL.PrimalConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Has higher <food></food> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink] income.</bullet><bullet>Alter provinces into the Primal Animal's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FavoredTerrainConcept]Favored Terrain[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.ProvinceAnnexationConcept.name: Province Annexation
GLOBAL.ProvinceAnnexationConcept.description:
Province Annexation is the process of expanding your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink] by building a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvement[/hyperlink].
Increase the distance a city can annex provinces by upgrading your town hall.Annex provinces from your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEVassalConcept]Vassals[/hyperlink] by paying [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink].Annex ruined provinces from enemy cities by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PillagingConcept]Pillaging[/hyperlink] them first.

GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept.name: Province
GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept.description:
An area on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink] marked by borders.

Provinces:Have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Features[/hyperlink], which determine the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvements[/hyperlink] that can be built there.Can be [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceAnnexationConcept]annexed[/hyperlink] to a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] by building a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvement[/hyperlink] within.May contain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NodeConcept]Resource Nodes[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PickupConcept]Pickups[/hyperlink], or an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonder[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept.name: Province Feature
GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept.description:
The natural feature of a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink], such as a forest, river, or grassy plain.

Determines which [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvements[/hyperlink] can be built in a Province.

Note that you can only build Improvements allowed by province features that share the same geography type as the center of the province (Land, Lava, Water, and Void). For example, [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OceanConcept]Ocean[/hyperlink] only grants the ability to build a Fishing Farm if the center of the province consists of a water feature.

GLOBAL.PvEVassalConcept.name: City Vassalage
GLOBAL.PvEVassalConcept.description:
Free Cities can be vassalized by Rulers through [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept]Negotiations[/hyperlink] or by converting an owned or conquered [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] into a vassal city.

Vassal cities have many advantages:They will share their income and magic materials.They will aid you in wars.They will grant you vision of their domain.Vassal cities may eventually also be [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfIntegrationConcept]integrated[/hyperlink] into the Ruler's empire.

GLOBAL.RacheqLoreConcept.name: Ra'cheq the Disturbing
GLOBAL.RacheqLoreConcept.description:
Ra'cheq was, as he himself proclaims, but an insect, living in the dirt and feeding on scraps. Until one day the sun eclipsed, the stars darkened and the world was embraced by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrrathLoreConcept]Urrath[/hyperlink]. Ra'cheq was the first to crawl from under the rubble and he believes that is why he was Chosen to lead his newly awakened people to greatness.

Ra'cheq's followers believe themselves to be the chosen disciples of Urrath, their dark god. They are prone to violence and jealousy, vying for their god's corrupted love without hesitation to betray even their own kin if their High Corruptor demands it.

GLOBAL.RainaTheGoldenLoreConcept.name: Raina the Golden
GLOBAL.RainaTheGoldenLoreConcept.description:
Raina was a powerful Human queen, who cared more for grandeur than for her subjects. One day an especially scorned and magically adept subject turned the Queen into a toad. Only a life of moderation can break the curse, but since Raina and her people have been toads for generations, this has proven to be an unsurmountable task.

The Cursed Toadlings originated as Raina's most faithful followers. After the first shock of the curse had diminished, they accepted their new existence as semi-aquatic humanoids with valor.

GLOBAL.ReaverConcept.name: Reaver
GLOBAL.ReaverConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Powerful ranged units with a high damage output.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.ReinforcementRuleConcept.name: Reinforcement Rule
GLOBAL.ReinforcementRuleConcept.description:
The Reinforcement Rule allows up to 3 friendly [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink] that are within 3 hexes of a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink] engagement on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink] to join one of the combatants.

There are exceptions to this rule. [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combat[/hyperlink] while exploring an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonder[/hyperlink] only allows 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Army[/hyperlink] to participate on each side. Furthermore, [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LocationConcept]Locations[/hyperlink] such as [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationSpawnerConcept]Infestation Spawners[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] under [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeConcept]Siege[/hyperlink] will not join [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatConcept]Combats[/hyperlink] outside of their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LocationConcept]Location[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.RiverConcept.name: River
GLOBAL.RiverConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

A river runs through this province. Grants +2 Food to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FarmConcept]Farms[/hyperlink] built in this province.

GLOBAL.RockyConcept.name: Rocky
GLOBAL.RockyConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

Rough lands of exposed rock. A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.QuarryConcept]Quarry[/hyperlink] can be built here.

GLOBAL.RootNodeLoreConcept.name: Root Node
GLOBAL.RootNodeLoreConcept.description: As a Godir's might grows, they begin to gain an almost innate understanding and attunement to places of powerful resonance. Root Nodes are physically manifest confluences of ambient magic present throughout the land. The mightiest of Godir can sense these locations and even manipulate and alter the latent magics therein to reflect their own affinities.

GLOBAL.RoutingConcept.name: Routing
GLOBAL.RoutingConcept.description:
The unit is terrified and is fleeing for its life!

Effects:Ignores zones of control and attacks of opportunity.25% harder to hit with ranged attacks.Moves toward nearest [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RetreatingConcept]Retreat Point.[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.SabertoothTempleConcept.name: Ash Sabertooth Temple
GLOBAL.SabertoothTempleConcept.description: Annexed [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] with an Ash Sabertooth Den and Provinces within a radius equal to the city tier:<bulletlist><bullet>Grant +5 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], one of the Provinces gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept]Ashlands[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>Per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], one of the Provinces loses [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RiverConcept]River[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FertilePlainsConcept]Grassland[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SwampConcept]Swamp[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SnowConcept]Snow[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept]Ice[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CavernFloorConcept]Cavern Floor[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FungusFieldsConcept]Fungus Fields[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SandConcept.name: Sand
GLOBAL.SandConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

A rolling landscape of golden sand. A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HutConcept]Hut[/hyperlink] can be built here.
Cities with Desert Adaptation can build a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FarmConcept]Farm[/hyperlink] here instead.

GLOBAL.ScoreVictoryConcept.name: Score Victory
GLOBAL.ScoreVictoryConcept.description:
The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] with the highest score when the turn limit is reached is victorious.

There are 5 categories which influence your score: Military, Diplomacy, Economy, Expansion and Research. How well you do in each category compared to the other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] is what determines your overall score ranking. This is dependent on many variables, these are some examples:Military: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitProductionConcept]Draft[/hyperlink] income, army power, and killing enemies.Diplomacy: Having allies and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEVassalConcept]Vassals[/hyperlink], avoid wars, and don’t cause [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievances[/hyperlink].Expansion: Amount of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink] income.Research: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] income.Economy: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] income.

GLOBAL.SealLoreConcept.name: World Seal
GLOBAL.SealLoreConcept.description: <lorefontsize><lorefont>Seals were built by order of the ancient [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink], to protect the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds Within[/hyperlink] from the influences of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink]... or the other way around. Whoever activates these powerful structures will have full control over anyone who enters or leaves the realm. Thus, the Seals were left heavily guarded. On most worlds, these arcane machinations now lie dormant and forgotten... Unless a powerful [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] finds a way to activate them once more.</lorefont></lorefontsize>

GLOBAL.SealsVictoryConcept.name: Seals Victory
GLOBAL.SealsVictoryConcept.description:
To achieve the Seals Victory, an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] needs to accumulate enough points from capturing and holding Seals.

Seals are found throughout the world and can be captured at any time. For each seal you have captured, you gain 1 point each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink]. During this time, Seal defenders will spawn every few [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink] at one of your claimed Seals and attempt to take back the Seal from your control. If you control more Seals, they will spawn more often.

The Seals Victory has to be enabled by adding one of the Seal Realm Traits.

GLOBAL.SerenaLoreConcept.name: Serena
GLOBAL.SerenaLoreConcept.description:
Serena is a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WizardKingLoreConcept]Wizard[/hyperlink] of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept]Athla[/hyperlink] and claimed to be master of life, elves and their eternal trees. After her banishment, Serena was [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowTrialLoreConcept]tormented[/hyperlink] by visions of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds[/hyperlink] destroyed by lesser people. Now rooted with religious conviction, she preaches the eradication of those who would threaten the delicate natural balance.

The Verdant Elves are Serena's most loyal followers. The forests are their home, and they will defend it with all their ageless might. They follow the guidance of the Sylvan Wolf and idolize their eerily beautiful Wizard of Life.

GLOBAL.SerpentTempleConcept.name: Dune Serpent Temple
GLOBAL.SerpentTempleConcept.description: Annexed [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] with a Dune Serpent Den and Surface Provinces within a radius equal to the city tier:<bulletlist><bullet>Grant +5 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], one of the Provinces gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], one of the provinces loses [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RiverConcept]River[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChasmConcept]Chasm[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FertilePlainsConcept]Grassland[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SwampConcept]Swamp[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SnowConcept]Snow[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept]Ice[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept]Ashlands[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CavernFloorConcept]Cavern Floor[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FungusFieldsConcept]Fungus Fields[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.ShadowCrisisConcept.name: Shadow Crisis
GLOBAL.ShadowCrisisConcept.description:
Your struggle with the forces of Shadow weakens your rule, temporarily decreasing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] in all of your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Shadow Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.SharpConcept.name: Sharp
GLOBAL.SharpConcept.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex will be inflicted with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BLEEDING]Bleeding[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.ShiraLoreConcept.name: Shira Snowblood
GLOBAL.ShiraLoreConcept.description:
Shira was born the heir of her people. During her coronation, the Shad'rai invaded her realm, killed her family and cast her into the Astral Void. Shira would have been Lost if not for the aid of Meandor, who guided her to Magehaven, where she joined the Covenant and learned to channel her grief into primal prowess. After a heroic return and a fierce battle against the usurping Shad'rai Godir, she retook her homeland.

Arctic Felines are a proud people who adjusted to the icy tundra of Cantarra, their homeworld. After the return of their long-lost Queen, they followed her through the depths of the Astral Sea and back to avenge their fallen royal family and thwart the plans of the Shad'rai.

GLOBAL.SilverSeasLoreConcept.name: The Silver Seas
GLOBAL.SilverSeasLoreConcept.description:
The legend of the Silver Seas is anchored in the mind of every sailor. Ancient sea shanties tell of a place in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds Within[/hyperlink] where the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralFlowsLoreConcept]Astral Currents[/hyperlink] converge, with seas so rich that their very waves are made of liquid silver. There, fish with scales of precious metals swim among reefs of pure mana, while the songs of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MaerLoreConcept]Maers[/hyperlink] lull the shores.

Some seafarers theorize that the waves of the Silver Seas lie hidden within [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TidolonLoreConcept]Tidolon[/hyperlink]; others believe that their tides are yet to be found. Still, there are those who claim that this paradise is not a place to find, but a place to seek.

GLOBAL.SingaithLoreConcept.name: Singaith Sky-Shatter
GLOBAL.SingaithLoreConcept.description:
As a rumored descendant of one of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TraitorKingsLoreConcept]Traitor Kings[/hyperlink], Singaith seems to have inherited her ancestors' obsession with power and immortality. Reclusive and self-centered, she values knowledge over any form of other fleeting relationship as she schemes for the glory of her kin to rise again.

Like their ruler Singaith and the Traitor Kings of old, the Galetoads are obsessed with achieving eternal life. Through the magic of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SoulsLoreConcept]Soul[/hyperlink] and the knowledge of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EternalCouncilLoreConcept]Eternal Council[/hyperlink], they hope to make their eternal dream a reality... through any means necessary.

GLOBAL.SkonyruLoreConcept.name: Skonyru
GLOBAL.SkonyruLoreConcept.description:
Ever watchful and bold, Grand Vindicator Skonyru judges those who threaten the meek, descending upon them with grim anger. Said to originate from a forgotten kingdom in which the larger and smaller races lived together in harmony, Skonyru is determined to carry on the legacy of his forebears—a noble mission which earned him the allegiance of the Graceful Judges.

Since Skonyru saved them from the pitiless forges of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KhirUranonLoreConcept]Khir Uranon[/hyperlink], the Vigilant Smithlings have been his loyal and dexterous followers. Through their special bond, the inner fire of the ogrekin was invoked within them and they became gifted in the carving of runes, making their formidable smithworks able to withstand almost any kind of harm.

GLOBAL.SlowingConcept.name: Slowing
GLOBAL.SlowingConcept.description:
The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpeedConcept]Combat Speed[/hyperlink] cost for moving through this hex is doubled for non-flying units.

[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHOCK_UNIT]Shock Units[/hyperlink] attacking from this hex have their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChargeConcept]Charge[/hyperlink] attacks blocked.

GLOBAL.SnowConcept.name: Snow
GLOBAL.SnowConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

Cold lands covered in snow. A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HutConcept]Hut[/hyperlink] can be built here.
Arctic-adapted factions can build a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FarmConcept]Farm[/hyperlink] here instead.

GLOBAL.SoulConcept.name: Soul
GLOBAL.SoulConcept.description:
Souls are the concentrated essence of living beings.

Used for:Producing Undead [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink].Casting certain Shadow [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink].Unlock Souls by researching certain Shadow [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TomeConcept]Tomes[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SpellJammerConcept.name: Spell Jammer
GLOBAL.SpellJammerConcept.description:
The Spell Jammer is a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpecialImprovementConcept]Special Province Improvement[/hyperlink] that can be built in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] that are at least [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityTierConcept]City Tier[/hyperlink] 3.

When built, has the following effects:Enemies cannot target [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapSpellConcept]World Map Spells[/hyperlink] in this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].-10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].Counts as a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ConduitConcept]Conduit[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SpellOverchargeConcept.name: Overcharged Spell
GLOBAL.SpellOverchargeConcept.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpellConcept]Combat Spells[/hyperlink] may gain overcharge, granting them increased effectiveness based on the type of spell:<bulletlist><bullet><casttactical></casttactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DamageSpellConcept]Damage Spells[/hyperlink] gain +25% damage.</bullet><bullet><casttactical></casttactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HealingSpellConcept]Healing Spells[/hyperlink] gain +25% healing.</bullet><bullet><casttactical></casttactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BuffSpellConcept]Buff Spells[/hyperlink] gain +1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BOLSTERED_RESISTANCE]Bolstered Resistance[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet><casttactical></casttactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DebuffSpellConcept]Debuff Spells[/hyperlink] gain +1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUNDERED_RESISTANCE]Sundered Resistance[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet><casttactical></casttactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatEnchantmentConcept]Combat Enchantments[/hyperlink] allow another spell to be cast that turn.</bullet><bullet><casttactical></casttactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSummonSpellConcept]Combat Summon Spells[/hyperlink] gain +2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STRENGTHENED]Strengthened[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SpellUpkeepConcept.name: Spell Upkeep
GLOBAL.SpellUpkeepConcept.description: Spell Upkeep is paid each <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink]. Each spell has its own <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] upkeep.

GLOBAL.SpiderTempleConcept.name: Tunneling Spider Temple
GLOBAL.SpiderTempleConcept.description: Annexed [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] with a Tunneling Spider Den and Underground Provinces within a radius equal to the city tier:<bulletlist><bullet>Per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], one of the Provinces gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MushroomForestConcept]Mushroom Forest[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.StalagmitesConcept.name: Stalagmites
GLOBAL.StalagmitesConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

A formation of mineral and rock that rises from the cavern floor. A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.QuarryConcept]Quarry[/hyperlink] can be built here.

GLOBAL.SundrenLoreConcept.name: Sundren
GLOBAL.SundrenLoreConcept.description:
Curious and clever, Sundren was the second-born child, daughter of Queen Julia and her royal consort. She founded the Torchbearers as one of the few leaders ever to unite High Elves with their Dark-Elf kindred... But after the assassination of her brother, and later the death of her father, Sundren finds her noble heart growing dark with a lust for vengeance.
