Mended Torchbearers are the kindred and followers of Sundred and her dream of a life filled with a deeply heroic meaning. Many kindred were once jaded by age and propriety, while others thirsted for bloody revenge. Sundren gave them all a much more thrilling reason to live.

GLOBAL.SurplusConcept.name: Surplus
GLOBAL.SurplusConcept.description:
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitProductionConcept]Draft[/hyperlink] that is left over once research, construction or recruitment is completed.

This surplus will automatically be spent on the next item that you choose to research, build or recruit.

Surplus can only be kept for a single [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.SylvaniLaurelLoreConcept.name: Sylvani Laurel
GLOBAL.SylvaniLaurelLoreConcept.description:
Sylvani was born and raised in the capital city of her Elven tribe. With her talent for magic and love for nature she inherited her title from her grandmother after she fell to undead forces.

The Auldweald Elves are one of the oldest Elven tribes on the World of their namesake. They carve their history in their own bodies, and in the trees around them. Thereby, both bark and skin share the same legends.

GLOBAL.SyronSovereignLoreConcept.name: Nykareth
GLOBAL.SyronSovereignLoreConcept.description:
Nykareth was once a Syron, one of the most zealous fighters of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomwatchLoreConcept]Gloomwatch[/hyperlink]. Through the Ages, her hatred for the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowRealmLoreConcept]Umbral Abyss[/hyperlink] began to consume her, and she started to see [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrrathLoreConcept]Urrath's[/hyperlink] corruption even within the light of creation itself. Shunned for her erratic behavior, Nykareth has become obsessed with smiting those she deems corrupted... But the grounds of her judgments are unclear to all but her.

The Veilstriders are Nykareth's most loyal soldiers, priding themselves on being the last bastion of true faith that stands against the torrent of the Umbral Abyss. They see their ruler's physical transformation as a blessing of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink], and as proof that their path is the truly righteous one.

GLOBAL.TeleporterConcept.name: Teleporter
GLOBAL.TeleporterConcept.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvement[/hyperlink] which enables an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Army[/hyperlink] to teleport from one teleporter to another.

-10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.TempestLoreConcept.name: Tempest
GLOBAL.TempestLoreConcept.description:
He arrives in a cyclone of lightning and claims himself to be the Master of Dragons. Few dare to question that claim, for Tempest is indeed known to walk among these primal beings. Even more eccentric and erratic now than he was before being banished to the Void, Tempest's mind is like a brewing storm.

The Draconians were the result of a rare collaboration between wizard and Dragon. As a reward for this endeavor, Tempest claimed half of the resulting hatchlings and has ruled them ever since. Now, after following their master through the Astral Sea itself, the Stormborn Draconians almost share more kinship with Tempest than the Dragons they originate from.

GLOBAL.TephradenirLoreConcept.name: Tephradenir
GLOBAL.TephradenirLoreConcept.description:
Tephradenir is an Elder Dragon who was born together with her world. Mountains and dales formed under her care. After her task was done, she slept... Until she was awakened once more, only to see her world filled with vermin who change and destroy her precious creations. Enraged, she rises to take vengeance upon those who deem her work "imperfect".

A group of primitive cave dwellers hid from Dwarven miners and found an Elder Dragon who slept at the bottom. When she awakened and destroyed the Dwarves—and a big part of the world above—the cave dwellers named her their wrathful goddess. Generations later, few question the decisions of their primal patron.

GLOBAL.ThrallConcept.name: Thrall
GLOBAL.ThrallConcept.description:
Thralls are enslaved people or creatures that can be used as currency for special ritual [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink].

[hyperlink,GLOBAL.EldritchSovereignLoreConcept]Eldritch Sovereigns[/hyperlink] gain thralls by defeating enough enemies in battle or with spells like [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ENTRHALL_POPULATION]Enthrall Population[/hyperlink].

[hyperlink,GLOBAL.ElderVampireLoreConcept]Elder Vampires[/hyperlink] gain thralls by building the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.LORD_CASTLE_FOUNDATION]Vampire Castle: Foundation[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.TradeAgreementConcept.name: Free Trade Agreement
GLOBAL.TradeAgreementConcept.description: Both [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink] allow each other to establish [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept]Trade Routes[/hyperlink] between each other's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept.name: Trade Route
GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept.description:
A connection between a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] and an Outpost or other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink], granting the origin city where it was created [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TradeRouteIncomeConcept]Trade Route Income[/hyperlink] based on the target it is connected to.

Cities can establish a Trade Route by spending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitProductionConcept]Draft[/hyperlink], the cost increasing with the type of target and the amount of movement needed to reach it.

Only a certain number of Trade Routes can be active per City, this cap can be increased via [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStructureConcept]City Structure[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.TradeRouteIncomeConcept.name: Trade Route Income
GLOBAL.TradeRouteIncomeConcept.description: Trade Route income given to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] depends on the target:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.OutpostConcept]Outposts[/hyperlink] - All income from the outpost's Domain.</bullet><bullet><minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] - A percentage of all their income increasing with their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEDiplStateConcept]Diplomatic State[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.ForeignCityConcept]Foreign Cities[/hyperlink] - A large percentage of their <gold></gold> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] and <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.TraitorKingCultLoreConcept.name: Sons of the Kjörnoe
GLOBAL.TraitorKingCultLoreConcept.description: Tempted by the promise of dark power, the Sons of the Kjörnoe worship the fallen [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TraitorKingsLoreConcept]Traitor Kings[/hyperlink] of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MyrridaLoreConcept]Myrrida[/hyperlink] as gods. Searching for artifacts imbued with the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SoulsLoreConcept]Souls[/hyperlink] of their deceased masters, the Sons of the Kjörnoe study the forbidden soulcurses of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TraitorKingsLoreConcept]Traitor Kings[/hyperlink], claiming the lives of the innocent to empower their vile rituals.

GLOBAL.TreatyConcept.name: Treaty
GLOBAL.TreatyConcept.description:
An agreement between two [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empires[/hyperlink] where resources may be exchanged or diplomatic permissions are granted.

A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MutualConsulateConcept]Wizard's Bond[/hyperlink] needs to be established for more advanced Treaties and to achieve an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DSAllianceConcept]Alliance[/hyperlink].

Treaties last indefinitely but may be broken manually or through declaring [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WarConcept]War[/hyperlink]. Breaking treaties is considered an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept]evil[/hyperlink] act and will give the opposing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink] a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept]Grievance[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.TugrumLoreConcept.name: Tugrum Hammerhall
GLOBAL.TugrumLoreConcept.description:
Dwarves labor to impress their First Guardian. Tugrum Hammerhall shows only that she is never quite appeased. Therefore, stubborn Dwarven men with their stubborn Dwarven wills contest her disapproving brow. One wonders when they will notice that she is secretly quite proud.

The strength of the mountains embodies the Mountain Dwarves. They thrive in the crevices, cliffsides, and among jagged precipices where they can work the hard rock breaking the soft level lands.

GLOBAL.TurielLoreConcept.name: Turiel Tolarim
GLOBAL.TurielLoreConcept.description:
A mighty Orc whose honor-bound convictions match his prodigious strength, Turiel was the first Wizard King to ascend to Godirhood. He appears as a mighty and masked Orc, a bastion of stoic ferocity clad in indomitable armor and wielding brutal weaponry. Ever oath-bound to the Archon in guarding Grexolis, he holds honor and duty in highest esteem.

Turiel leads the mighty Onmar, fierce Ascended Orcs who aid him in a duty shared and who have, in return, been blessed by the Archon. Their minds are guarded against the insidious whispers of the banished souls they hold eternal vigil over.

GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingConcept.name: Umbral Dwelling
GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingConcept.description:
Umbral Dwellings are a type of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DwellingConcept]Dwelling[/hyperlink] inhabited by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowDemonsLoreConcept]Umbral Demons[/hyperlink] that can only be found in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowRealmLoreConcept]Umbral Abyss[/hyperlink].
Umbral Dwellings are always considered [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EVIL_3_UNIT_PROPERTY] Pure Evil[/hyperlink] and will have positive relations with other Evil Empires and negative relations with Good Empires.You cannot assign a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DiplomaticTokenConcept]Whispering Stone[/hyperlink] to them.To improve [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept] Allegiance[/hyperlink], you will be asked to make sacrifices during random events and via the Boost Allegiance action.Upon reaching a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EldritchPactConcept]Eldritch Pact[/hyperlink], you can purchase unique [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] and other bonuses to benefit from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink] terrain.Umbral Dwellings slowly alter terrain in and adjacent to their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink] into [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink]Umbral Dwellings cannot be [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageConcept]vassalized[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AbsorbingConcept]conquered[/hyperlink]. Instead, they are destroyed upon being captured.Umbral Dwellings are led by unique [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.UMBRAL_TYRANT]Umbral Tyrant[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HERO]Heroes[/hyperlink] who cannot be recruited or converted.

GLOBAL.UmbralTaintHazard.name: Umbral Taint
GLOBAL.UmbralTaintHazard.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex:<bulletlist><bullet>Lose -5 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DECAYING]Decaying[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>Units immune to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHADOW_SICKNESS]Umbral Malady[/hyperlink] aren't affected.

GLOBAL.UnitEnchantmentConcept.name: Unit Enchantment
GLOBAL.UnitEnchantmentConcept.description:
A type of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spell[/hyperlink] that grants a bonus to a specific group of your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] while it is active.

These spells:Affect both existing and newly created units.Increase the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Upkeep[/hyperlink] of affected units.Can be canceled at any time by the caster.

GLOBAL.UrvatoghLoreConcept.name: Urvatogh
GLOBAL.UrvatoghLoreConcept.description:
To some, he is the divine progenitor who sired perfection into existence through the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchvampireLoreConcept]Pureblood Archvampires[/hyperlink]; while to others he is but a mythological monster who once terrorized the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink] in a bygone age. Yet to one alone, he shall forever be remembered as the gallant Pale Prince of Roses...

Urvatogh the First Vampire, Blood Emperor Eternal of the Crimson Reign, and Deathless God who died yet rose again. His Grand Dominion of Drevanya once spread far and wide, until deepest betrayal sealed him away within a crypt, to fade beyond memory into myth. Here, he slumbers in perpetuity, though certain cults tell that he shall one night rise again to bring about a coveted reckoning of blood.

His Eternal Attendants are but animated remnants of a now long-forgotten race. They once served the family of the Pale Prince of Roses, back in brighter days.

GLOBAL.ValeryLoreConcept.name: Valery of House Avernos
GLOBAL.ValeryLoreConcept.description:
A warlord of high principles and standards, Valery of House Avernos represents the best the fallen [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CommonwealthLoreConcept]Commonwealth[/hyperlink] once stood for. When dedicated to a cause, her loyalty is beyond question, though after the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadraiFactionLoreConcept]Shad'rai[/hyperlink] invasion on [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept]Athla[/hyperlink] she yet has to find a new cause worthy of her vow.

The soldiers of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CommonwealthLoreConcept]Commonwealth[/hyperlink] were the first line of defense when the World Seals on Athla were opened, but rather than glorious battle they found themselves adrift in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink]. After what seems like an eternity of torment, the Commonwealth Remnants struggle to uphold the values they once stood for.

GLOBAL.VantagePointConcept.name: Vantage Point
GLOBAL.VantagePointConcept.description: Units at this location gain +1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RangeConcept]<range></range> Range[/hyperlink] and ignore [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.OBSCURED]Obscured[/hyperlink] on their ranged attacks.

GLOBAL.VaultsphereLoreConcept.name: Vaultsphere
GLOBAL.VaultsphereLoreConcept.description: A mysterious dome-like structure built by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientKrazuraLoreConcept]Ancient Krazura[/hyperlink]. Inside, a dormant environment dwells in magical stasis, as the last glimpse of a world long lost. While the original purpose of the Vaultsphere became forgotten with its creators, many aspiring factions have attempted to use the realm fragments sealed inside as experimental chambers of their own.

GLOBAL.VeryLowMoraleConcept.name: Very Low
GLOBAL.VeryLowMoraleConcept.description:
The unit is despairing and close to breaking.

Effects:Fumble Chance: 40%.

GLOBAL.WaterRockyConcept.name: Water Rocky
GLOBAL.WaterRockyConcept.description:
A water [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept]Province Feature[/hyperlink].

A series of rocky outcroppings trailing into the sea. A water [hyperlink,GLOBAL.QuarryConcept]Quarry[/hyperlink] can be built here.

GLOBAL.WepwatepLoreConcept.name: Wepwatep
GLOBAL.WepwatepLoreConcept.description:
Wepwatep was a zealous priestess of the Dune Serpent. So deep was her love for the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PrimalSpiritsLoreConcept]Primal Spirit[/hyperlink], that in an elaborate ritual she had herself covered in snakes and entombed below the shifting sands of the Alkothan Desert. When she emerged, the golden markings of the Dune Serpent were forever etched in her body and soul.

Sandfangs see wealth as a great virtue and adorn themselves in gold and jewelry to honor the Dune Serpent. Priests create pendants of the bones of the dead, for Sandfangs believe it is a great honor to wear the fangs of their forefathers on their bodies.

GLOBAL.WerlacLoreConcept.name: Werlac of Insaldur
GLOBAL.WerlacLoreConcept.description:
The best villains consider themselves heroes. While a simple servant of Meandor, Werlac organized a zealous cult to bring back the banished [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WizardKingLoreConcept]Wizard Kings[/hyperlink], without concern for the cataclysms it unleashed. When he found his reward unsatisfying, he started his search for other ancient powers to revere.

The Shadowborn Elves are wandering cultists, adept at unveiling secrets in the weirdest spaces between [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]worlds[/hyperlink]. They follow their cult leader through the shadows of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink] with the ease of pirates on a vast mysterious ocean, looking for a befitting higher power to worship and unleash upon the worlds.

GLOBAL.WightbornConcept.name: Wightborn
GLOBAL.WightbornConcept.description: Gives the target race immortality beyond life, granting them:<bulletlist><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UNDEAD]Undead[/hyperlink] unit type.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.NEW_LIFE_STEAL]Life Steal[/hyperlink], which restores [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept]<temphp></temphp> Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink] upon each attack.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.WizardSyronLoreConcept.name: Aeri Kyastir
GLOBAL.WizardSyronLoreConcept.description:
As a direct descendant of the first Syrons, Aeri grew up in reverence of the history of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomwatchLoreConcept]Gloomwatch[/hyperlink]. Yet, as her talents as a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WizardKingLoreConcept]Wizard[/hyperlink] grew, her [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowTrialLoreConcept]Torment of Shadows[/hyperlink] made her question her assigned burden as a cosmic protector. Instead, she decided to offer sanctuary to those who choose simpler lives... Though in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink], that in itself is a challenge.

The Free Syrons consist mainly of veterans, and people who declined the duty and honor of the Gloomwatch in favor of a calmer life on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds Within[/hyperlink]. Yet, when threatened, they will stand their ground next to any other battle-hardened warrior.

GLOBAL.WokoLoreConcept.name: Woko Ulang
GLOBAL.WokoLoreConcept.description:
When his name is whispered on a realm, everyone starts to prepare for war: Woko Ulang, the Apex Slayer, invokes fear even in the most ferocious warriors, for his blade strikes true and his heart knows no respite. After he slew the Elder Jade Dragon Shoqwuna on his home world, Woko Ulang started to travel the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink], seeking opponents worth striking down.

The Warring Jungleborn are the relentless tide which Woko Ulang unleashes on the realms he enters. They are agile fighters, jumping from liana to liana, and they will carry the drums of war to anyone unable to flee their rapid expansion in time.

GLOBAL.WolfTempleConcept.name: Sylvan Wolf Temple
GLOBAL.WolfTempleConcept.description: Annexed [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] with a Sylvan Wolf Den and Surface Provinces within a radius equal to the city tier:<bulletlist><bullet>Grant +5 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], one of the Provinces gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ForestConcept]Forest[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.WonderStoneConcept.name: Wonderstone
GLOBAL.WonderStoneConcept.description: <wonderstone></wonderstone> Wonderstone is a resource uniquely used by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchitectConcept]Architects[/hyperlink] to construct and improve <monument></monument> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchitectMonumentConcept]Monuments[/hyperlink].<wonderstone></wonderstone> Wonderstone is gained from:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Materials[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Using Surveyors to survey unsurveyed provinces that contain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicMaterialConcept]Magic Materials[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept.name: World Map Casting Point
GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept.description:
Represent your ability to channel the powerful magical energies needed to cast [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink].

They are refilled at the start of each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink]. If a spell needs more casting points than you have, then the spell will take multiple turns to cast.

GLOBAL.XanderaLoreConcept.name: Xandera the Phoenix
GLOBAL.XanderaLoreConcept.description:
With scarlet wings and piercing emerald eyes, Xandera the Phoenix signals her readiness to the potential enemies of her people—which means to everyone. As the Yukara of the Krazura she is believed to be the current reincarnation of the first Krazuran Yukara, possessing great knowledge and wisdom. But the recollections of millennia of hardships and betrayal have rendered her cautious and unforgiving towards outsiders.

Knowledgeable and gifted in the arcane, the Krazura still resemble their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientKrazuraLoreConcept]distant ancestors[/hyperlink] in many ways. However ages of isolation within [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GrexolisLoreConcept]Grexolis[/hyperlink] have dulled their astral instincts and eroded their civilization, to the point that only a minority of Manuhari's inhabitants still call themselves Krazura.

GLOBAL.XetevacaLoreConcept.name: Xetevaca Worldshaper
GLOBAL.XetevacaLoreConcept.description:
Xetevaca was named by the excavators who found her after she was cast into the dark depths as a newborn. Her charm and popularity was deemed dangerous by her ruling empress, resulting in the banishment of Xetevaca and her loyal followers. She emerged from the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralVoidLoreConcept]Astral Void[/hyperlink] as a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink].

The Underground Disciples originated as a small community within a vast empire, but their trust in Xetevaca caused them to take a leap of faith into the Astral Void itself. Those who survived emerged with her and now follow her in search of a new home.

GLOBAL.XornLoreConcept.name: Xorn the Disciplined
GLOBAL.XornLoreConcept.description:
Xorn used to be a mercenary commander, hired by the former Elven Court on [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept]Athla[/hyperlink]. As the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowDemonsLoreConcept]Umbral Demons[/hyperlink] invaded, Xorn found himself fighting alongside former enemies. Ever stoic and true to his name, it is said he ascended when he fell holding off an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EldritchSovereignLoreConcept]Eldritch Sovereign[/hyperlink] and its armies—an act of bravery still lauded among his people.

Originating from a mercenary army, the Othrakar have since developed a culture and morality of their own. Their myths and legends consist mostly of acts of heroism and overcoming great odds, which is also why they hold their leader in such high reverence.

GLOBAL.YakaLoreConcept.name: Yaka
GLOBAL.YakaLoreConcept.description:
Stare into the flames long enough and a single name will come to your lips. A god of fire. Only a god of fire can live within the raging inferno, able to master its unpredictable flow of destruction. He is quick to punish those that do not give him rightful reverence, for only creatures that can withstand waves of unrelenting heat are worthy to serve the great Godir, Yaka.

Remembering a time when felines were worshiped as god-kin, the Firebrand Predators serve Yaka with a zeal that he has not seen for generations. Yaka dotes upon his Tigran followers, for he remembers how his past servants abandoned him. Together they seek to build an unquenchable inferno.

GLOBAL.YdgaardLoreConcept.name: Ydgaard Worldbender
GLOBAL.YdgaardLoreConcept.description:
Like the Void Stone that replaced his heart through a macabre covenant for power, Ydgaard's desires run to the cold and shiny. A grizzled and mighty Dwarf whose greed is as impressive as his beard, he covets wealth and resources above all. The great jewel that adorns his left eye socket in place of an eyeball (also part of the aforementioned pact) is a stark reflection of how he sees the world.

Ydgaard rules over a race of mole-like beings known as the Grave Underlings. It is surmised that their form was chosen due in part to their poor eyesight, that they may never covet their master's wealth. Likewise, their natural predilection to excavation of the planet's riches allow them to ever increase the size of Ydgaard's own hoard.

GLOBAL.ZaethylLoreConcept.name: Zaethyl Silverleaf
GLOBAL.ZaethylLoreConcept.description:
After the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DragonsLoreConcept]Dragons[/hyperlink] breathed out the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]worlds[/hyperlink], and the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink] fixed them to stars, they called the first ones to lead those who will put down the storm, quench the fires and quicken the seas. They call for the Wild Guardian, Zaethyl.

The immortal First Elves live refined lives cultivated by millennia of patient thought and arcane mastery. Entrusted with arcane mysteries and guardians of creation magic, they form worlds rife with life. Sometimes perceived as intolerant elites, they have little patience for short-term mortal concerns.

GLOBAL.ZoneOfControlConcept.name: Zone of Control
GLOBAL.ZoneOfControlConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>A unit's Zone of Control is the three hexes in front of it.</bullet><bullet>The Zone of Control blocks enemy movement and determines where the unit can perform a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RetaliationConcept]Retaliation Attack[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Going into [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DefenseModeConcept]Defense Mode[/hyperlink] extends the Zone of Control to all adjacent hexes.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.DEFENSES.NULLIFY_WALL.name: Defense Mode: Nullify
GLOBAL.DEFENSES.NULLIFY_WALL.description: This unit ends its turn and goes into a defensive mode:<bulletlist><bullet>Extends its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ZoneOfControlConcept]Zone of Control[/hyperlink] to all adjacent hexes.</bullet><bullet>Gains +2 <defense></defense> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DefenseConcept]Defense[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Gains +2 <resistance></resistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept]Resistance[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Immune to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FlankingConcept]<flank></flank> Flanking[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>All adjacent friendly units gain +3 <defense></defense> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DefenseConcept]Defense[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Enemy units adjacent to this unit suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISRUPTION_TOOLTIP_PROPERTY]Disrupted[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ACCURSED_ARMORS_GROUP.name: Accursed Armors
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ACCURSED_ARMORS_GROUP.description: When a melee range attack hits, the attacker has a 60% chance of being inflicted with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MISFORTUNE]Misfortune[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ADAPTABLE_XP_BONUS.name: Adaptable
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ADAPTABLE_XP_BONUS.description: Non-hero units gain +30% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept]<xp></xp> Experience[/hyperlink] from combat.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AGE_OF_DEATH.name: Age of Death
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AGE_OF_DEATH.description: <bulletlist><bullet>All non-[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UNDEAD]Undead[/hyperlink] receive 50% less [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept]<temphp></temphp> Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink] when healed.</bullet><bullet>In combat with the Prophet's armies, all non-friendly units gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AGE_OF_DEATH_WIGHTBORN_CURSE_PROPERTY]Curse of Servitude[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>The Prophet gains +20 <souls></souls> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SoulConcept]Souls[/hyperlink] per turn.</bullet></bulletlist>The ruler that foresaw the Vision of Ruin and brought about this age is the Prophet.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AGE_OF_DEATH_WIGHTBORN.name: Curse of Servitude
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AGE_OF_DEATH_WIGHTBORN.description: When this unit dies, it summons a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.DECAYING_ZOMBIE]Decaying Zombie[/hyperlink] under the Prophet's control.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ANIMAL_GUARDIAN.name: Animal Guardian
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ANIMAL_GUARDIAN.description: All other friendly [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ANIMAL]Animal[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Army[/hyperlink] gain +1 <defense></defense> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DefenseConcept]Defense[/hyperlink] and <resistance></resistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept]Resistance[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ANIMAL_KINSHIP.name: Animal Kinship
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ANIMAL_KINSHIP.description: Makes the target race more bestial and connected to animals. When adjacent to a friendly [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ANIMAL]Animal[/hyperlink], both units are granted:<bulletlist><bullet>+10% damage</bullet><bullet>+10% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CriticalHitConcept]<crit></crit> Critical Hit Chance[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ARCANIST_MASTERY.name: The Arcanist's Mastery
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ARCANIST_MASTERY.description:
Allows this unit's side to cast an additional [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spell[/hyperlink] this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].
Add +20 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink] to this combat.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ARCTIC_BLIZZARDS_DISPL.name: Arctic Blizzards
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ARCTIC_BLIZZARDS_DISPL.description: Units in this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] suffer:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ARCTIC_BLIZZARDS_UNIT_PROPERTY]Arctic Blizzards[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_ARCTIC_BLIZZARDS]Snow Storm[/hyperlink] in combat</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ARCTIC_BLIZZARDS_UNIT_.name: Arctic Blizzards
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ARCTIC_BLIZZARDS_UNIT_.description: This unit is in an Arctic Blizzard and subject to the following:<bulletlist><bullet>This Unit [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CANNOT_REGENERATE]Cannot Regenerate[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>This Unit suffers -1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.VisionRangeConcept]Vision Range[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>This Unit gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UNIVERSAL_CAMOUFLAGE]Universal Camouflage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ASCENDED_ARTILLERIST_C.name: Artillery Cover
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ASCENDED_ARTILLERIST_C.description: While the Ascended Artillerist is in combat:<bulletlist><bullet>At the start of the owner's <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MARKED]Marked[/hyperlink] enemies are struck for <eventColor>{ASCENDED_ARTILLERIST_COMBAT_PROPERTY_EFFECT_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Physic}</eventColor> <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PhysicalDamageConcept]Physical Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ASHLAND_CAMOUFLAGE.name: Ashland Camouflage
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ASHLAND_CAMOUFLAGE.description: This unit cannot be detected when on Ashland hexes.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ASTRAL_INCARNATE_UNIT_.name: Astral Incarnate
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ASTRAL_INCARNATE_UNIT_.description: For each stack of Affinity Incarnate, this unit gains:<bulletlist><bullet>+1 <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ASTRAL_INFLUENCE_EMPOW.name: Empowered Astral Influence
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ASTRAL_INFLUENCE_EMPOW.description: Unit has:<bulletlist><bullet>-2 <defenselightning></defenselightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningResistanceConcept]Lightning Protection[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>Base [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicConcept]Magic[/hyperlink] attacks deal <eventColor>{ASTRAL_INFLUENCE_EMPOWERED_JUMP>ResolvedEffectMultiplier}</eventColor>% of the damage to another enemy within <eventColor>{ASTRAL_INFLUENCE_EMPOWERED_JUMP>MaxDistance}</eventColor> hexes.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ASTRAL_REFUGE.name: Astral Refuge
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ASTRAL_REFUGE.description: When this unit is hit, it becomes:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.INVULNERABLE]Invulnerable[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STUNNED]Stunned[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ATTUNEMENT_ASTRAL_OMEN.name: Attunement: Astral Omen
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ATTUNEMENT_ASTRAL_OMEN.description: When a friendly spell is cast, this unit gains a random [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PositiveStatusEffectConcept]Positive Status Effect[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ATTUNEMENT_ASTRAL_RESO.name: Attunement: Astral Resonance
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ATTUNEMENT_ASTRAL_RESO.description: When a friendly spell is cast, this unit is healed for +10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept]<temphp></temphp> Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink] and gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STRENGTHENED]Strengthened[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ATTUNEMENT_MANA_ADDICT.name: Attunement: Mana Addicted
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ATTUNEMENT_MANA_ADDICT.description:
When a friendly [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpellConcept]Combat Spell[/hyperlink] is cast, this unit gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.NEW_LIFE_STEAL]Life Steal[/hyperlink] for 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].
This unit suffers -5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink] at the end of its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] if no [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpellConcept]Combat Spell[/hyperlink] was cast this turn.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BARGAIN_PRICE.name: Bargain Price
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BARGAIN_PRICE.description: Unit costs -20% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink] due to being produced in a City with a Merchants' Guild.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BATTLE_SHIELD.name: Battle Shields
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BATTLE_SHIELD.description: When this unit's total [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink] reach <eventColor>{ABJURER_GLYPH_PRECOG_60_THRESHOLD>ResolvedTriggerProportion}</eventColor>% and <eventColor>{ABJURER_GLYPH_PRECOG_30_THRESHOLD>ResolvedTriggerProportion}</eventColor>%, it gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.PRECOGNITION]Precognition[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BERSERKERS_RAGE_THRESH.name: Belt of the Berserker
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BERSERKERS_RAGE_THRESH.description: When this unit's total [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink] reach <eventColor>{BERSERKERS_RAGE_THRESHOLD_EVENT>ResolvedTriggerProportion}</eventColor>% or lower, grants this unit:<bulletlist><bullet>3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STRENGTHENED]Strengthened[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BERSERK]Berserk[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STEADFAST]Steadfast[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BESTOW_MASK_OF_PROSPER.name: Mask of Prosperity
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BESTOW_MASK_OF_PROSPER.description: <bulletlist><bullet>This unit is absorbing the damage of another unit, reduced by 50%.</bullet><bullet>At the start of each turn, gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GRACE]Grace[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BLIGHTFALL_COMBAT_PROP.name: Blightfall Conjunction
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BLIGHTFALL_COMBAT_PROP.description: Each turn in combat, a random unit:<bulletlist><bullet>Takes 15 <damageBlight></damageBlight> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BlightDamageConcept]Blight Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Becomes [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISEASED]Diseased[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BOLSTERING_STRIKE.name: Bolstering Strike
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BOLSTERING_STRIKE.description: When this unit attacks an enemy, it gains a stack of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BOLSTERED_DEFENSE]Bolstered Defense[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BOON_STEALING_PROPERTY.name: Boon Stealing
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BOON_STEALING_PROPERTY.description: Base attacks steal 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PositiveStatusEffectConcept]Positive Status Effect[/hyperlink] from the target.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BORN_UNDER_THE_STARS.name: Born Under the Stars
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BORN_UNDER_THE_STARS.description: This Unit deals +20% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CriticalHitConcept]Critical Hit[/hyperlink] Damage on its attacks.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CANNOT_REGENERATE.name: Cannot Regenerate
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CANNOT_REGENERATE.description: This unit does not heal naturally on the world map.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CASCADING_POWER_AUTO_S.name: Stack of Cascading Power
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CASCADING_POWER_AUTO_S.description: <bulletlist><bullet>A random enemy unit takes 30 <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink] at the start of the owner's <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>For each stack another random enemy unit sustains damage.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CAVALRY_SLAYER.name: Cavalry Slayer
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CAVALRY_SLAYER.description: This unit deals +<eventColor>{CAVALRY_SLAYER_DAMAGE_UP>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>% damage to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CAVALRY_GROUP]Optional Cavalry[/hyperlink] units.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CELESTIAL_SLAYER.name: Celestial Slayer
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CELESTIAL_SLAYER.description: Base attacks deal +<eventColor>{CELESTIAL_SLAYER_DAMAGE>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>% damage to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CELESTIAL]Celestial[/hyperlink] units.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHAOS_BRAND_ON_DEATH.name: Inferno Brand
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHAOS_BRAND_ON_DEATH.description:
When this unit dies, it turns into an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.INFERNO_PUPPY]Inferno Puppy[/hyperlink] under enemy control.

If the Puppy survives combat, it then Evolves and the enemy can pay [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] to keep it.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHAOS_INCARNATE_UNIT_P.name: Chaos Incarnate
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHAOS_INCARNATE_UNIT_P.description: For each stack of Affinity Incarnate, this unit gains:<bulletlist><bullet>+1 <damageFire></damageFire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHOSEN_ALIPAVAR.name: Chosen of Allipavar
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHOSEN_ALIPAVAR.description: This unit gains:<bulletlist><bullet>+20 maximum [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXTRA_RETALIATION]+<eventColor>{EXTRA_RETALIATION>NumTriggersToAdd}</eventColor> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RetaliationConcept]Retaliation Attacks[/hyperlink][/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FRENZY]Frenzy[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BERSERKERS_RAGE_THRESHOLD_EVENT]Belt of the Berserker[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHOSEN_BOSZORKAN.name: Chosen of Boszorkan
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHOSEN_BOSZORKAN.description: Allows this unit's side to cast an additional [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spell[/hyperlink] this <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CLEANSING_FLAMEHERALD_.name: Flameherald's Consecration
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CLEANSING_FLAMEHERALD_.description: <bulletlist><bullet>All [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OnFireConcept]Burning Ground[/hyperlink] becomes [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CleansingFlamesHazard]Cleansing Flames[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>Slain enemy units create [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CleansingFlamesHazard]Cleansing Flames[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CLEANSING_FLAME_FLAME_.name: Flame Blessed Champions
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CLEANSING_FLAME_FLAME_.description: Makes base [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MeleeConcept]Melee[/hyperlink] attacks of enchanted units:<bulletlist><bullet>Deal +<eventColor>{FLAME_BLESSED_CHAMPIONS_EXTRA_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Fire}</eventColor> <damageFire></damageFire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Deal +<eventColor>{FLAME_BLESSED_CHAMPIONS_EXTRA_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Spirit}</eventColor> <damageSpirit></damageSpirit> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpiritDamageConcept]Spirit Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Gain base <eventColor>{BURNING_RESISTANCE>ResolvedStrength}</eventColor>% chance of inflicting [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BURNING]Burning[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>Create [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CleansingFlamesHazard]Cleansing Flames[/hyperlink] on the target hex for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COLLECTORS_GIFT.name: The Collector
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COLLECTORS_GIFT.description: This unit gains:<bulletlist><bullet>Attacks transform targets into Zombies until the end of battle on kill.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.KRALICAVIR_SUMMON_UNDEAD]Collector's gift[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COLOSSUS_MOON_DISPLAY.name: Thunder Storms
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COLOSSUS_MOON_DISPLAY.description: Each turn in combat:<bulletlist><bullet>All units become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WET]Wet[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>1 random unit takes 20 <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COLOSSUS_MOON_UNIT_AUT.name: Thunder Storms
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COLOSSUS_MOON_UNIT_AUT.description: Each turn in combat:<bulletlist><bullet>All units become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WET]Wet[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>1 random unit takes 20 <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_ARCTIC_.name: Snow Storm
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_ARCTIC_.description: At the end of the attacker's <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink]:<bulletlist><bullet>All non-[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROSTLING_TRANSFORMATION_PROPERTY_GROUP]Frostling Transformation[/hyperlink] units suffer 6 <damageFrost></damageFrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostDamageConcept]Frost Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>90% base chance of all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WET]Wet[/hyperlink] units suffering [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROZEN]Frozen[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_AUT.name: Autumn Storm
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_AUT.description:
All enemy units suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WET]Wet[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

In addition, after 5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], all enemy units that are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WET]Wet[/hyperlink] suffer 20 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink] and have a 60% chance of suffering [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STUNNED]Stunned[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_AUT.name: Domain of Autumn
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_AUT.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_AUTUMN]Autumn Storm[/hyperlink] is active in this province.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_SPR.name: Spring Growth
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_SPR.description: Each time the owner's units suffer damage, they gain 1 stack(s) of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.REGENERATION]Regeneration[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_SPR.name: Domain of Spring
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_SPR.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_SPRING]Spring Growth[/hyperlink] is active in this province.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_SUM.name: Summer Heat
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_SUM.description: At the start of the owner's turn, enemy units adjacent to owner's units have 90% chance of suffering [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BURNING]Burning[/hyperlink] and suffer 5 <damageFire></damageFire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink] for each stack of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BURNING]Burning[/hyperlink] they have.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_SUM.name: Domain of Summer
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_SUM.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_SUMMER]Summer Heat[/hyperlink] is active in this province.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_WIN.name: Winter Sorrow
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_WIN.description: Enemy units suffer 5 stack(s) of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DEMORALIZED]Demoralized[/hyperlink] whenever they kill another unit.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_WIN.name: Domain of Winter
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_WIN.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_FEY_WINTER]Winter Sorrow[/hyperlink] is active in this province.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_RAZED.name: Razed
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_RAZED.description: This location has been razed or raided. Many obstacles are damaged, destroyed, or on fire.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_SANDSTO.name: Blinding Sandstorm
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_SANDSTO.description: At the end of the attacker's <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink]:<bulletlist><bullet>60% base chance for units of suffering [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BLINDED]Blind[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_VOLCANI.name: Volcanic Eruptions
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_VOLCANI.description: Every 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], a marker is placed. Then, after 1 <turn></turn> the ground will erupt and units within 1 <range></range> of the marker will suffer 10 <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PhysicalDamageConcept]Physical Damage[/hyperlink] and 10 <damageFire></damageFire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink]. Random affected hexes will gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OnFireConcept]On Fire[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBAT_SUMMON.name: Combat Summon
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBAT_SUMMON.description: This unit is a Combat Summon:<bulletlist><bullet>This unit will disappear at the end of combat or when this property expires.</bullet><bullet>This unit is destroyed if only Non-Vital or Combat Summon allies remain.</bullet><bullet>This unit's death does not affect their allies' <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBAT_TRAINED.name: Combat Trained
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBAT_TRAINED.description: This unit is under the control of a Player or Free City and gains:<bulletlist><bullet>+10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>+<eventColor>{COMBAT_TRAINED_STATS>BONUS>DEFENSE>Armor}</eventColor> <defense></defense> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DefenseConcept]Defense[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>+<eventColor>{COMBAT_TRAINED_STATS>BONUS>DEFENSE>Resistance}</eventColor> <resistance></resistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept]Resistance[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CONSECRATING_FIRESTORM.name: Consecrating Firestorm
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CONSECRATING_FIRESTORM.description: Combat in this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink]:<bulletlist><bullet>Has the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CLEANSING_FLAMEHERALD_COMBAT_PROPERTY]Flameherald's Consecration[/hyperlink] combat enchantment.</bullet><bullet>At the start of combat, [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CleansingFlamesHazard]Cleansing Flames[/hyperlink] appear on random hexes.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COSMOS_MANIFEST_ASTRAL.name: Cosmos Manifest: Astral
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COSMOS_MANIFEST_ASTRAL.description: At the start of the turn within 3 hexes:<bulletlist><bullet>Friendly units heal 5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept]<temphp></temphp> Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink] and gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BOLSTERED_RESISTANCE]Bolstered Resistance[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Enemy units sustain 5 <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COSMOS_MANIFEST_CHAOS.name: Cosmos Manifest: Chaos
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COSMOS_MANIFEST_CHAOS.description: At the start of the turn within 3 hexes:<bulletlist><bullet>Friendly units gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STRENGTHENED]Strengthened[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FORTUNE]Fortune[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Enemy units sustain 5 <damageFire></damageFire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COSMOS_MANIFEST_MATERI.name: Cosmos Manifest: Materium
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COSMOS_MANIFEST_MATERI.description: At the start of the turn within 3 hexes:<bulletlist><bullet>Friendly units heal 5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept]<temphp></temphp> Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink] and gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BOLSTERED_DEFENSE]Bolstered Defense[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Enemy units sustain 5 <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PhysicalDamageConcept]Physical Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COSMOS_MANIFEST_NATURE.name: Cosmos Manifest: Nature
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COSMOS_MANIFEST_NATURE.description: At the start of the turn within 3 hexes:<bulletlist><bullet>Friendly units heal 10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept]<temphp></temphp> Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Enemy units sustain 5 <damageBlight></damageBlight> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BlightDamageConcept]Blight Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COSMOS_MANIFEST_ORDER.name: Cosmos Manifest: Order
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COSMOS_MANIFEST_ORDER.description: At the start of the turn within 3 hexes:<bulletlist><bullet>Friendly units gain <eventColor>{COSMOS_MANIFEST_MORALE>Morale Change Absolute}</eventColor> <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Enemy units sustain 5 <damageSpirit></damageSpirit> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpiritDamageConcept]Spirit Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COSMOS_MANIFEST_SHADOW.name: Cosmos Manifest: Shadow
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COSMOS_MANIFEST_SHADOW.description: At the start of the turn within 3 hexes:<bulletlist><bullet>Friendly units have 2 Negative Status Effects removed.</bullet><bullet>Enemy units sustain 5 <damageFrost></damageFrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostDamageConcept]Frost Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CRUEL_ABILITY_MODIFIER.name: Cruel
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CRUEL_ABILITY_MODIFIER.description: Unit has:<bulletlist><bullet>+<eventColor>{CRUEL_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>% damage against units with <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink] of "Low" or worse.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CULT_OF_TYRANNY.name: Cult of Tyranny
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CULT_OF_TYRANNY.description: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AURA_OF_TYRANNY]Aura of Tyranny[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>Attacks gain base <eventColor>{CULT_OF_TYRANNY_RESISTANCE>ResolvedStrength}</eventColor>% chance of inflicting [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STATUS_VULNERABILITY]Status Vulnerability[/hyperlink] and heal this unit for <eventColor>{CULT_OF_TYRANNY_HEALING>NumHitpointsToRestore}</eventColor> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept]<temphp></temphp> Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CURSE_OF_UNDEATH.name: Curse of Undeath
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CURSE_OF_UNDEATH.description: When this Unit dies, it is resurrected with 20% of its maximum [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Point[/hyperlink] after 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CYCLE_OF_SEASONS.name: Cycle of Seasons
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CYCLE_OF_SEASONS.description: Grant a different effect each turn in the following order:

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DEFENSIVE_TACTICS_HALO.name: Defensive Tactics
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DEFENSIVE_TACTICS_HALO.description: +1 <defense></defense> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DefenseConcept]Defense[/hyperlink], +1 <resistance></resistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept]Resistance[/hyperlink] and +10% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EvasionConcept]Evasion[/hyperlink] when standing next to a friendly unit with Defensive Tactics. This does not stack.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DEMONIC_HUNGER_PROPERT.name: Demonic Hunger
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DEMONIC_HUNGER_PROPERT.description: <bulletlist><bullet>When killing a non-[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBAT_SUMMON]Combat Summon[/hyperlink] enemy unit, gain a permanent stack of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GORGED]Gorged[/hyperlink] which:<bulletlist><bullet>At 5 stacks turns into a permanent stack of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DEMONIC_SATIATION]Demonic Satiation[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Cannot be gained when [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DEMONIC_SATIATION]Demonic Satiation[/hyperlink] is at 5 stacks.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet><bullet>When pillaging a province, heal for 25% of their maximum [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISRUPTION_TOOLTIP_PRO.name: Disrupted
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISRUPTION_TOOLTIP_PRO.description: This unit's <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitEnchantmentConcept]Unit Enchantments[/hyperlink] are temporarily disabled.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DOMAIN_OF_MAYHEM.name: Domain of Mayhem
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DOMAIN_OF_MAYHEM.description: Every 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink] all units have a base 30% of being inflicted with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BERSERK]Berserk[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DOWNPOURING.name: Downpouring
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DOWNPOURING.description:
At the start of combat, units in this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink]:Become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WET]Wet[/hyperlink].If flying, become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SLOWED]Slowed[/hyperlink] in combat.
Units with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AMPHIBIOUS_MOVEMENT]Amphibious[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WATER_MOVEMENT]Water Movement[/hyperlink] are not affected.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ELEMENTAL_ATTUNEMENT_U.name: Elemental Attunement
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ELEMENTAL_ATTUNEMENT_U.description:
When a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spell[/hyperlink] is cast, this unit's base attack gains +1 damage based on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AffinityConcept]Affinity[/hyperlink] of the spell: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OrderConcept]Order Affinity[/hyperlink] - [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpiritDamageConcept]Spirit Damage[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos Affinity[/hyperlink] - [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralConcept]Astral Affinity[/hyperlink] - [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MateriumConcept]Materium Affinity[/hyperlink] - [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PhysicalDamageConcept]Physical Damage[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NatureConcept]Nature Affinity[/hyperlink] - [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BlightDamageConcept]Blight Damage[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowConcept]Shadow Affinity[/hyperlink] - [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostDamageConcept]Frost Damage[/hyperlink]Stacks up to 3 times.
Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ELEMENTAL_DEFENSES.name: Elemental Defenses
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ELEMENTAL_DEFENSES.description: Every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], a random [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] is targeted by one of the following effects chosen at random:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ICE_COFFIN]Ice Coffin[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FIREBALL]Ignite[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FULMINATION]Fulmination[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ROCK_BLAST]Rock Blast[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ELEMENTAL_MASTERY_PROP.name: Elemental Mastery
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ELEMENTAL_MASTERY_PROP.description: Discipline of Storms gains:<bulletlist><bullet>+4 <defenselightning></defenselightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningResistanceConcept]Lightning Protection[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>Base attacks gain +2 <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>Discipline of Flames gains:<bulletlist><bullet>+4 <defensefire></defensefire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireResistanceConcept]Fire Protection[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Base attacks gain +2 <damageFire></damageFire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>Discipline of Earth gains:<bulletlist><bullet>+4 <defensephysical></defensephysical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PhysicalResistanceConcept]Physical Protection[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Base attacks gain +2 <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PhysicalDamageConcept]Physical Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>Discipline of Frost gains:<bulletlist><bullet>+4 <defensefrost></defensefrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostResistanceConcept]Frost Protection[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Base attacks gain +2 <damageFrost></damageFrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostDamageConcept]Frost Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ENCHAINED.name: Enchained
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ENCHAINED.description: At the end of the units turn it has a 30% chance to break free, if failed sustains 10 <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PhysicalDamageConcept]Physical Damage[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXHAUSTED.name: Exhausted
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXHAUSTED.description: This unit does not regenerate [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Point[/hyperlink] on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink], nor can it be healed using [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SupportConcept]Support Abilities[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXHAUSTED_IMMUNITY.name: Exhausted Immunity
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXHAUSTED_IMMUNITY.description: This unit cannot become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXHAUSTED]Exhausted[/hyperlink] from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpeedMarchConcept]Forced March[/hyperlink] and other sources.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPEDITIONLEADER.name: Expedition Leader
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPEDITIONLEADER.description: The Hero leading this army is the Expedition Leader. If the Expedition Leader flees or dies but the battle is won, the remaining forces will revive the Expedition Leader after battle.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPEDITION_LEADER.name: Expedition Leader
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPEDITION_LEADER.description: The Hero leading this army is the Expedition Leader. If the Expedition Leader flees or dies but the battle is won, the remaining forces will revive the Expedition Leader after battle.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPLOIT_VULNERABILITY.name: Exploit Vulnerability
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPLOIT_VULNERABILITY.description: Unit's attacks have a Base <eventColor>{CULT_OF_TYRANNY_RESISTANCE>ResolvedStrength}</eventColor>% chance of:<bulletlist><bullet>Inflicting [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STATUS_VULNERABILITY]Status Vulnerability[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Healing self for <eventColor>{CULT_OF_TYRANNY_HEALING>NumHitpointsToRestore}</eventColor> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept]<temphp></temphp> Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EYE_OF_FIRE_PROPERTY_G.name: Demonic Potential
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EYE_OF_FIRE_PROPERTY_G.description:
Base attacks have a base 30% chance of inflicting a random [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept]Negative Status Effect[/hyperlink].
Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FAST_EMBARK.name: Fast Embark
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FAST_EMBARK.description: This unit spends fewer move points when embarking.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FEDERATE_LEVY.name: Federate Levy
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FEDERATE_LEVY.description: This unit is Levied from a Vassal:<bulletlist><bullet>Attacks inflict [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ENGAGED_BY_LEVIES]Engaged by Levies[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.SupportConcept]Support[/hyperlink] abilities heal [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FEDERATE_SOLDIER]Federate Soldier[/hyperlink] targets for +20% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept]<temphp></temphp> Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>For each unit in the army with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FEDERATE_SOLDIER]Federate Soldier[/hyperlink] gain:<bulletlist><bullet>+10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>+<eventColor>{FEDERATE_LEVY_XP_BONUS>XP}</eventColor> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept]<xp></xp> Experience[/hyperlink] per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FEDERATE_SOLDIER.name: Federate Soldier
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FEDERATE_SOLDIER.description: This unit is part of the core Federation:<bulletlist><bullet>Bonus damage and accuracy against units with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ENGAGED_BY_LEVIES]Engaged by Levies[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.SupportConcept]Support[/hyperlink] abilities heal [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FEDERATE_LEVY]Federate Levy[/hyperlink] targets for +20% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept]<temphp></temphp> Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>For each unit in the army with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FEDERATE_LEVY]Federate Levy[/hyperlink] gain:<bulletlist><bullet>+10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>+<eventColor>{FEDERATE_SOLDIER_XP_BONUS>XP}</eventColor> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept]<xp></xp> Experience[/hyperlink] per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FEUDAL_MONARCHS_DOMINI.name: Monarch's Dominion
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FEUDAL_MONARCHS_DOMINI.description: The unit is the absolute Monarch of their faction:<bulletlist><bullet>In combat, activates [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FOR_THE_MONARCH]For the Monarch[/hyperlink] on friendly units.</bullet><bullet>While army leader, all units in the army with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FOR_THE_MONARCH]For the Monarch[/hyperlink] cost -100% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>This unit gains: +<eventColor>{LED_BY_MONARCH_STAT>BONUS>DEFENSE>Armor}</eventColor> <defense></defense> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DefenseConcept]Defense[/hyperlink], +<eventColor>{LED_BY_MONARCH_STAT>BONUS>DEFENSE>Resistance}</eventColor> <resistance></resistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept]Resistance[/hyperlink], +<eventColor>{LED_BY_MONARCH_MOD>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>% damage, and +10 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIEND.name: Fiend
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIEND.description: Unit with these types are considered Fiends:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.INFERNAL_FIEND]Infernal Fiend[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ACCURSED]Accursed Fiend[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIEND_SLAYER.name: Fiend Slayer
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIEND_SLAYER.description: Base attacks deal +<eventColor>{FIEND_SLAYER_DAMAGE>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>% damage to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIEND]Fiend[/hyperlink] units.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIRE_HAZARD_IMMUNITY.name: Fire Hazard Immunity
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIRE_HAZARD_IMMUNITY.description: Unit is immune to the effects of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OnFireConcept]On Fire[/hyperlink] hexes in combat.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIRE_SEAL_DEBUFF_GROUP.name: Seal of Fire
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIRE_SEAL_DEBUFF_GROUP.description:
At the start of the turn, this unit sustains 10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink].

If the unit dies while under this effect, it explodes dealing 20 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink] to adjacent friendly units.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FOR_THE_MONARCH.name: For the Monarch
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FOR_THE_MONARCH.description: While in combat in own Domain or alongside their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink], this unit gains:<bulletlist><bullet>+1 <defense></defense> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DefenseConcept]Defense[/hyperlink] and +1 <resistance></resistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept]Resistance[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>+10% damage</bullet><bullet>+10 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROSTLING_TRANSFORMATI.name: Frostling Transformation
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROSTLING_TRANSFORMATI.description: Unit has:<bulletlist><bullet>3 <defensefrost></defensefrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostResistanceConcept]Frost Protection[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Immunity to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHILLED]Chilled[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>+10 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink] while on [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SnowConcept]Snow[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept]Ice[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ARCTIC_WALK]Arctic Walk[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SNOW_CAMOUFLAGE]Snow Camouflage[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROST_ARROWS_PROPERTY_.name: Frost Arrows
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROST_ARROWS_PROPERTY_.description: Unit's attacks have:<bulletlist><bullet>+<eventColor>{FROST_BLADES_EXTRA_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Frost}</eventColor> <damageFrost></damageFrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostDamageConcept]Frost Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>A base <eventColor>{CHILLED_RESISTANCE>ResolvedStrength}</eventColor>% chance of inflicting [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHILLED]Chilled[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROST_BLADES_PROPERTY_.name: Frost Strikes
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROST_BLADES_PROPERTY_.description: Base attacks gain:<bulletlist><bullet>+<eventColor>{FROST_BLADES_EXTRA_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Frost}</eventColor> <damageFrost></damageFrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostDamageConcept]Frost Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>+<eventColor>{FROST_BLADES_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>% damage against targets that are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHILLED]Chilled[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROZEN]Frozen[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GLOOM_SHEPHERD.name: Gloom Shepherd
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GLOOM_SHEPHERD.description: While this unit is the leader of the army, units gain:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHADOW_SICKNESS_IMMUNITY]Umbral Malady Immunity[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GRACE.name: Grace
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GRACE.description:
When this unit is damaged:Heal for 10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept] Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink].Remove one stack of Grace.
Stacks up to 3 times.

Grace [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OpposingStatusEffectsConcept]counters[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TORMENT]Torment[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GROVETENDERS_GIFT.name: The Grovetender's Gift
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GROVETENDERS_GIFT.description: Friendly units gain:<bulletlist><bullet>15 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept]<temphp></temphp> Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.REGENERATION]Regeneration[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>Dead friendly [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ANIMAL]Animals[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.PLANT]Plants[/hyperlink] are brought back to life with 20 of their total [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HERO.name: Hero
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HERO.description:
Heroes are important units that can lead [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Armies[/hyperlink] and become powerful battle [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink].
Heroes are immune to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MIND_CONTROLLED]Final Ultimatum[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DOMINATED]Dominated[/hyperlink].

They are needed to:Explore [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonders[/hyperlink].Initiate a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeConcept]Siege[/hyperlink].Govern [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink].Build [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OutpostConcept]Outposts[/hyperlink].
If a Hero dies and the opponent is victorious, the Hero will go to their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PrisonConcept]Prison[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CryptConcept]Crypt[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_C.name: Champion Governor
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_C.description:
While Governor, the governed city gains benefits based on the Renown level of this Hero:Renown level 1
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FarmConcept]Farm[/hyperlink] grants +5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink].Renown level 2
Acquiring new [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] requires -20% less [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink].Renown level 3
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] grants +1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink], +1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink], and +1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink].Renown level 4
Units cost -20% less [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitProductionConcept]Draft[/hyperlink] to recruit.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_D.name: Dragon Governor
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_D.description:
While Governor, the governed city gains benefits based on the Renown level of this Hero:Renown level 1
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MineConcept]Mine[/hyperlink] grants +5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink].Renown level 2
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MineConcept]Mine[/hyperlink] grants +5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink].Renown level 3
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] grants +2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink].Renown level 4
+10% more [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] income.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_E.name: Eldritch Governor
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_E.description:
While Governor, the governed city gains benefits based on the Renown level of this Hero:Renown level 1
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpecialImprovementConcept]Special Province Improvement[/hyperlink] costs -20% less [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] and -20% less [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] to build.Renown level 2
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpecialImprovementConcept]Special Province Improvement[/hyperlink] grants +10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink].Renown level 3
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] grants +2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].Renown level 4
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] grants +2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_G.name: Giant King Governor
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_G.description:
While Governor, the governed city gains benefits based on the Renown level of this Hero:Renown level 1
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.QuarryConcept]Quarry[/hyperlink] grants +5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink].Renown level 2
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStructureConcept]City Structures[/hyperlink] cost -20% less [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink].Renown level 3
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.QuarryConcept]Quarry[/hyperlink] grants +1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BindingEssenceConcept]Binding Fragments[/hyperlink].Renown level 4
[hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStructureConcept]City Structures[/hyperlink] grant +2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] in addition to their normal effects.
Enable drafting of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.STORM_GIANT]Storm Giant[/hyperlink] units.
