GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_V.name: Elder Vampire Governor
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_V.description:
While Governor, the governed city gains benefits based on the Renown level of this Hero:Renown level 1
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] grants +1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink], +1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitProductionConcept]Draft[/hyperlink], and +1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink].Renown level 2
Acquiring new [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThrallConcept]Thralls[/hyperlink] requires -20% less [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink]Renown level 3
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MineConcept]Mine[/hyperlink] grants +2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink]Renown level 4
Units cost -20% less [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitProductionConcept]Draft[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SoulConcept]Souls[/hyperlink] to recruit.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_W.name: Wizard Governor
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HEROTRAIT_GOVERNANCE_W.description:
While Governor, the governed city gains benefits based on the Renown level of this Hero:Renown level 1
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpecialImprovementConcept]Special Province Improvement[/hyperlink] grants +5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink].Renown level 2
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ConduitConcept]Conduit[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResearchPostConcept]Research Post[/hyperlink] grants +5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink].Renown level 3
Each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] grants +2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink].Renown level 4
+10% more [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] income.In addition each renown level grants +5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink] and +5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HOLY_RETRIBUTION.name: Holy Retribution
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HOLY_RETRIBUTION.description: Attacks that hit this unit from within 3 hexes deal:<bulletlist><bullet>6 <damageSpirit></damageSpirit> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpiritDamageConcept]Spirit Damage[/hyperlink] to the attacker.</bullet><bullet>Inflict [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CONDEMNED]Condemned[/hyperlink] on the attacker.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HONOR_GUARD.name: Honor Guard
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HONOR_GUARD.description: Friendly units adjacent to the wielder of the Kingsblade:<bulletlist><bullet>Gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STALWART]Stalwart[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>Deal +<eventColor>{KINGSBLADE_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>% damage</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HOSTILE_OCEANS_SEA_STO.name: Sea Storm
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HOSTILE_OCEANS_SEA_STO.description: <bulletlist><bullet>All units are permanently [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WET]Wet[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>At the start of the Defender's turn, up to 3 random units:<bulletlist><bullet>Sustain 10 <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Have a base 90% chance of suffering [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ELECTRIFIED]Electrified[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HOSTILE_OCEANS_UNIT_PR.name: Hostile Seas
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HOSTILE_OCEANS_UNIT_PR.description: This unit is in a Sea Storm and subject to the following:<bulletlist><bullet>This unit [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CANNOT_REGENERATE]Cannot Regenerate[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>This unit suffers -<eventColor>{REALM_TRAIT_UNIT_PROPERTY_HEALTH_DRAIN>HealthLoss}</eventColor> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink] each <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>This unit suffers <eventColor>{REALM_TRAIT_UNIT_PROPERTY_STAT_BONUS>BONUS>SightRange}</eventColor> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.VisionRangeConcept]Vision Range[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>This unit gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UNIVERSAL_CAMOUFLAGE]Universal Camouflage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HS_FATAL_STRIKES_MODIF.name: Fatal Strikes
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HS_FATAL_STRIKES_MODIF.description: Damage increases as the target loses health, up to +<eventColor>{HS_FATAL_STRIKES_DAMAGE>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>%.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HS_SPIRITBREAKER_MOD.name: Willbreaker
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HS_SPIRITBREAKER_MOD.description: When this unit kills, enemies within 3 hexes of the target suffer:<bulletlist><bullet>1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WEAKENED]Weakened[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.REMORSE]Remorse[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.IMMORTAL.name: Immortal
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.IMMORTAL.description: When this unit's total [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink] reach 10% or lower, it is immediately [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RoutingConcept]Routed[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.IMMORTAL_ARCHON_WARD.name: Immortal Ward
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.IMMORTAL_ARCHON_WARD.description: When this unit's total [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink] reach 25% or lower, it is immediately [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RoutingConcept]Routed[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.INFINITE_BEING_GROUP.name: Attunement: Enhancement
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.INFINITE_BEING_GROUP.description: Whenever a spell is cast, this units gains a random [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PositiveStatusEffectConcept]Positive Status Effect[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LIEGE_LORD.name: Liege Lord
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LIEGE_LORD.description:
This hero is the Liege Lord of their House, granting them and House units in their army:-{LIEGE_LORD_STACK_UPKEEP_MODIFIER>ResolvedUpkeepModifier}% base [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink].Regenerate an additional +{LIEGE_LORD_STACK_PROPERTY_STAT_BONUS>BONUS>Regen} [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept] Hit Points[/hyperlink] per World Map [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].+10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept] Hit Points[/hyperlink].+5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink].
This bonus increases as this Hero gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RenownConcept]Renown[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LINKED_MINDS_PROPERTY_.name: Linked Minds
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LINKED_MINDS_PROPERTY_.description: This unit gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HYPER_AWARE_UNIT_PASSIVE]Hyper-Awareness[/hyperlink] when it is adjacent to a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CONSTRUCT]Construct[/hyperlink] or unit with Linked Minds.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MARTYR.name: Martyr
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MARTYR.description: This unit's death increases their allies' <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink] instead of reducing it.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MASK_OF_CALAMITY_PROP.name: Mask of Calamity
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MASK_OF_CALAMITY_PROP.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Each time the caster unit is attacked, this unit suffers 5 <damageFire></damageFire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink] and 5 <damageFrost></damageFrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostDamageConcept]Frost Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>At the start of its turn the unit gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GHOSTFIRE]Ghostfire[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MATERIUM_DRAGON_ELDER_.name: Materium Scales
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MATERIUM_DRAGON_ELDER_.description: At the start of this unit's turn, it gains a stack of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MATERIUM_HARDENING]Materium Hardening[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MATERIUM_INCARNATE_UNI.name: Materium Incarnate
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MATERIUM_INCARNATE_UNI.description: For each stack of Affinity Incarnate, this unit gains:<bulletlist><bullet>+1 <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PhysicalDamageConcept]Physical Damage[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MERFOLK.name: Merfolk
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MERFOLK.description: A merfolk unit with:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.AMPHIBIOUS_MOVEMENT]Amphibious[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>When in water this unit has:<bulletlist><bullet><eventColor>{VERY_FAST_MOVEMENT>TacticalMovePoints}</eventColor> <combatspeed></combatspeed> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpeedConcept]Combat Speed[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>+<eventColor>{MERFOLK_TAIL_DAMAGE>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>% damage.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MIGHT_MAKES_RIGHT_DUMM.name: Might Makes Right
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MIGHT_MAKES_RIGHT_DUMM.description: The houses of this realm respect strength above all. They will grow more loyal to proven conquerors.<bulletlist><bullet>Conquering <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] grants +10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept]<allegiance></allegiance> Allegiance[/hyperlink] with all other <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PvEVassalConcept]Vassals[/hyperlink] gain +2 Allegiance Levels when first vassalized through conquest.</bullet><bullet><allegiance></allegiance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfluenceConcept]Whispering Stone Strength[/hyperlink] is reduced by -50%.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MISTY.name: Misty
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MISTY.description: Units in this province have:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UNIVERSAL_CAMOUFLAGE]Universal Camouflage[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet><eventColor>{LINGERING_MIST_VISION_REDUCTION>BONUS>SightRange}</eventColor> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.VisionRangeConcept]Vision Range[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>Every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] during combat:<bulletlist><bullet>Various [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MistConcept]Mist[/hyperlink] clouds appear.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MOLTEN_ARMOR.name: Molten Armor
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MOLTEN_ARMOR.description: Unit gains +3 <defensefire></defensefire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireResistanceConcept]Fire Protection[/hyperlink] due to being produced in a City with a Volcanologists' Guild.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.NATURE_INCARNATE_UNIT_.name: Nature Incarnate

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUNSTRUCK_ERUPTIONS_CO.description: Each turn in combat, 1-3 markers are placed. Then, after 1 <turn></turn> the ground will erupt and units within 1 <range></range> of the marker will suffer 10 <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PhysicalDamageConcept]Physical Damage[/hyperlink] and 10 <damageFire></damageFire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink]. Random affected hexes will gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OnFireConcept]On Fire[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TAUNTED.name: Taunted
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TAUNTED.description:
This unit is uncontrollable and will always attack the unit that taunted it.
A unit can taunt multiple opponents.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.THE_DESTROYER_PROPERTY.name: Might of the Destroyer
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.THE_DESTROYER_PROPERTY.description: This unit gains:<bulletlist><bullet>+60 maximum [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXTRA_RETALIATION]+<eventColor>{EXTRA_RETALIATION>NumTriggersToAdd}</eventColor> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RetaliationConcept]Retaliation Attacks[/hyperlink][/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FRENZY]Frenzy[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BERSERKERS_RAGE_THRESHOLD_EVENT]Belt of the Berserker[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.NEW_LIFE_STEAL]Life Steal[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TIER_1_PROP_GROUP.name: Tier I
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TIER_1_PROP_GROUP.description: Base [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink] of 6 <gold></gold> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink], or 6 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] when summoned.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TIER_2_PROP_GROUP.name: Tier II
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TIER_2_PROP_GROUP.description: Base [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink] of 12 <gold></gold> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink], or 12 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] when summoned.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TIER_3_PROP_GROUP.name: Tier III
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TIER_3_PROP_GROUP.description:
Base [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink] of 20 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink], or 20 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] when summoned.
Unit has a base [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StatusResistanceConcept]Status Resistance[/hyperlink] of 3.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TITAN_GUARDIAN_AUTO.name: Titan Guardian
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TITAN_GUARDIAN_AUTO.description: An [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.EARTH_TITAN_UNIT]Earth Titan[/hyperlink] is summoned next to one of the owner's units at the start of Combat.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TRANSFERENCE_SEAL_DEBU.name: Seal of Transference
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TRANSFERENCE_SEAL_DEBU.description:
Enemy attacking units restore 5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept] Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink] on hit.

Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TREACHEROUS_REFLECTION.name: Treacherous Reflection
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TREACHEROUS_REFLECTION.description:
Create a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TREACHEROUS_REFLECTION]Treacherous Reflection[/hyperlink] of target enemy unit.

Cannot target [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HERO]Heroes[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBAT_SUMMON]Combat Summons[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MYTHIC_UNIT]Mythic Units[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_CRYSTAL_STORM_AUTO.name: Crystal Storms
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_CRYSTAL_STORM_AUTO.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Every 2 turns in combat, a random enemy is hit by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.CRYSTAL_CRASH]Crystal Crash[/hyperlink] spell.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_CSP_RELIC_UNIT_PRO.name: Blessing of Storms
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_CSP_RELIC_UNIT_PRO.description: Unit has:<bulletlist><bullet>+3 <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink] on base attacks, [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.</bullet><bullet>+<eventColor>{RELIC_UNIT_EXTRA_RESISTANCE>DEF_MOD>Resistance}</eventColor> <resistance></resistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept]Resistance[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>+5 <defenselightning></defenselightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningResistanceConcept]Lightning Protection[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ATTUNEMENT_FORTUNE]Attunement: Fortune[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STATUS_EFFECT_IMMUNITY_ELECTRIFY]Status Effect Immunity: Electrified[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_DGC_COBWEB_INFESTA.name: Cobweb Hazard
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_DGC_COBWEB_INFESTA.description: All non-spider units in this sector are inflicted with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SLOW_MOVEMENT]Slow Movement[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_DGC_DUNGEON_TRAPS.name: Dungeon Traps
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_DGC_DUNGEON_TRAPS.description: At the beginning of each strategic turn, every non-[hyperlink,GLOBAL.MarauderConcept]Marauder[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Army[/hyperlink] in this sector has a 33% chance of being hit by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.DUNGEON_HAZARD]Dungeon Hazard[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spell[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_FF_CURSED_BY_HUNGE.name: Cursed by Hunger
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_FF_CURSED_BY_HUNGE.description:
Whenever this unit takes damage, it has a base 30% chance of going [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BERSERK]Berserk[/hyperlink] for 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].

If this unit is racial, it gains:[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CONSUME_CORPSE]Consume Corpse[/hyperlink], if it is Tier I or Tier II.[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.VIOLENT_GORGING]Violent Gorging[/hyperlink], if it is Tier III, a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Hero[/hyperlink] or a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Ruler[/hyperlink].[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TERRIFYING_GORGING]Terrifying Gorging[/hyperlink], if it is Tier IV or Tier V.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_FF_MALDICTION_OF_G.name: Malediction of Gluttony
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_FF_MALDICTION_OF_G.description: All units in this sector are inflicted with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_FF_CURSED_BY_HUNGER]Cursed by Hunger[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_MS_RELIC_UNIT_PROP.name: Blessing of Flame
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_MS_RELIC_UNIT_PROP.description: Unit has:<bulletlist><bullet>+3 <damageFire></damageFire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink] on base attacks, [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.</bullet><bullet>+<eventColor>{RELIC_UNIT_EXTRA_RESISTANCE>DEF_MOD>Resistance}</eventColor> <resistance></resistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept]Resistance[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>+5 <defensefire></defensefire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireResistanceConcept]Fire Protection[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.VENGEFUL_FLAMES]Vengeful Flames[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STATUS_EFFECT_IMMUNITY_BURNING]Status Effect Immunity: Burning[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_RFR_GWL_WORM_PROPE.name: Gargantuan Tremors
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_RFR_GWL_WORM_PROPE.description: Every 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], a 2-hex radius near an attacking Unit becomes marked by tremors.<bulletlist><bullet>All attacking [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] without [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLYING_MOVEMENT]Flying[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLOATING_MOVEMENT]Floating[/hyperlink], or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SAND_WALK]Sand Walk[/hyperlink] in the radius suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SLOWED]Slowed[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> Turn.</bullet><bullet>At the end of the next <turn></turn> Turn, all Units still inside the radius are killed.<bulletlist><bullet>Units killed this way ignore [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.RESURGENCE]Resurgence[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STEADFAST]Steadfast[/hyperlink] and do not leave behind a corpse.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TWISTED_BRAND_ON_DEATH.name: Fey Brand
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TWISTED_BRAND_ON_DEATH.description:
When this unit dies, it turns into an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.EVENING_SPRITE]Evening Sprite[/hyperlink] under enemy control.

If this unit survives combat, it evolves and can be kept for a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] cost.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UMBRAL_DEMON_SLAYER.name: Umbral Demon Slayer
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UMBRAL_DEMON_SLAYER.description: Base attacks deal +<eventColor>{UMBRAL_DEMON_SLAYER_DAMAGE>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>% damage to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UMBRAL_DEMON]Umbral Demon[/hyperlink] units.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UMBRAL_DRAIN.name: Umbral Drain
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UMBRAL_DRAIN.description: At the end of each turn:<bulletlist><bullet>This unit:<bulletlist><bullet>Sustains 10 <damageFrost></damageFrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostDamageConcept]Frost Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Loses a stack of a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PositiveStatusEffectConcept]Positive Status Effect[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist></bullet><bullet>The linked unit:<bulletlist><bullet>Heals 10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept]<temphp></temphp> Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Steals the removed [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PositiveStatusEffectConcept]Positive Status Effect[/hyperlink] stack.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.VOLCANIC_ERUPTION_DISP.name: Volcanic Eruptions
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.VOLCANIC_ERUPTION_DISP.description: Units in this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] suffer:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.VOLCANIC_HEAT_UNIT_PROPERTY]Volcanic Heat[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_VOLCANIC_ERUPTION]Volcanic Eruptions[/hyperlink] in combat</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.VOLCANIC_HEAT_UNIT_PRO.name: Volcanic Heat
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.VOLCANIC_HEAT_UNIT_PRO.description: This unit is in a province affected by volcanic activity and subject to the following:<bulletlist><bullet>This unit [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CANNOT_REGENERATE]Cannot Regenerate[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>This unit suffers -3 <defensefire></defensefire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireResistanceConcept]Fire Protection[/hyperlink], but gains +3 <defensefrost></defensefrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostResistanceConcept]Frost Protection[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WARDED_BY_FATE.name: Ward of Fates
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WARDED_BY_FATE.description: The region is protected by a spell—according to myth woven by fate itself—which renders this sector uninhabitable and blocks [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapSpellConcept]World Map Spells[/hyperlink]. Only when the fateful conflict overseen by this spell has been resolved, will the ward disperse.

GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WILLBREAKER_MOD.name: Cruel
GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WILLBREAKER_MOD.description: Unit has:<bulletlist><bullet>+<eventColor>{CRUEL_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>% damage against units with <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink] of "Low" or worse.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SIEGE_PROJECTS.CAPTIVATING_MIST.name: Captivating Mists
GLOBAL.SIEGE_PROJECTS.CAPTIVATING_MIST.description: <bulletlist><bullet>While besieged, the city loses -1 <population></population> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] each <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink]. When it reaches 0 <population></population> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink], the city will be razed.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SIEGE_PROJECTS.FEY_INVASION_AUTUM.name: Autumnstorm Evocation
GLOBAL.SIEGE_PROJECTS.FEY_INVASION_AUTUM.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Every 2 turns in combat, a random enemy is hit by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FULMINATION]Fulmination[/hyperlink] spell.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SIEGE_PROJECTS.FEY_INVASION_SPRIN.name: Springvine Evocation
GLOBAL.SIEGE_PROJECTS.FEY_INVASION_SPRIN.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Every 2 turns in combat, a random ally is healed by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.HEALING_ROOTS]Healing Roots[/hyperlink] spell.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SIEGE_PROJECTS.FEY_INVASION_SUMME.name: Summerburst Evocation
GLOBAL.SIEGE_PROJECTS.FEY_INVASION_SUMME.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Every 2 turns in combat, a random enemy is hit by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FIREBALL]Ignite[/hyperlink] spell.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SIEGE_PROJECTS.FEY_INVASION_WINTE.name: Winterfreeze Evocation
GLOBAL.SIEGE_PROJECTS.FEY_INVASION_WINTE.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Every 2 turns in combat, a random enemy is hit by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ICE_COFFIN]Ice Coffin[/hyperlink] spell.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SKILLS.DRAINING_CHARM.name: Draining Charm
GLOBAL.SKILLS.DRAINING_CHARM.description: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.BloodDrainConcept]Blood Drain[/hyperlink] abilities now have a chance of inflicting [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MIND_CONTROLLED]Final Ultimatum[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink] instead of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STUNNED]Stunned[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Still attempts to inflict [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STUNNED]Stunned[/hyperlink] against [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CONTROL_LOSS_IMMUNITY]Control Loss Immunity[/hyperlink] units.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SKILLS.FEUDAL_LORD_CROPS.name: Lord of Crops
GLOBAL.SKILLS.FEUDAL_LORD_CROPS.description:
The city of which this hero is governor gains 25 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink] income.

Only one hero can be this Lord at any time.

GLOBAL.SKILLS.FEUDAL_LORD_KNOWLEDGE.name: Lord of Knowledge
GLOBAL.SKILLS.FEUDAL_LORD_KNOWLEDGE.description:
The city of which this hero is governor gains 15 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink] income.

Only one hero can be this Lord at any time.

GLOBAL.SKILLS.FEUDAL_LORD_MAGIC.name: Lord of Magic
GLOBAL.SKILLS.FEUDAL_LORD_MAGIC.description:
The city of which this hero is governor gains 15 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] income.

Only one hero can be this Lord at any time.

GLOBAL.SKILLS.FEUDAL_LORD_PRODUCTION.name: Lord of Production
GLOBAL.SKILLS.FEUDAL_LORD_PRODUCTION.description:
The city of which this hero is governor gains 25 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] income.

Only one hero can be this Lord at any time.

GLOBAL.SKILLS.FEUDAL_LORD_WAR.name: Lord of War
GLOBAL.SKILLS.FEUDAL_LORD_WAR.description:
While army leader, units in the army [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapRegeneration]regenerate[/hyperlink] +15 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept] Hit Points[/hyperlink] in friendly and neutral territory.

In addition, after winning combat, units in the army regain 50% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MovePointConcept]Move Points[/hyperlink].
This triggers once per [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink]

Only one Hero can be this Lord at any time.

GLOBAL.SKILLS.FROST_BLADES_HERO_SKILL.name: Frost Strikes
GLOBAL.SKILLS.FROST_BLADES_HERO_SKILL.description: Base attacks gain:<bulletlist><bullet>+<eventColor>{FROST_BLADES_EXTRA_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Frost}</eventColor> <damageFrost></damageFrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostDamageConcept]Frost Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>+<eventColor>{FROST_BLADES_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>% damage against targets that are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHILLED]Chilled[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROZEN]Frozen[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.SKILLS.HS_CLEANSING_FLAMEHERALD.name: Cleansing Flameherald
GLOBAL.SKILLS.HS_CLEANSING_FLAMEHERALD.description:
Gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CLEANSING_FLAME_FLAME_BLESSED_CHAMPIONS_PROPERTY_GROUP]Flame Blessed Champions[/hyperlink].
In combat, apply [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CLEANSING_FLAMEHERALD_COMBAT_PROPERTY]Flameherald's Consecration[/hyperlink] to the battlefield.

GLOBAL.SKILLS.LIGHTNING_MAGIC.name: Lightning Strikes
GLOBAL.SKILLS.LIGHTNING_MAGIC.description: Base attacks gain:<bulletlist><bullet>+<eventColor>{LIGHTNING_MAGIC_EXTRA_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Shock}</eventColor> <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>+<eventColor>{LIGHTNING_BLADES_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>% damage against targets that are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ELECTRIFIED]Electrified[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.SKILLS.SEARING_STEEL_HS.name: Searing Strikes
GLOBAL.SKILLS.SEARING_STEEL_HS.description: Base attacks gain:<bulletlist><bullet>+<eventColor>{SEARING_STEEL_HS_EXTRA_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Fire}</eventColor> <damageFire></damageFire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>+<eventColor>{SEARING_STEEL_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>% damage against targets that are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BURNING]Burning[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ABRADE_MOUNTAI.name: Summon Storm Runestele
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ABRADE_MOUNTAI.description: Summon a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StormRunesteleConcept]Storm Runestele[/hyperlink] on target Surface [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink], which will appear on an empty hex and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TerraformingConcept]terraform[/hyperlink] surrounding provinces every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.AGE_OF_ASTRAL.name: Age of Astral
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.AGE_OF_ASTRAL.description: Channel the Age of Astral to reach the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicVictoryConcept]Magic Victory[/hyperlink]. While channeling:<bulletlist><bullet>Your <arcana></arcana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralConcept]Astral Affinity[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] cost -20% <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink], <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink], and <optactical></optactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Each turn in combat, a random enemy takes 15 mixed Fire, Lightning, and Frost, damage and gets 2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUNDERED_RESISTANCE]Sundered Resistance[/hyperlink] and 2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STATUS_VULNERABILITY]Status Vulnerability[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.AGE_OF_CHAOS.name: Age of Chaos
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.AGE_OF_CHAOS.description: Channel the Age of Chaos to reach the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicVictoryConcept]Magic Victory[/hyperlink]. While channeling:<bulletlist><bullet>Your <chaos></chaos> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos Affinity[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] cost -20% <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink], <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink], and <optactical></optactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Each <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] in combat, a random enemy unit sustains 15 damage of a random type and has a base 90% chance of receiving a random [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept]Negative Status Effect[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.AGE_OF_MATERIU.name: Age of Materium
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.AGE_OF_MATERIU.description: Channel the Age of Materium to reach the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicVictoryConcept]Magic Victory[/hyperlink]. While channeling:<bulletlist><bullet>Your <matter></matter> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MateriumConcept]Materium Affinity[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] cost -20% <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink], <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink], and <optactical></optactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Each turn in combat, a friendly unit gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BOLSTERED_DEFENSE]Bolstered Defense[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BOLSTERED_RESISTANCE]Bolstered Resistance[/hyperlink]. Repeats 2-4 times.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.AGE_OF_NATURE.name: Age of Nature
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.AGE_OF_NATURE.description: Channel the Age of Nature to reach the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicVictoryConcept]Magic Victory[/hyperlink]. While channeling:<bulletlist><bullet>Your <nature></nature> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NatureConcept]Nature Affinity[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] cost -20% <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink], <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink], and <optactical></optactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Every 2 turns in combat, a Tier II-III nature unit is summoned on your side.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.AGE_OF_ORDER.name: Age of Order
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.AGE_OF_ORDER.description: Channel the Age of Order to reach the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicVictoryConcept]Magic Victory[/hyperlink]. While channeling:<bulletlist><bullet>Your <order></order> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OrderConcept]Order Affinity[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] cost -20% <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink], <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink], and <optactical></optactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Each turn in combat, a random ally gains 3 random [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PositiveStatusEffectConcept]Positive Status Effects[/hyperlink] and loses all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept]Negative Status Effects[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.AGE_OF_SHADOW.name: Age of Shadow
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.AGE_OF_SHADOW.description: Channel the Age of Shadow to reach the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicVictoryConcept]Magic Victory[/hyperlink]. While channeling:<bulletlist><bullet>Your <shadow></shadow> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowConcept]Shadow Affinity[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] cost -20% <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink], <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink], and <optactical></optactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Each turn in combat, a random corpse is reanimated as a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.DECAYING_ZOMBIE]Decaying Zombie[/hyperlink] until the end of combat.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.AMPLIFIED_ARRO.name: Amplifying Imbuement
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.AMPLIFIED_ARRO.description: Makes base attacks of enchanted units:<bulletlist><bullet>Deal +<eventColor>{AMPLIFIED_ARROWS_EXTRA_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Shock}</eventColor> <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Deal 3 <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink] to <eventColor>{AMPLIFIED_ARROWS_JUMP>MaxJumps}</eventColor> other targets within <eventColor>{AMPLIFIED_ARROWS_JUMP>MaxDistance}</eventColor> hexes.</bullet><bullet>Have a base <eventColor>{SUNDERED_RESISTANCE_RESISTANCE>ResolvedStrength}</eventColor>% chance of inflicting [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUNDERED_RESISTANCE]Sundered Resistance[/hyperlink] on each target hit for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ARCANE_RENEWAL.name: Arcane Renewal
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ARCANE_RENEWAL.description: Target friendly unit heals 30 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept]<temphp></temphp> Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ARCTIC_BLIZZAR.name: Call Arctic Blizzards
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ARCTIC_BLIZZAR.description: For 3 turns, at the start of your turn:<bulletlist><bullet>Enemy units take 8 <damageFrost></damageFrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostDamageConcept]Frost Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>All [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WET]Wet[/hyperlink] units have a 90% chance of becoming [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROZEN]Frozen[/hyperlink] for 1 turn.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.BHAJIFS_DISRUP.name: Bhajif's Disruption
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.BHAJIFS_DISRUP.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Enemies in a 1-hex radius:</bullet><bullet>Become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISRUPTION_TOOLTIP_PROPERTY]Disrupted[/hyperlink] for 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MANA_DRAINED]Mana Drained[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist><bulletlist><bullet>Additionally:</bullet><bullet>All active combat enchantments are dispelled.</bullet><bullet>For the next 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatSpellConcept]Combat Spells[/hyperlink] cannot be cast.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.BLIGHTFALL_PLA.name: Call Blightfall
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.BLIGHTFALL_PLA.description: For 3 turns, at the start of your turn, a random enemy unit:<bulletlist><bullet>Takes 15 <damageBlight></damageBlight> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BlightDamageConcept]Blight Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Becomes [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISEASED]Diseased[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.BLINDING_SANDS.name: Call Blinding Sands
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.BLINDING_SANDS.description: For 3 turns, at the start of your turn:<bulletlist><bullet>Each enemy unit has a 60% chance of becoming [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BLINDED]Blind[/hyperlink] for <eventColor>{BLINDED_EFFECT_DESCRIPTION>NumTurns}</eventColor> turn.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.BLOOD_MOON_RIT.name: Blood Moon Ritual
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.BLOOD_MOON_RIT.description: For the next 10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink] <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink] Vampires:<bulletlist><bullet>Don't suffer from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUNLIGHT_WEAKNESS]Sunlight Weakness[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>+15 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Point[/hyperlink] regeneration on the World Map.</bullet><bullet>Gain +20% damage.</bullet><bullet>Gain +2 <resistance></resistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept]Resistance[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.BLOOD_TRANSFER.name: Blood Transfer Ritual
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.BLOOD_TRANSFER.description: In target friendly army:<bulletlist><bullet>Heal Vampires for 50% of their maximum [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Heal non-Vampires for 20% of their maximum [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.BROKEN_WIZARD_.name: Cosmic Inspiration
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.BROKEN_WIZARD_.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Requires target owned [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] with 3 or more [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] in its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink] adjacent to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.BROKEN_WIZARD_TOWER]Broken Wizard's Throne[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Each City can only be targeted once by this Spell.</bullet><bullet>Immediately unlocks a random [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spell[/hyperlink] that you do not have access to yet.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.CHAINED_DEMON_.name: Brimstone Bind
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.CHAINED_DEMON_.description: Target enemy [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink]:<bulletlist><bullet>Has 120% chance of suffering [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BURNING]Burning[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].<bulletlist><bullet>This effect repeats 5 times.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet><bullet>Suffers [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.IMMOBILIZED]Immobilized[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.PACIFIED]Pacified[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.CLAIRVOYANCE_R.name: Clairvoyance Ritual
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.CLAIRVOYANCE_R.description: Reveals the closest undiscovered [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestation[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonder[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.COSMIC_TREMORS.name: Cosmic Wake
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.COSMIC_TREMORS.description: Target [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink]:<bulletlist><bullet>If it contains an enemy [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvement[/hyperlink] and no [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonder[/hyperlink], it is removed and the <population></population> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] is lost.</bullet><bullet>Enemy [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] in the province sustain 4 <damageFire></damageFire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink], <damageFrost></damageFrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostDamageConcept]Frost Damage[/hyperlink], <damageBlight></damageBlight> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BlightDamageConcept]Blight Damage[/hyperlink], <damageSpirit></damageSpirit> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpiritDamageConcept]Spirit Damage[/hyperlink], <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink], and <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PhysicalDamageConcept]Physical Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.CRYSTAL_CRASH.name: Crystal Crash
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.CRYSTAL_CRASH.description: Enemy units in a 1-hex radius:<bulletlist><bullet>Sustain 15 <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PhysicalDamageConcept]Physical Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Sustain 15 <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Have a base 90% chance of inflicting [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.VOLATILE_CHARGE]Volatile Charge[/hyperlink] for 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.CRYSTAL_FOCUS.name: Crystal Focus
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.CRYSTAL_FOCUS.description: Attacks of enchanted units gain:<bulletlist><bullet>A base <eventColor>{VOLATILE_CHARGE_RESISTANCE>ResolvedStrength}</eventColor>% chance of applying [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.VOLATILE_CHARGE]Volatile Charge[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.DESECRATION_RI.name: Desecration Ritual
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.DESECRATION_RI.description: Target and adjacent surface [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink]:<bulletlist><bullet>Gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SunlessConcept]Sunless[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Enemy armies sustain 20 <damageFrost></damageFrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostDamageConcept]Frost Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.DETONATE_INFES.name: Detonate Infestation
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.DETONATE_INFES.description:
Target [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.FRACTURED_INFESTATION]Fractured Infestation[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.FLEETING_FRACTURED_INFESTATION]Fleeting Fractured Infestation[/hyperlink] is destroyed, does not grant its rewards.

This spell does not contribute to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FracturingWindsConcept]Devouring Winds[/hyperlink] and cannot [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BackfireConcept]Backfire[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.DIVERT_DEVOURI.name: Divert Devouring Winds
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.DIVERT_DEVOURI.description:
Target [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] that is marked to be struck by a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CataclysmConcept]Cataclysm[/hyperlink] loses its mark and will not be struck next Cataclysm.

This spell does not contribute to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FracturingWindsConcept]Devouring Winds[/hyperlink] and cannot [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BackfireConcept]Backfire[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.EARTHSHAPE_ASH.name: Earthshape: Ashland
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.EARTHSHAPE_ASH.description: Target friendly or unowned [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink]:<bulletlist><bullet>Gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept]Ashlands[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>Loses [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RiverConcept]River[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FertilePlainsConcept]Grassland[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SwampConcept]Swamp[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SnowConcept]Snow[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept]Ice[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CavernFloorConcept]Cavern Floor[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ENTRHALL_POPUL.name: Enthrall Population
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ENTRHALL_POPUL.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Target owned or vassal city loses 1 <population></population> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>If used on a vassal lose -200 <goodRelation></goodRelation> relation with them.</bullet><bullet>You gain 3 <thralls></thralls> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThrallConcept]Thralls[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FANFARE_OF_MER.name: Fanfare of Mercy
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FANFARE_OF_MER.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ETHEREAL]Ethereal[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UNDEAD]Undead[/hyperlink] units in a 2-hex radius:<bulletlist><bullet>Have a 60% chance of becoming [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RoutingConcept]Routing[/hyperlink]. If resisted, they are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.PACIFIED]Pacified[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink] instead.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FEYTOUCHED.name: Feytouched
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FEYTOUCHED.description: Makes the target race connect with Fey powers, granting them:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FEY_GUILE]Fey Guile[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>The ability to ignore:<bulletlist><bullet>Vision penalties from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MISTY]Misty[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.AccuracyConcept]<accuracy></accuracy> Accuracy[/hyperlink] penalties from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CLINGING_MIST]Clinging Mist[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FIREBALL.name: Ignite
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FIREBALL.description: Target enemy unit:<bulletlist><bullet>Sustains 25 <damageFire></damageFire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Is inflicted with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BURNING]Burning[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>The ground is set [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OnFireConcept]On Fire[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FLOOD_THE_LAND.name: Earthshape: Swamp
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FLOOD_THE_LAND.description: Target friendly or unowned Surface [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink]:<bulletlist><bullet>Gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SwampConcept]Swamp[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>Loses [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChasmConcept]Chasm[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SnowConcept]Snow[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept]Ice[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept]Ashlands[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FRACTURED_TRAN.name: Fractured Transformation
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FRACTURED_TRAN.description: Target race becomes fractured:<bulletlist><bullet>Attacks have a base <eventColor>{DISRUPTION_RESISTANCE>ResolvedStrength}</eventColor>% chance of inflicting [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISRUPTION_TOOLTIP_PROPERTY]Disrupted[/hyperlink]. This effect is increased for Single Shot attacks.</bullet><bullet>Gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MANA_STARVED]Mana Starved[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Has all its other enchantments and transformations disabled. For each disabled gain:<bulletlist><bullet>5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>+<eventColor>{FRACTURED_TRANSFORMATION_UPGRADE_DAMAGE>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>% damage</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FREEZE_THE_LAN.name: Earthshape: Snow
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FREEZE_THE_LAN.description: Target friendly or unowned [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink]:<bulletlist><bullet>Gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SnowConcept]Snow[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept]Ice[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Loses [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChasmConcept]Chasm[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FertilePlainsConcept]Grassland[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SwampConcept]Swamp[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept]Ashlands[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CavernFloorConcept]Cavern Floor[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FULMINATION.name: Fulmination
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.FULMINATION.description: Enemy units in a 1-hex radius:<bulletlist><bullet>Sustain 15 <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Have a 60% chance of becoming [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ELECTRIFIED]Electrified[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.GIFT_OF_THE_OL.name: Gift of the Old Blood
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.GIFT_OF_THE_OL.description: Transform your units as they ritually imbibe blood from an Exarch, granting them:<bulletlist><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UNDEAD]Undead[/hyperlink] unit type.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.LIFEDRINKER]Lifedrinker[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Base attacks have a base <eventColor>{BLOOD_PARASITE_RESISTANCE>ResolvedStrength}</eventColor>% chance of inflicting [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BLOOD_PARASITE]Blood Parasite[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink]. This effect is increased for Single Shot attacks.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.GLOOMSTRIDER_T.name: Gloom Strider
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.GLOOMSTRIDER_T.description:
Turns target race into Umbral beings, which grants them:The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UMBRAL_DEMON]Umbral Demon[/hyperlink] unit type.[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLOATING_MOVEMENT]Floating[/hyperlink].[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FAST_MOVEMENT]Fast Movement[/hyperlink].

Mounted units lose their mounts.

Heroes lose their Mount and Leg equipment slots.

This transformation is incompatible with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.PURE_SOUL]Pure Soul[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.GLOOM_WARD.name: Ritual of the Gloomveil
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.GLOOM_WARD.description: All [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] in your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHADOW_SICKNESS_IMMUNITY]Umbral Malady Immunity[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.GRASPING_VINES.name: Call Grasping Vines
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.GRASPING_VINES.description:
Every turn in combat, all enemy units have a 50% chance of becoming [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.IMMOBILIZED]Immobilized[/hyperlink] for 3 turn.

Lasts for 3 turns.

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.HEALING_ROOTS.name: Healing Roots
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.HEALING_ROOTS.description: Target friendly unit:<bulletlist><bullet>Heals +10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept]<temphp></temphp> Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Gains 2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.REGENERATION]Regeneration[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Has [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ObscuringConcept]Obscuring[/hyperlink] Flora created below it.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ICE_COFFIN.name: Ice Coffin
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ICE_COFFIN.description: Target enemy:<bulletlist><bullet>Sustains 15 <damageFrost></damageFrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostDamageConcept]Frost Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Has a base 90% chance of becoming [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROZEN]Frozen[/hyperlink]. If unsuccessful, inflicts [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHILLED]Chilled[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.LAVA_FLOW.name: Summon Lava Runestele
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.LAVA_FLOW.description: Summon a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LavaRunesteleConcept]Lava Runestele[/hyperlink] on target [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink], which will appear on an empty hex and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TerraformingConcept]terraform[/hyperlink] surrounding provinces every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.LEV_CRISIS_BIN.name: Bind Leviathan Landmark
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.LEV_CRISIS_BIN.description: Puts the Leviathan Landmark next to the target city into dormant state, deactivating its adjacency effects. As the crisis progresses, once all Landmarks have been revealed, a bound Leviathan Landmark may be woken up again, disengaging this spell.

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.LIGHTNING_BLAD.name: Lightning Blades
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.LIGHTNING_BLAD.description: Makes attacks of enchanted units deal:<bulletlist><bullet>+<eventColor>{LIGHTNING_BLADES_EXTRA_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Shock}</eventColor> <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>+<eventColor>{LIGHTNING_BLADES_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>% damage against [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ELECTRIFIED]Electrified[/hyperlink] units.</bullet></bulletlist>Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.MAGESLAYER_BLA.name: Disrupting Weapons
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.MAGESLAYER_BLA.description: Makes attacks of enchanted units gain:<bulletlist><bullet>A base <eventColor>{DISRUPTION_RESISTANCE>ResolvedStrength}</eventColor>% chance of inflicting [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISRUPTION_TOOLTIP_PROPERTY]Disrupted[/hyperlink] for <eventColor>{DISRUPTION_DISABLE>Duration}</eventColor> <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.MAGE_BANE_RITU.name: Mage Bane Ritual
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.MAGE_BANE_RITU.description: Summons a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.MAGE_BANE_UNIT]Mage Bane[/hyperlink] on target hex.

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.MASS_PHANTASMA.name: Mass Phantasmal Ritual
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.MASS_PHANTASMA.description: Enemy units in target [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] lose 2 <statuseffectresistance></statuseffectresistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StatusResistanceConcept]Status Resistance[/hyperlink] for 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink] <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.MEND_FRACTURE.name: Mend Fracture
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.MEND_FRACTURE.description:
Decreases the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FracturingWindsConcept]Devouring Winds[/hyperlink] value by 220, temporarily reducing the chance of a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CataclysmConcept]Cataclysm[/hyperlink].
The cost of this spell is reduced based on the amount of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArtifactConcept]Artifacts[/hyperlink] of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnmakersLoreConcept]Unmakers[/hyperlink] the caster has.

This spell does not contribute to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FracturingWindsConcept]Devouring Winds[/hyperlink] and cannot [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BackfireConcept]Backfire[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.MISTY_MAGIC.name: Misty Magic
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.MISTY_MAGIC.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ObscuringConcept]Obscuring[/hyperlink] Mist covers the battlefield for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], giving your units standing in the mist +1 <resistance></resistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept]Resistance[/hyperlink] and enemy units become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISTRACTED]Distracted[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.PURE_SOUL.name: Pure Soul
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.PURE_SOUL.description: Purify the souls of target race, granting them:<bulletlist><bullet>At the start of each turn in combat, dispel 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept]Negative Status Effect[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>If the Negative Status Effect removed had a positive [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OpposingStatusEffectsConcept]counter[/hyperlink], gain the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PositiveStatusEffectConcept]Positive Status Effect[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>This transformation is incompatible with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.UMBRAL_FLESH]Umbral Flesh[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.GLOOMSTRIDER_TRANSFORMATION]Gloom Strider[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ROCK_BLAST.name: Rock Blast
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.ROCK_BLAST.description: Target enemy unit:<bulletlist><bullet>Suffers 24 <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PhysicalDamageConcept]Physical Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Has its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DefenseModeConcept]Defense Mode[/hyperlink] canceled.</bullet><bullet>Has its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RetaliationConcept]Retaliation Attacks[/hyperlink] removed.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SCORCH_THE_LAN.name: Earthshape: Sand
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SCORCH_THE_LAN.description: Target friendly or unowned Surface [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink]:<bulletlist><bullet>Gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Loses [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChasmConcept]Chasm[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SwampConcept]Swamp[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SnowConcept]Snow[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept]Ice[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept]Ashlands[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SHAPE_ROCK.name: Summon Rock Runestele
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SHAPE_ROCK.description: Summon a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RockRunesteleConcept]Rock Runestele[/hyperlink] on target [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink], which will appear on an empty hex and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TerraformingConcept]terraform[/hyperlink] surrounding provinces every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SIGN_OF_THE_HU.name: Sign of the Huntress
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SIGN_OF_THE_HU.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicConcept]Magic[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RangedConcept]Missile[/hyperlink] attacks have +<eventColor>{SIGN_OF_THE_HUNTRESS_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>% damage and -1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RangeConcept]<range></range> Range[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SIGN_OF_THE_LU.name: Sign Of The Lumbering Staff
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SIGN_OF_THE_LU.description: Unit has:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicConcept]Magic[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SupportConcept]Support[/hyperlink] abilities have +1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RangeConcept]<range></range> Range[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SLOW_MOVEMENT]Slow Movement[/hyperlink] in combat.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SIGN_OF_THE_VA.name: Sign Of The Vanguard
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SIGN_OF_THE_VA.description: Unit has:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.VERY_FAST_MOVEMENT]Athletics[/hyperlink] in combat.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.MagicConcept]Magic[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RangedConcept]Missile[/hyperlink] attacks against this unit have -<eventColor>{SIGN_OF_THE_VANGUARD_ACCURACY_TARGET>ResolvedAccuracyModifier}</eventColor>% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AccuracyConcept]<accuracy></accuracy> Accuracy[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.MeleeConcept]Melee[/hyperlink] attacks deal -<eventColor>{SIGN_OF_THE_VANGUARD_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER>ResolvedMultiplier}</eventColor>% damage.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SOULCURSE_OF_G.name: Soulcurse of Gluttony
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SOULCURSE_OF_G.description: Target province becomes affected by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_FF_MALDICTION_OF_GLUTTONY]Malediction of Gluttony[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SOULCURSE_OF_G.name: Soulcurse of Greed
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SOULCURSE_OF_G.description: Target enemy army:<bulletlist><bullet>Sustains 8 <damageSpirit></damageSpirit> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpiritDamageConcept]Spirit Damage[/hyperlink] and 8 <damageFrost></damageFrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostDamageConcept]Frost Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Becomes [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SOULCURSE_OF_GREED_STATUS]Cursed by Greed[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SOULCURSE_OF_P.name: Soulcurse of Pride
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SOULCURSE_OF_P.description: Target enemy [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink]:<bulletlist><bullet>Loses a border land [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] and the <population></population> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] is lost.</bullet><bullet>Spawns a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.RITUAL_SPAWNER]Ritual Circle[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationConcept]Infestation[/hyperlink] on lost province.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SUMMON_ACCURSE.name: Summon Accursed Ogre
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SUMMON_ACCURSE.description: Summon an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.ACCURSED_OGRE]Accursed Ogre[/hyperlink], a shock unit that pushes enemies around and inflicts them with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GHOSTFIRE]Ghostfire[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SUMMON_BLESSED.name: Summon Blessed Dragon
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SUMMON_BLESSED.description: Summon a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.BLESSED_DRAGON]Blessed Dragon[/hyperlink], a support unit that grants [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.REGENERATION]Regeneration[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GRACE]Grace[/hyperlink] to friendly units.

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SUMMON_ICE_RUN.name: Summon Ice Runestele
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SUMMON_ICE_RUN.description: Summon an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IceRunesteleConcept]Ice Runestele[/hyperlink] on target [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink], which will appear on an empty hex and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TerraformingConcept]terraform[/hyperlink] surrounding provinces every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SUMMON_MISBORN.name: Thulyana's Contortion
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SUMMON_MISBORN.description: Summon a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.MISBORN_MISTLING]Abominable Mistling[/hyperlink], a transformed and monstrous Fey that favors brute force over Fey tricks.

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.TEAR_FRACTURE.name: Tear Fracture
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.TEAR_FRACTURE.description:
Target hex becomes marked, Units in 2-hex radius of the marked hex have a 60% base chance of receiving [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISRUPTION_TOOLTIP_PROPERTY]Disrupted[/hyperlink]. After 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], the marked hex explodes and inflicts the following in a 2-hex radius:Units suffer 48 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PhysicalDamageConcept]Physical Damage[/hyperlink].Units have 60% base chance of suffering [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MANA_DRAINED]Mana Drained[/hyperlink].Each hex has 20% chance of creating a Mana Fracture obstacle, which have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DrainingConcept]Draining[/hyperlink] and spread to adjacent hexes when spells are cast.
This spell cannot [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BackfireConcept]Backfire[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.THUNDER_STORMS.name: Call Thunder Storms
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.THUNDER_STORMS.description: For 3 turns, at the start of your turn:<bulletlist><bullet>All units become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WET]Wet[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>1 random units take 20 <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.TRANSFORMATION.name: Transformation Ascetics
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.TRANSFORMATION.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Units of this Race cannot have any non-Cultural <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitEnchantmentConcept]Unit Enchantments[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Units of this Race cannot have any <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RaceTransformationConcept]Race Transformations[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Non-Hero Units of this Race gain +5 maximum [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink] and deal +1 damage (doubled for non-repeating) with their attacks per Rank.</bullet><bullet>Hero Units of this Race gain +5 maximum [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink] and deal +1 damage (doubled for non-repeating) with their attacks per Signature Skill they have.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.UMBRAL_FLESH.name: Umbral Flesh
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.UMBRAL_FLESH.description: Gives the target race blessings of the Umbral Abyss, granting them:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHADOW_SICKNESS_IMMUNITY]Umbral Malady Immunity[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>While in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink] terrain units gain:<bulletlist><bullet>+10 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>+<eventColor>{GLOOM_SHEPHERD_HEALTH_REGEN>BONUS>Regen}</eventColor> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Point[/hyperlink] per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] on the world map.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OutpostConcept]Outposts[/hyperlink] of the race:<bulletlist><bullet>Gain +2 <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink] income for each province with Gloom terrain.</bullet><bullet>Ignore <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] penalties from Gloom terrain.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet><bullet>Hero units gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GLOOM_SHEPHERD]Gloom Shepherd[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>This transformation is incompatible with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.PURE_SOUL]Pure Soul[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.VIVISECTION_RI.name: Vivisection Ritual
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.VIVISECTION_RI.description: All units in target enemy army gain 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BLEEDING]Bleeding[/hyperlink] for 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink] <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink]. You then gain +150 <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.VOLCANIC_ERUPT.name: Call Volcanic Eruptions
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.VOLCANIC_ERUPT.description: For 3 turns, at the start of your turn, a marker is placed near an enemy. Then, after 3 <turn></turn> the ground will erupt, and units within 1 <range></range> of the marker will suffer 10 <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PhysicalDamageConcept]Physical Damage[/hyperlink] and 10 <damageFire></damageFire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink]. Random affected hexes will gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OnFireConcept]On Fire[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.WAYFINDER.name: Wayfinder Enchantment
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.WAYFINDER.description: When enchanted units rout in combat:<bulletlist><bullet>They never die.</bullet><bullet>They return 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink] sooner.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.YSARIEL_FALLEN.name: Ysariel's Fallen Form
GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.YSARIEL_FALLEN.description: Target race is infused with Fallen Angels gaining:<bulletlist><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CELESTIAL]Celestial[/hyperlink] unit type.</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLYING_MOVEMENT]Flying[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FRENZY]Frenzy[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Decreased number of units in formation.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.ANCIENT_OBELISK_NODE.name: Ancient Obelisk
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.ANCIENT_OBELISK_NODE.description: An archaic monument pulsing with magic and engraved with secrets.

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.ARCANIUM_ORE.name: Arcanium Ore
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.ARCANIUM_ORE.description: Unique global effect: <bulletlist><bullet>Hurry Recruitment for [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] is 25% cheaper.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.ASTRAL_DEW.name: Astral Dew
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.ASTRAL_DEW.description: Unique global effect: <bulletlist><bullet>+15 <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.BLOOD_GLASS.name: Blood Glass
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.BLOOD_GLASS.description: Unique global effect:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] gain +5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Point[/hyperlink] regeneration per [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept]World Map[/hyperlink] <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.BREACHED_ARCANUM.name: Breached Arcanum
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.BREACHED_ARCANUM.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Adds one or more unknown [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink] based on the Arcanum's surrounding environment.</bullet><bullet>Can be restored to a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.SHROUDED_ARCANUM]Shrouded Arcanum[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.BROKEN_WIZARD_TOWER.name: Broken Wizard's Throne
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.BROKEN_WIZARD_TOWER.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] adjacent to this Landmark gain:<bulletlist><bullet>+5 <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>A <researchpost></researchpost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResearchPostConcept]Research Post[/hyperlink] in the Province gains +10 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] income.</bullet><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ELEMENTAL_DEFENSES]Elemental Defenses[/hyperlink] <casttactical></casttactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatEnchantmentConcept]Combat Enchantment[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] with 3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] adjacent to this Landmark gains:<bulletlist><bullet>Enemy [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpellConcept]Spells[/hyperlink] have 33% chance of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BackfireConcept]Backfiring[/hyperlink] within the domain.</bullet><bullet>The City's owner gains 15 <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink] and <optactical></optactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Unlocks the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.BROKEN_WIZARD_TOWER_SPELL]Cosmic Inspiration[/hyperlink] <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CitySpellConcept]City Spell[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.CRUSADER_HOST.name: Crusader Host
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.CRUSADER_HOST.description:
Devotees and celestials gather to vanquish evil.
If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion armies.

This Infestation will be [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfestationNeutralityConcept]Neutral[/hyperlink] to those with Very Good or better [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept]Alignment[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.FLEETING_FRACTURED_INF.name: Fleeting Fractured Infestation
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.FLEETING_FRACTURED_INF.description:
A temporary scar inhabited by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MANA_STARVED]Mana Starved[/hyperlink] creatures which spreads [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralBarrensConcept]Astral Barrens[/hyperlink] in its territory.

If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion armies.

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.FOCUS_CRYSTALS.name: Focus Crystals
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.FOCUS_CRYSTALS.description: Unique global effect: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] gain +20% <xp></xp> experience from combat.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.FOUNTAIN_OF_CREATION_L.name: Fountain of Creation
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.FOUNTAIN_OF_CREATION_L.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] adjacent to this Landmark gain:<bulletlist><bullet>+5 <food></food> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>A <farm></farm> Farm in this province grants +5 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CELESTIAL_RAIN]Celestial rain[/hyperlink] <casttactical></casttactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatEnchantmentConcept]Combat Enchantment[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] with 3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] adjacent to this Landmark gains:<bulletlist><bullet><farm></farm> Farms in the domain grant +2 <gold></gold> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] and +2 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CELESTIAL_RAIN]Celestial rain[/hyperlink] <casttactical></casttactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatEnchantmentConcept]Combat Enchantment[/hyperlink] in the domain.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.FRACTURED_INFESTATION.name: Fractured Infestation
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.FRACTURED_INFESTATION.description:
A massive scar inhabited by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MANA_STARVED]Mana Starved[/hyperlink] creatures.
This infestation spreads [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralBarrensConcept]Astral Barrens[/hyperlink] in its territory.
If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion armies.

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.FRACTURED_TOWER.name: Fractured Tower
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.FRACTURED_TOWER.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResearchConcept]Research[/hyperlink] per <conduit></conduit> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ConduitConcept]Conduit[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.FRACTURED_EVOKER]Fractured Evoker[/hyperlink] to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.GOLDEN_ZIGGURAT.name: Golden Ziggurat
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.GOLDEN_ZIGGURAT.description: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MAGIC_ORIGIN]Magic Origin[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] require -50% less <gold></gold> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] and <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] base [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink] in this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.PHOENIX]Phoenix[/hyperlink] unit to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.GREAT_BIRD_NEST_SPAWNE.name: Great Bird Nest
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.GREAT_BIRD_NEST_SPAWNE.description:
A flock of dangerous birds has claimed this region.
If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion armies.

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.GREAT_WORM_INFESTATION.name: Great Worm Infestation
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.GREAT_WORM_INFESTATION.description:
A massive scar inhabited by the Great Worm and her progeny.
This infestation spreads [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralBarrensConcept]Astral Barrens[/hyperlink] in its territory.
If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion armies. The territory of the Great Worm will suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TSR_RFR_GWL_WORM_PROPERTY]Gargantuan Tremors[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.HASTE_BERRIES.name: Haste Berries
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.HASTE_BERRIES.description: Unique global effect: <bulletlist><bullet>Founding, migrating and absorbing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] takes -2 turns.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.HIDDEN_WELLSPRING.name: Hidden Wellspring
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.HIDDEN_WELLSPRING.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+2 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] per <farm></farm> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FarmConcept]Farm[/hyperlink] and <forester></forester> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ForesterConcept]Forester[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Friendly [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink] are healed for 30 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink] at the end of each strategic <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.SPRING_FAIRY]Spring Fairy[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.SUMMER_FAIRY]Summer Fairy[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.AUTUMN_FAIRY]Autumn Fairy[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.WINTER_FAIRY]Winter Fairy[/hyperlink] to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.LEVIATHAN_TENTACLES.name: Leviathan Tentacles
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.LEVIATHAN_TENTACLES.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] adjacent to this Landmark gain:<bulletlist><bullet>-20 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] and +10 <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ELDRITCH_LURE]Eldritch lure[/hyperlink] <casttactical></casttactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatEnchantmentConcept]Combat Enchantment[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] with 3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] adjacent to this Landmark gains:<bulletlist><bullet>+100 <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>Allows recruitment of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.ASTRAL_WISP_UNIT]Astral Wisps[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.ASTRAL_SERPENT_UNIT]Astral Serpents[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.ASTRAL_SIPHONER_UNIT]Astral Siphoners[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>On new turn, this Landmark is bound, putting it in a dormant state where its other adjacency effects are disabled.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.MISTWALKER_CAMP_SPRING.name: Mistwalker Camp
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.MISTWALKER_CAMP_SPRING.description:
A crude encampment where sinister Fey lurk in the mists.
Provinces in this infestation's territory have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MISTY]Misty[/hyperlink].
If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion armies.

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.RAINBOW_CLOVER.name: Rainbow Clover
