GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.RAINBOW_CLOVER.description: Unique global effect: <bulletlist><bullet>+100 <goodRelation></goodRelation> relations with <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.RITUAL_SPAWNER.name: Ritual Circle
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.RITUAL_SPAWNER.description:
A cabal of crazed cultists has claimed this region.
If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion armies.

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.SECRET_TEMPLE.name: Secret Temple
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.SECRET_TEMPLE.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+2 <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink] per <researchpost></researchpost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResearchPostConcept]Research Post[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.BLESSED_SOUL]Blessed Soul[/hyperlink] unit to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.THORN_HEART_LANDMARK.name: Thorn Heart
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.THORN_HEART_LANDMARK.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] adjacent to this Landmark gain:<bulletlist><bullet>+5 <food></food> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>+5 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>A Farm <farm></farm> in this province grants +5 <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink] additional income.</bullet></bulletlist>A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] with 3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] adjacent to this Landmark gains:<bulletlist><bullet>The City terraforms 1 province on the surface within a 5 province radius of its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink] per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink]. The terraformed province:<bulletlist><bullet>Gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SunlessConcept]Sunless[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Loses [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist></bullet><bullet>The City's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireConcept]Empire[/hyperlink] gains the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.PARASITICINFECTION]Parasiticinfection[/hyperlink] <casttactical></casttactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatEnchantmentConcept]Combat Enchantment[/hyperlink] when fighting in a province with Sunless.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.VOID_STONES.name: Void Stones
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.VOID_STONES.description: Unique global effect: <bulletlist><bullet>Gain +2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept]<allegiance></allegiance> Allegiance[/hyperlink] with discovered [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingConcept]Umbral Dwellings[/hyperlink] per <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Allows the forging of misc items that grant immunity to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SHADOW_SICKNESS]Umbral Malady[/hyperlink] in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ItemForgeConcept]Item Forge[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.WITHERED_TREE.name: Withered Tree
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.WITHERED_TREE.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+1 <food></food> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink] and +1 <structureprod></structureprod> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] per [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralBarrensConcept]Astral Barrens[/hyperlink] in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.CARRION_BIRD]Carrion Bird[/hyperlink] unit to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Unlocks the Restore action which turns this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonder[/hyperlink] into a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.WORLD_TREE]World Tree[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.WORLD_TREE.name: World Tree
GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.WORLD_TREE.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+2 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] and +2 <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink] per <forester></forester> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ForesterConcept]Forester[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.ENTWINED_THRALL_UNIT]Entwined Thrall[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.ENTWINED_PROTECTOR_UNIT]Entwined Protector[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.ENTWINED_SCOURGE_UNIT]Entwined Scourge[/hyperlink] to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.ALTAR_OF_MARCH.name: [conduit/] Altar of Marching Gloom
GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.ALTAR_OF_MARCH.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+10 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] income.</bullet><bullet>Every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] within a radius equal to the City Tier:<bulletlist><bullet>Gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept]Gloom[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Loses [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChasmConcept]Chasm[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RiverConcept]River[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SwampConcept]Swamp[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SnowConcept]Snow[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept]Ice[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept]Ashlands[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist></bullet><bullet>Counts as a <conduit></conduit> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ConduitConcept]Conduit[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.BEACONOFUNITY.name: [expansionvictory/] Beacon of Unity
GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.BEACONOFUNITY.description: A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SpecialImprovementConcept]Special Province Improvement[/hyperlink] that is built as part of the Expansion Victory. Once three Beacons have been built, an option to Light the Beacons will appear. Lighting the Beacons will start a <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] timer counting down to victory.

GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.LORD_CASTLE_2.name: Vampire Castle: Chambers
GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.LORD_CASTLE_2.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+1 <medalGold></medalGold> Starting Rank to every summoned Tier 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MAGIC_ORIGIN]Magic Origin[/hyperlink] unit.</bullet><bullet>Unlocks Summoning Tier II Units.</bullet><bullet>Unlocks the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.BLOOD_TRANSFER_RITUAL]Blood Transfer Ritual[/hyperlink] spell.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.LORD_CASTLE_FO.name: Vampire Castle: Foundation
GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.LORD_CASTLE_FO.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Unlocks <thralls></thralls> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThrallConcept]Thralls[/hyperlink] in the city, produced like <population></population> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.PALL_OF_DARKNESS]Pall of Darkness Ritual[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>If <souls></souls> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SoulConcept]Soul[/hyperlink] are unlocked:<bulletlist><bullet>Gain the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.SOUL_DRAIN_RITUAL]Soul Drain Ritual[/hyperlink] spell.</bullet><bullet>Gain the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SPECIAL_OPERATIONS.THRALL_EFFIGY]Thrall Effigy[/hyperlink] spell.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.OUTPOST_WATCH_.name: Watch Tower
GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.OUTPOST_WATCH_.description: Builds a Watch Tower in this outpost, granting the outpost +4 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.VisionRangeConcept]Vision Range[/hyperlink] and +4 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SensorRangeConcept]Sensing Range[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.OUTPOST_WORK_C.name: Work Camp
GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.OUTPOST_WORK_C.description: <bulletlist><bullet>This allows for the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceAnnexationConcept]Annexation[/hyperlink] of a single province.</bullet><bullet>If a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] is founded from this outpost, it will start with one additional <population></population> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PopulationConcept]Population[/hyperlink] and the annexed province already attached.</bullet><bullet>A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.TELEPORTER]<teleporter></teleporter> Teleporter[/hyperlink] improvement can be built in the province with the Teleporter Infrastructure [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EmpireSkillConcept]Empire Skill[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.SPELL_JAMMER.name: [conduit/] Spell Jammer
GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.SPELL_JAMMER.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Enemies cannot target [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapSpellConcept]World Map Spells[/hyperlink] in this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>-10 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Counts as a <conduit></conduit> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ConduitConcept]Conduit[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.STONE_WALLS.name: Sentry Nests
GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.STONE_WALLS.description: Grants 2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.STRIDER]Striders[/hyperlink] on the defender's side when fighting a defensive [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeConcept]Siege[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.TELEPORTER.name: [teleporter/] Teleporter
GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.TELEPORTER.description:
A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvement[/hyperlink] which enables an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArmyConcept]Army[/hyperlink] to teleport from one teleporter to another.

-10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.WIZARD_TOWER_I.name: Wizard Tower: Item Forge
GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.WIZARD_TOWER_I.description: Unlocks the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ItemForgeConcept]Item Forge[/hyperlink], allowing you to create custom Hero Items using <bindingessence></bindingessence> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BindingEssenceConcept]Binding Essence[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.WIZARD_TOWER_L.name: Wizard Tower: Chambers
GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.WIZARD_TOWER_L.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+1 <medalGold></medalGold> Starting Rank to every summoned Tier 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MAGIC_ORIGIN]Magic Origin[/hyperlink] unit.</bullet><bullet>Unlocks Summoning Tier II Units.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.TOKENDEFINITION.ARCANIUM_ORE_TOKE.name: Arcanium Ore
GLOBAL.TOKENDEFINITION.ARCANIUM_ORE_TOKE.description: Unique global effect: <bulletlist><bullet>Hurry Recruitment for [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] is 25% cheaper.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.TOKENDEFINITION.ASTRAL_DEW_TOKEN.name: Astral Dew
GLOBAL.TOKENDEFINITION.ASTRAL_DEW_TOKEN.description: Unique global effect: <bulletlist><bullet>+15 <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.TOKENDEFINITION.FOCUS_CRYSTALS_TO.name: Focus Crystals
GLOBAL.TOKENDEFINITION.FOCUS_CRYSTALS_TO.description: Unique global effect: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] gain +20% <xp></xp> experience from combat.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.TOKENDEFINITION.HASTE_BERRIES_TOK.name: Haste Berries
GLOBAL.TOKENDEFINITION.HASTE_BERRIES_TOK.description: Unique global effect: <bulletlist><bullet>Founding, migrating and absorbing [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] takes -2 turns.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.TOKENDEFINITION.LITHORITE_ASTROLA.name: Lithorite Astrolabe
GLOBAL.TOKENDEFINITION.LITHORITE_ASTROLA.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Unlocks Eternal Studies in your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink], which converts the city's <structureprod></structureprod> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] into <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.TOKENDEFINITION.LITHORITE_PRISM_A.name: Lithorite Prism
GLOBAL.TOKENDEFINITION.LITHORITE_PRISM_A.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] gain:<bulletlist><bullet>+20 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] if you have an <order></order> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OrderConcept]Order Affinity[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TomeConcept]Tome[/hyperlink] in your library.</bullet><bullet>+10 <food></food> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink] if you have a <nature></nature> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NatureConcept]Nature Affinity[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TomeConcept]Tome[/hyperlink] in your library.</bullet><bullet>+10 <gold></gold> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] if you have a <matter></matter> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MateriumConcept]Materium Affinity[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TomeConcept]Tome[/hyperlink] in your library.</bullet><bullet>+10 <unitprod></unitprod> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitProductionConcept]Draft[/hyperlink] if you have a <chaos></chaos> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos Affinity[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TomeConcept]Tome[/hyperlink] in your library.</bullet><bullet>+10 <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink] if you have a <shadow></shadow> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowConcept]Shadow Affinity[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TomeConcept]Tome[/hyperlink] in your library.</bullet><bullet>+10 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] if you have an <arcana></arcana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralConcept]Astral Affinity[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TomeConcept]Tome[/hyperlink] in your library.</bullet><bullet>For dual affinity [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TomeConcept]Tomes[/hyperlink] these bonuses are halved.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.TOKENDEFINITION.RAINBOW_CLOVER_TO.name: Rainbow Clover
GLOBAL.TOKENDEFINITION.RAINBOW_CLOVER_TO.description: Unique global effect: <bulletlist><bullet>+100 <goodRelation></goodRelation> relations with <minorcity></minorcity> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Free Cities[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LeaderConcept]Rulers[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.TOKENSETBONUS.COSMICFLUX_ELIXIR.name: Cosmoflux Elixir
GLOBAL.TOKENSETBONUS.COSMICFLUX_ELIXIR.description: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceImprovementConcept]Province Improvements[/hyperlink] in provinces with Mana [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NodeConcept]Resource Nodes[/hyperlink] grant +5 <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink] and <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.UNITS.AMPLIFICATION_PYLON_UNIT.name: Amplification Pylon
GLOBAL.UNITS.AMPLIFICATION_PYLON_UNIT.description: Stationary tower that shoots enemies and amplifies spell damage.

GLOBAL.UNITS.BONE_GOLEM.name: Bone Horror
GLOBAL.UNITS.BONE_GOLEM.description: This amalgamation of reanimated corpses has the sole purpose of killing your foes, with no regard for its own survival.

GLOBAL.UNITS.CATAPULT_UNIT.name: Onager
GLOBAL.UNITS.CATAPULT_UNIT.description: An mobile siege engine that can hurl projectiles over large distances. But may be inaccurate.

GLOBAL.UNITS.CHAOES_EATER_UNIT.name: Chaos Eater
GLOBAL.UNITS.CHAOES_EATER_UNIT.description: Close-range Battle Mage unit that excels at exploiting [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept]Negative Status Effects[/hyperlink].

GLOBAL.UNITS.EARTHSHATTER_ENGINE_UNIT.name: Earthshatter Engine
GLOBAL.UNITS.EARTHSHATTER_ENGINE_UNIT.description: Slow but strong siege engine capable of destroying whole sections of walls within moments.

GLOBAL.UNITS.EARTH_TITAN_UNIT.name: Earth Titan
GLOBAL.UNITS.EARTH_TITAN_UNIT.description: Only obeying the command of the absolute masters of the earth, the Earth Titan is an unstoppable force and the embodiment of the earth's rage.

GLOBAL.UNITS.HORNED_GOD.name: Horned God
GLOBAL.UNITS.HORNED_GOD.description: A powerful warden of nature and the personification of its wrath. Capable of summoning and healing.

GLOBAL.UNITS.IRON_GOLEM_ASSISTANT_UNIT.name: Iron Golem Assistant
GLOBAL.UNITS.IRON_GOLEM_ASSISTANT_UNIT.description: Expandable [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIGHTER]Fighter Unit[/hyperlink] that is immune to Status Effects.

GLOBAL.UNITS.LIVING_FOG_UNIT.name: Living Fog
GLOBAL.UNITS.LIVING_FOG_UNIT.description: A being from the void whose attacks cannot be blocked and that makes mortals go insane.

GLOBAL.UNITS.LIVING_VINE_UNIT.name: Living Vine
GLOBAL.UNITS.LIVING_VINE_UNIT.description: A stationary plant that entangles anything that comes within its range.

GLOBAL.UNITS.NECROTIC_SPIRE_UNIT.name: Necrotic Spire
GLOBAL.UNITS.NECROTIC_SPIRE_UNIT.description: A defensive structure that heals and buffs nearby friendly Undead units.

GLOBAL.UNITS.PHASE_BEAST_UNIT.name: Phase Beast
GLOBAL.UNITS.PHASE_BEAST_UNIT.description: An elusive and fast shock unit, capable of teleportation.

GLOBAL.UNITS.TENTACLE_UNIT.name: Tentacle
GLOBAL.UNITS.TENTACLE_UNIT.description: A stationary tentacle that constricts nearby targets in its reach.

GLOBAL.UNITS.WIND_RAGER_UNIT.name: Wind Rager
GLOBAL.UNITS.WIND_RAGER_UNIT.description: Summon a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.WIND_RAGER_UNIT]Wind Rager[/hyperlink], a fast and disruptive [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIGHTER]Fighter Unit[/hyperlink]

GLOBAL.UNITS.ZEALOT_UNIT.name: Zealot
GLOBAL.UNITS.ZEALOT_UNIT.description: Cheap fanatical Fighter unit that is advantageous against [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CONDEMNED]Condemned[/hyperlink] units.
